commentary: Prasidh to Tom Curran, out Caught by Bhuvneshwar!! Curran backs away to a full ball just outside off, swings hard and slices it high off the toe-end. Tumbling catch from Bhuvneshwar running in from third man and that is the end of that. Prasidh finishes with four-fer on debut, putting the finishing touches on a collapse he started. Thakur to Buttler, out Lbw! Nothing on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking: Pitching in line, impact in line, and umpire's call for hitting, clipping the top of leg-stump! That's pitching on off-stump, angling towards leg, Buttler is late on the flick shot, falling over into the off-side, and misses, and that's struck him on the pads. Massive appeal from Thakur, and he's got a raised finger from the umpire. Buttler reviews because he thinks it's going down leg, but it's just clipping. Review retained, but wicket, not quite. Thakur to Bairstow, out Caught by Kuldeep Yadav! What's with openers, pulls and the 90s today? A cross-seamer banged in short, Bairstow lashes out with a pull, but hasn't timed it particularly well, and has managed to hand the fielder manning the cow corner fence the simplest chance. He's run across, lost his cap, but has the sense to keep his eyes on the ball and take the catch. It does look like the early advantage of the opening stand is being fast neutralized by India now. Prasidh to Roy, out Caught by (sub)Suryakumar Yadav!! First international wicket for Prasidh. SKY juggling at backward point, but manages to grab the rebound. Bit of a strange shot this. Roy lost the bottom hand grip looking to loft the ball. Looked like it came slowly off the pitch and Roy ended up slicing it low to the left of backward point. No actually it was the extra bounce that did the trick. Roy was looking to pull, had to change the shot and the ball rushed on him to hit him high on the bat and fly towards backward point. Finally a breakthrough for India and the bowling change has worked. Roy c (sub)Suryakumar Yadav b Prasidh 46(35) [4s-7 6s-1]

Moeen Ali to Kohli, no run, spinning back in, Kohli cuts it towards point

Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, oh tries to flick and gets a leading edge that rolls towards point
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, 1 run, cut away square of the wicket outside the off-side

Adil Rashid to Dhawan, no run, enough doubt there to rule it in favour of the batsman there. Spinning back in, Dhawan misses the sweep, impact in line with leg but the ball had turned to cause the doubt in the ump's mind. England keep their review

Adil Rashid to Dhawan, SIX, the Shikhar Dhawan slog sweep and he clears the mid-wicket boundary to raise his fifty. This is full and just outside off stump, picks it up from there and powers it nicely. Pat on the shoulder from the captain
Stokes to Kohli, no run, defended towards backward point
Stokes to Kohli, no run, short of length delivery on the off stump, Kohli gets hit on the thigh pad as he ball bounces extra
Stokes to Kohli, no run, short of length delivery, Kohli defends
Stokes to Kohli, no run, outside off stump, left alone
Stokes to Kohli, no run, creams the cover drive but is frustrated with himself for hitting it straight to the fielder
Stokes to Kohli, FOUR, short delivery on the off stump, Kohli goes back and pulls through mid-wicket, man in the deep very wide and had no chance running to his left
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, punched off the back foot to long-on
Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, driven off the front foot towards cover
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 2 runs, quicker ball but Kohli using the depth of the crease to great effect and cut late past backward point
Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, flighted delivery just outside off stump, Kohli defends off the front foot
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, 1 run, whipped away past mid-wicket, long-on is wide and he cuts it off
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, no run, advances and defends this flatter delivery into off
Stokes to Dhawan, 1 run, short of length delivery outside off stump, Dhawan taps it away to backward point
Stokes to Dhawan, no run, played to point
Stokes to Dhawan, no run, Dhawan taps it beside the pitch and looks for a quick single which isn't there
Stokes to Kohli, 1 run, fullish delivery well outside off stump, driven to the left of cover this time
Stokes to Kohli, no run, short of length delivery outside off stump, Kohli taps it towards backward point
Stokes to Kohli, FOUR, oh shot!!! Overpitched delivery outside off stump, Kohli leans forward and crashes the drive right from the middle of the bat between mid-off and cover
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, taps it to point off the front foot and runs off
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, 1 run, full and down leg, Dhawan plays the fine sweep to fine leg
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, no run, shortish delivery outside off stump, Dhawan cuts towards point
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, no run, appeal for LBW, not given! Missing leg, Dhawan wanted to sweep this full ball and missed
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, again mistimes the drive, wanted to hit through cover, but plays it off the inner half of the bat and it rolls straight down the ground
Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, short delivery, Kohli pulls towards mid-wicket
Tom Curran to Kohli, 1 run, shortish delivery outside off stump, Kohli lets the ball come and cuts to sweeper cover
Tom Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, short of length delivery outside off stump, Dhawan cuts to sweeper cover
Tom Curran to Dhawan, no run, fullish and outside off stump, Dhawan drives it towards mid-off
Tom Curran to Dhawan, no run, short of length delivery outside off stump, Dhawan punches it towards backward point
Tom Curran to Dhawan, no run, short of length delivery outside off stump, Dhawan chops the cut to backward point
Tom Curran to Kohli, 1 run, short of length on the off stump, Kohli goes back and knocks it to mid-wicket
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, no run, googly on the off stump, Dhawan defends from the crease
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, no run, flighted delivery on the stumps, Dhawan defends
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, flighted delivery on the leg stump, Kohli works it through square leg
Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, too short, punched back to the bowler
Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, inviting the drive off the front foot, Kohli mistimes back to the bowler
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, 1 run, full and down leg, Dhawan glances it to fine leg
Tom Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, glanced to fine leg, they think about two as the fielder has to attack the ball from distance, risky second so they say no
Tom Curran to Kohli, 1 run, short of length delivery outside off stump, Kohli guides it to third man
Tom Curran to Kohli, no run, fullish delivery just outside off stump, Kohli defends into the off-side
Tom Curran to Kohli, no run, slower delivery on the off stump, Kohli defends off the back foot
Tom Curran to Kohli, no run, good length delivery outside off stump, Kohli lets it pass
Tom Curran to Kohli, 2 runs, walks a long way across the sticks and glanced this full ball from the off stump line to fine leg, man in the deep very square so Kohli rushing back for the second run
Stokes to Dhawan, FOUR, on the pads, is strong with that bottom-handed flick. Dhawan sends this racing through backward square leg and the man in the deep too had no chance
Stokes to Kohli, 1 run, opens the face of the bat and guides to third man
Stokes to Dhawan, 1 run, oh driven on the rise, but didn't control the shot. Played it to the right of cover. Looks like that length ball stopped on him
Stokes to Kohli, 1 run, now drives to the left of the fielder at cover and opens the account
Stokes to Kohli, no run, first ball Virat Kohli is stretching fully forward to the pitch of the ball and cover driving! Hit it straight to the fielder though

Stokes to Rohit, out Caught by Buttler!! Ben Stokes the patnership breaker again! Looks at his team-mates with a smile because he knows he's got a big wicket on a nothing ball. Short and wide, almost a wide, Rohit usually smashes those past backward point, but got an outside edge as the ball swung away late. England get their first breakthrough. Rohit c Buttler b Stokes 28(42) [4s-4]
Tom Curran to Rohit, 1 run, good length delivery on the off stump, Rohit works it to short mid-wicket
Tom Curran to Rohit, no run, Rohit closes the bat face early looking to work the ball to leg, gets a leading edge that rolls towards backward point
Tom Curran to Rohit, FOUR, advances and pulls over mid-wicket. Short delivery, Rohit ran at the bowler and had no intentions of keeping it along the ground
Tom Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, short of length delivery outside off stump, Dhawan opens the face of the bat and guides to third man
Tom Curran to Dhawan, no run, short of length delivery just outside off stump, Dhawan pushes towards point
Tom Curran to Dhawan, no run, fullish and on the off stump, Dhawan defends
Stokes to Rohit, no run, beaten on the forward defence! Gets Rohit forward, and gets it to seam away from a good length, beating him on the outside edge!
Stokes to Dhawan, leg byes, 1 run, onto the thighs from a back of a length, tucks it away off the backfoot to short fine leg for a single - no bat involved in fact. Leg-byes.

Stokes to Dhawan, FOUR, short ball, and it turns out, Dhawan has premeditated correctly this time, gets across and now has the margin of error to play the hook a bit late, gets it away to fine leg on the bounce for four
Stokes to Dhawan, 2 runs, back of a length ball on the hips, Dhawan charges and tucks this away towards backward square leg for a couple
Stokes to Dhawan, no run, back of a length ball on off-stump, Dhawan defends this tentatively into the off-side
Stokes to Dhawan, no run, back of a length ball on middle, Dhawan defends off the backfoot

Tom Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, another blind charge from Dhawan, tries working it into the on-side from a back of a length, but ends up getting a leading edge wide of the slip fielder down to third man for a single
Tom Curran to Rohit, 1 run, works this one from a back of a length to short mid-wicket for a single
Tom Curran to Rohit, no run, seams back in from a back of a length, Rohit tries to glance it away but that's struck him on the thigh

Tom Curran to Rohit, no run, squared up! This white ball has done more today than it's done in the lasy 15 years combined! Gets forward and across to counter the movement, but this one seams away off a hard length and beats him on the outside edge of the defence...
Tom Curran to Rohit, no run, takes off from a back of a length, loads of width outside off, Rohit gets low and has a go at the delicate cut, but that flies over the top-edge
Tom Curran to Rohit, no run, carves a length ball with width towards Roy's left at point, but he's dived once again and cut it off, much to the frustration of Rohit...
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, back of a length ball just outside off, tapped off the backfoot towards point
Sam Curran to Rohit, 1 run, short of length ball, rather wide, Rohit reaches out and taps it on the head to glide it down to third man for a single
Sam Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, very full ball on the boots, whipped away to deep mid-wicket for a single
Sam Curran to Dhawan, 2 runs, a bit round-arm, Malinga ball from a length, Dhawan opens the face and carves this away to deep backward point for a couple
Sam Curran to Rohit, 1 run, a wide yorker close to the wide-line, Rohit reaches out and squeezes it with an open-faced deflection down to third man for a single
Sam Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, short and wide, cut away hard, square of the wicket, for a single
Sam Curran to Dhawan, wide, sees Dhawan coming, pitches it short, Dhawan tries to upper-cut, but even the 'keeper has to leap to keep it down - wide called for height

Tom Curran to Rohit, no run, seams sharply back in from a back of a length, Rohit gets across and then jackknifes low after a hop, gets it off the thigh towards the 'keeper who appeals in vain for a catch
Tom Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, good length ball on the pads, clipped off the legs towards backward square leg for a single
Tom Curran to Rohit, 1 run, still a bit of away-swing from a good length, Rohit lets it come on and steers it down to third man for a single
Tom Curran to Rohit, no run, back of a length and marginally wide, Rohit cuts it away towards Roy at point who dives and cuts it off
Tom Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, tucks a back of a length ball off a hop towards square leg for a single

Tom Curran to Dhawan, no run, right on the money! Pitches it on a back of a length in the channel outside off, gets it to seam away just more than enough, and that beats Dhawan on the outside edge of the backfoot defence
Sam Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, short ball, gets across and swivels into a pull shot down to deep square leg for one
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, back of a length and just a little wide, Dhawan balances himself with a wide stance and glides it towards backward point - can't find the gap
Sam Curran to Rohit, 1 run, swinging back in from a good length, clipped away towards deep square leg for a single
Sam Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, works this off a leg-stump line to mid-on for a quick single
Sam Curran to Rohit, 1 run, digs this in short, Rohit gets into position for the hook, mistimes it down to backward square leg for a single
Sam Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, good length ball on middle, Dhawan works it away to square leg for a quick single
Mark Wood to Rohit, FOUR, overtpiches this time, and Rohit has nailed a check-drive to the long-on fence for four! Absolutely times the pants off this one...
Mark Wood to Rohit, FOUR, picks this from a good length and creams the drive on the up over the covers to the deep extra cover fence for four!

Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, very full on middle and leg again, check-drives this really late towards mid-on, where the fielder, Tom Curran, dives and has a throw at the non-striker's end, hits, but Dhawan is safely in...
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, no width on offer from a back of a length spot, deadbatted off the backfoot
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, fuller length delivery just outside off, punched towards cover

Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, a swerving yorker ball on middle and off, Rohit just about manages to get an outside edge on it and manages to get it to Stokes in the slips - who has managed to hurt his shin!
Sam Curran to Rohit, 1 run, fuller length ball swerving in slightly, check-driven to mid-on for a quick single
Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, takes the pace off, 124km/h, width on offer, an off-cutter (leg-cutter for Rohit), and he reaches out to have a poke - misses
Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, fuller length ball on off-stump, a bit of swing in, Rohit checks a drive towards mid-on
Sam Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, tucked this off a backfoot hop to square leg for a quick single
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, marginally wide and full outside off, left alone by Dhawan

Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, dropped! Run-out chance! All happening! Dhawan cuts one with minimal width, doesn't keep it down, a dive to the left from Roy, who can't hold on, and Billings throws at the non-striker's end - misses, might've been out if he'd hit. Rohit had to put in the dive!
Mark Wood to Dhawan, 1 run, back of a length ball just outside off, tapped on the head off the backfoot towards cover point for a quick single

Mark Wood to Dhawan, FOUR, overpitched this time, a bit of swing away to create width, Dhawan doesn't move his feet uch but runs his hands through the ball to deep extra cover for four! Runs starting to flow just a little bit, for India...

Mark Wood to Dhawan, FOUR, save your legs! Well you can't, because there aren't any spectators to throw it back. Scratch that, go fetch - short and marginally wide, Dhawan very marginally, and Dhawan gets on his toes to arch a little and cream a cramped cut square of the wicket for four! Incredible shot!
Mark Wood to Dhawan, no run, no width on this short of length ball, Dhawan tries having a go at the cut, gets it away towards cover point

Mark Wood to Dhawan, no run, 140.1km/h, skids through from a good length and a bit of movement off the seam into the left-hander, Dhawan tries driving footlessly but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads
Mark Wood to Dhawan, no run, length ball pitched rather wide outside off, Dhawan steps across and leaves it alone...
Sam Curran to Rohit, FOUR, that's a shot and a half! He's stepped across, in surprisingly sensitive conditions, and lapped a good length ball over short fine leg for a one-bounce four!
Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, back of a length ball just outside off, Rohit stays back and defends it very late into the wicket
Sam Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, good length and wide outside off, Dhawan charges down the wicket, and works it from outside off towards mid-wicket for one

Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, angles in, seams in as well and hurries on from a length Dhawan, Dhawan is late on the half-cocked forward defence, and that's struck him on the pads - perhaps a little high, and that's a futile appeal
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, charges down, but sees no width on a short ball, and he's had to get on his toes to fend it off the sticker with the bottom-hand off...
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, short and wide, Dhawan shapes up with a wide stance for the cut, but simply doesn't go through with it! Shoulders arms...
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, beaten! Takes off from a short of length spot, straightens a little off the seam, and beats the attempted backfoot punch from Rohit on the outside edge!
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, very full, 142.3km/h, swerves away from the off-stump line a little, Rohit opens the face a little into the off-side and defends under his eye

Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, ouch! Rohit is in agony! 148km/h, and it's taken off from a back of a length, straightened, and missed the backfoot defence to strike him on the elbow - possibly the funny bone, which isn't amusing in the least. He's getting some medical attention. A second unforeseen break - 1. Hole in the ball, 2. The not-so-funny bone...
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, taps this length ball on the head towards cover, and they've sensibly decided against the single
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, seams away once again and beats the outside edge? Nah, I'd say he's played it inside the line and intended to miss, as it whizzes past
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, good length and straightening on off-stump, fended off the backfoot into the off-side
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, zips through from a good length spot in the channel outside off, Dhawan boldly leaves it alone. Maiden from Curran.
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, angling in towards the leg-side, Dhawan misses the glance trying to pick it from a length, thuds off the kneeroll into the off-side
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, very full and outside off, Dhawan gets forward, a little too forward, and drills it off the toe-end towards mid-off
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, a bit more width but lands it on a good length, Dhawan gets the backfoot across on off-stump again before leaving it alone
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, back of a length ball angling away but relatively close to the stumps, Dhawan gets across and shoulders arms

Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, fuller length ball just outside off, Dhawan walks into a cover drive, Billings stops it at short cover, and twists his ankle before falling over! Looks like he's alright...
Mark Wood to Dhawan, 1 run, rising into the ribcage from a short of length at 146.6km/h, Dhawan hops and tucks it away towards fine leg for a single
Mark Wood to Dhawan, no run, good length ball but angling far too wide outside off, left alone by Dhawan
Mark Wood to Dhawan, FOUR, just a hint of width on offer on a short of length ball, and Dhawan allows it to come on, cracks it away with a cut to the deep backward point fence for four!

Mark Wood to Dhawan, no run, uh oh, that's inveigled him into thinking that he had some width on a short of length ball, but seams back in to cut him in half and beats his inside edge - flies over the stumps, between bat and thigh, to the 'keeper
Mark Wood to Dhawan, no run, short of length ball angling outside off, Dhawan gets his backfoot across towards off-stump and leaves it alone
Mark Wood to Rohit, 1 run, back of a length ball rising sharply, 145.1km/h, Rohit gets on his toes and rides the bounce to steer it down towards third man for a single
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, short of length ball in the channel outside off, and seaming away prodigiously, Dhawan shuffles across in his trigger and shoulders arms
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, nice hard length outside off, Dhawan steps forward and across to shoulder arms
Sam Curran to Rohit, 1 run, works another full one away towards mid-wicket for a single
Sam Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, back of a length and minimal width on offer, Dhawan stays low and carves it away to deep backward point for a single...
Sam Curran to Rohit, 1 run, pitched up on the pads, and that's whipped away to backward square leg for one

Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, is that pitching outside leg? That was a good length one swinging back in, Rohit has fallen across a little trying to glance it away, misses, and that's struck him on the pads - big appeal, but possibly going over the stumps as well, and pitching outside leg according to Ball-tracking...
Mark Wood to Dhawan, no run, tucks this short of length ball off the hips towards square leg
Mark Wood to Dhawan, no run, angling away, hard length, and seams further away as Dhawan defends inside the line! Good, hard phase of Test match lengths dished out to the batsmen at the moment...
Mark Wood to Rohit, 1 run, 143.1km/h, short of length ball into the hip, tucked towards square leg for a quick single
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, short of length ball at 143.1km/h, seaming away from the inward angle, and that's beaten Rohit on the outside edge as he tries to defend off the backfoot
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, short of length on off-stump, Rohit gets on his toes to get on top of the bounce and drops it into the on-side
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, hard length but wide outside the off-stump, 138.7km/h, warm-up pace for Wood, and that's left alone by Rohit

Thakur to Malan, 2 runs, England complete an absolute mockery of the chase! Short of a length around middle, Malan swivel-pulls this to deep mid-wicket where there is a slight fumble which makes the second run a formality. Series is now level 1-1 with a game to go

Thakur to Malan, no ball, byes, FOUR, another bumper attempt, sails well over a leaping Pant and away to the fence. Looks like five wides initially but the ump signals no-ball, so four byes to it. Free Hit coming up
Thakur to Malan, no run, another short ball, once again Malan evades the bumper
Thakur to Malan, no run, sharp short ball, Malan doesn't offer a stroke
Prasidh to Livingstone, no run, short of a length, Livingstone looks to slog but misses and this goes off his shoulder towards slip
Prasidh to Livingstone, no run, another lovely yorker, attacking the stumps, jammed out by Livingstone
Prasidh to Livingstone, no run, goes for the yorker, gets it right, dug out back past the bowler, towards mid-on
Prasidh to Malan, 1 run, pitched up on middle and leg, whipped away to long-on
Prasidh to Malan, wide, goes short but it's too high and above Malan's head
Prasidh to Malan, no run, play and a miss again! Another away-angler, Malan tries to run it down to third man but misses
Prasidh to Malan, no run, shortish and angling across Malan who is beaten on the cut
Bhuvneshwar to Malan, 1 run, on the pads again, fuller, Malan wrists it to deep square leg
Bhuvneshwar to Malan, no run, straighter line on middle and leg, Malan stays back and blocks it well
Bhuvneshwar to Malan, 2 runs, fuller and straighter this time, whipped away through mid-wicket
Bhuvneshwar to Malan, FOUR, streaky runs! Malan looks to go for the drive, chases it with zero footwork and gets a healthy nick that goes well wide of Pant. Very fine and away to the third man fence
Bhuvneshwar to Malan, no run, back of a length, extra bounce and Malan dabs it gently towards point
Bhuvneshwar to Livingstone, 1 run, angling in on middle and leg, Livingstone stands tall and eases this down to long-on
Prasidh to Malan, no run, shortish and angling across Malan who tries to poke at it but is beaten by the slant
Prasidh to Malan, no run, back of a length, slanting across Malan who steers this from the crease towards point
Prasidh to Malan, no run, angling across from middle and off, dabbed gently to point
Prasidh to Livingstone, leg byes, 1 run, short again, but high enough for the pull and Livingstone misses the pull stroke, and wears a blow near his midriff region. That will sting for sure
Prasidh to Livingstone, no run, sharp bumper, well-directed and Livingstone is late on the pull. Beaten!
Prasidh to Malan, 1 run, full and angling across Malan who drives sweetly behind point to get off-strike

Bhuvneshwar to Malan, leg byes, 1 run, good call from the ump! This one straightened off the deck, pinning Malan on the crease and rapped him on the pads in front of middle and off. Looked close in real time and Bhuvneshwar prompted Kohli into the review. As it turns out, it was pitching just outside leg. That's probably what the ump felt too
Bhuvneshwar to Livingstone, 1 run, fuller and outside off, driven firmly to mid-off who is at the edge of the ring
Bhuvneshwar to Malan, 1 run, angling across the left-hander, steered past point
Bhuvneshwar to Livingstone, 1 run, shortish and on off stump, punched off the back foot towards long-on

Bhuvneshwar to Livingstone, SIX, this is an even bigger hit! Bhuvneshwar responds with a bumper, well-directed but Livingstone is equal to the challenge. Rocks back and clobbers the pull high over deep square leg. Deep into the stands

Bhuvneshwar to Livingstone, SIX, daredevil stuff from Livingstone! Gives the charge early, gets the shortened length from Bhuvneshwar and yet, goes through with the stroke. Checks his lofted drive easily over mid-on. Cracking connection and clears the ropes
Kuldeep Yadav to Livingstone, 1 run, sliding in on middle and leg, Livingstone camps back and punches this down to long-on
Kuldeep Yadav to Malan, 1 run, flatter one outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover
Kuldeep Yadav to Livingstone, 1 run, tossed up outside off, Livingstone reaches out and strokes this towards long-off
Kuldeep Yadav to Livingstone, no run, more loop, fuller length outside off, driven gently to cover
Kuldeep Yadav to Livingstone, no run, fuller and outside off, blocked off the front foot towards point

Kuldeep Yadav to Livingstone, FOUR, rank long hop from Kuldeep, can't bowl these freebies to Livingstone. He might be on debut but he is a powerhitter who needs no second invitation for these gifts. Stays back and cracks the pull, keeps it squarer of the deep mid-wicket fielder
Krunal Pandya to Livingstone, 1 run, down the pitch goes Livingstone, drives it down to long-off
Krunal Pandya to Malan, 1 run, floated up on middle and leg, nudged towards mid-wicket
Krunal Pandya to Livingstone, 1 run, fired into the pads, clipped away past square leg
Krunal Pandya to Livingstone, 2 runs, fractionally short and outside off, Livingstone sits back and cuts it hard through point
Krunal Pandya to Malan, 1 run, flatter one on the pads, worked gently towards square leg. They run the first one hard but Malan declines the second run
Krunal Pandya to Livingstone, 1 run, sliding in on middle and leg, worked off the back foot to long-on
Prasidh to Livingstone, 1 run, pacy and shortish, awkward bounce for Livingstone who fends uppishly through the vacant backward square leg region
Prasidh to Livingstone, no run, goes for the yorker again, wide outside off, jammed out to cover

Prasidh to Buttler, out Bowled!! Now then, now then!! Is there a twist left? Buttler's horror day is over. Dropped two crucial catches earlier on, and now has a three-ball duck to cap the day. What a nut from Krishna though! A pacy, searing yorker, right at the base of off stump and the England captain is late in getting his bat down. Beaten for pace, beaten by the length and England in a slight bit of bother here. Still in control though but they won't want to lose another right here. Buttler b Prasidh 0(3)
Prasidh to Buttler, no run, back of a length outside off, Buttler stays back and dabs it gently to point
Prasidh to Buttler, no run, angling in from around off, Buttler stands tall and defends

Prasidh to Bairstow, out Caught by Kohli!! Hit hard but straight to cover! Now then, surely not another collapse? Naah, seems too far fetched but India have finally gotten rid of the set (marauding) batsmen in rather quick succession. This wasn't a wicket-taking ball though, in the driving zone and Bairstow strokes this sweetly but can't keep it down. Straight to the Indian captain in the ring. You'd think that these wickets have come five overs too late. Bairstow c Kohli b Prasidh 124(112) [4s-11 6s-7]
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, 1 run, fuller and wider outside off, steered off the front foot towards deep point
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, straighter lines, Bairstow stays back and defends
Bhuvneshwar to Malan, 1 run, opens up Malan with an away-angler, he was trying to flick and ended up getting an outside edge down to third man
Bhuvneshwar to Malan, no run, shortish and angling across Malan who dabs it gently to point

Bhuvneshwar to Stokes, out Caught by Pant!! Gone on 99! Heartbreak of sorts for Stokes and he is gutted as he makes the long way back. Sharp short ball from Bhuvneshwar, rushed the left-hander into the pull stroke and induced a bit of glove on its route through to Pant. The appeal was instantaneous from India and Stokes knew it too. So did the ump. He may have missed a ton but what a ruthless knock this was. Absolutely roasted the Indian bowling. Stokes c Pant b Bhuvneshwar 99(52) [4s-4 6s-10]

Bhuvneshwar to Stokes, FOUR, Rohit is down and in a lot of pain! This was a cracking shot from Stokes, stepped out early, knew the length will be shortened and flat-batted it straight down the ground. Rohit from long-off got across and fell awkwardly on his elbow while trying to stop it. Excellent effort but in vain

Prasidh to Bairstow, no run, wide yorker, almost on point, Bairstow jams it to the right of Pant who takes it with a lovely dive. No appeal from the Indians, they're in a daze with all this onslaught but the umps decide to just have a check upstairs for bump ball. The third ump agrees with the soft signal
Prasidh to Bairstow, FOUR, slower ball, doesn't matter to Bairstow, he sits back and clubs this over mid-wicket. Clean as a whistle and picks his gap

Prasidh to Bairstow, FOUR, slammed! These two aren't interested in running anymore, just want to end this game in fours and sixes. Krishna misses the yorker, gives Bairstow a juicy full toss. Pumped straight over the bowler's head
Prasidh to Bairstow, no run, short of a length, skids off the deck and Bairstow is early into the pull, gets an under-edge onto the back pad
Prasidh to Bairstow, SIX, outrageous stuff from Bairstow! How has he hit this for six? Almost the perfect wide yorker, low full toss and it's effortlessly sliced over sweeper cover. Unreal stuff
Prasidh to Bairstow, no ball, short ball, Bairstow somehow evades it. Krishna has overstepped. Free HIt coming
Prasidh to Bairstow, no run, a fine yorker, just around off, Bairstow jams it out

Krunal Pandya to Stokes, 2 runs, almost the perfect wide yorker, Stokes slices this just past Pant and down to third man. Very fine and they get a brace. 28 off the over! Krunal realising how cruel this game is. Hero not too long ago, absolutely belted today

Krunal Pandya to Stokes, SIX, he's launched this into orbit! My word, Stokes is in some mood. Probably wants to make up for his momentum-sucking knock last game. Boy, hasn't he compensated for that or not. Sits deep, expecting the flatter one that's on a good length and it's swiped merrily over wide long-on

Krunal Pandya to Stokes, SIX, just over deep backward square leg! Kuldeep had a slight chance but in the end, it's cleared him, just! Was a flatter one outside leg, Stokes didn't get enough on the slog sweep but still gets a maximum
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, wide, Krunal clearly crumbling under this onslaught, once again gets the wide yorker wrong. Too wide
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, 2 runs, fuller and wider this time, Stokes once again goes over extra cover and it takes a fine effort from long-off to prevent another boundary

Krunal Pandya to Stokes, FOUR, spanked! Got to feel for Krunal here, he simply has nowhere to hide against the rampaging Stokes. He sits back to a shortish medium-pacer type delivery, slaps it easily over extra cover. Toying with the bowling
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, wide, tries the wide yorker but well outside the tramline

Krunal Pandya to Stokes, SIX, Stokes can't resist hitting sixes! What ball-striking! Knows that Krunal is going to fire it in, this is on a shortish length and has been flat-batted straight down the ground for a huge maximum. India have no answers to him at the moment
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, down the leg side and Bairstow fails to put away his sweep as he can't middle it
Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, 1 run, short and wide outside off, Stokes slaps it through covers for one

Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, SIX, hat-trick of sixes and Virat Kohli looks concerned. Only 100 runs required. A flighted delivery by the left arm chinaman and it has been deposited right over the sightscreen this time around. Carnage of the highest calibre
Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, SIX, running out of ideas is Kuldeep Yadav. Pitches this up again and Stokes has smoked it straight down the ground as the ball smashes it into the sightscreen

Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, SIX, no stopping Stokes! Even he looks good to bring up his ton tonight. A loopy ball by Kuldeep Yadav and the southpaw goes down on his knee as he pummels this over long-on for six runs. Nothing much can Kuldeep Yadav do on this belter
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, 1 run, spinning down the leg side as Bairstow clips it towards square leg for one
Thakur to Bairstow, 1 run, opens his bat face and steers this back of a length delivery past point for one
Thakur to Bairstow, FOUR, swung away! Slower short ball by Thakur, Bairstow's bottom hand comes off as he swings hard. The impact is good enough for this to race away to the deep mid-wicket fence
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, short ball by Thakur and this one sails over the batsman's head

Thakur to Stokes, 1 run, drives this slower full length delivery back to Thakur as he fails to stop the ball. Single taken as Stokes brings up his fifty. The dug-out realizes it late, hence they applaud a little late as well
Thakur to Stokes, no run, on a length around middle and leg, Stokes clips it in front of mid-wicket
Thakur to Bairstow, 1 run, short of a length outside off, Bairstow guides it down to third man for one
Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, no run, tad short outside off, Stokes rocks back and cuts it to the fielder at point
Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, FOUR, 100-run stand up for the second wicket! Stokes goes down on his knee and heaves the loopy delivery over mid-wicket for four runs
Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, no run, on his back foot to knock this short ball in front of covers

Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, SIX, smashed! Kuldeep Yadav gives it a bit of flight and Stokes tonks it right over the bowler's head as he stands on the pitch and admires his shot. Even he is a only five runs away from his fifty
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, 1 run, heaves this tossed up delivery through the leg side for one

Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, SIX, 11th ODI century for Jonny Bairstow who keeps piling up runs in this format. Missed out an opportunity in the previous game, but makes sure to bring up the milestone in this game. Goes down on his knee and smokes this loopy delivery over deep mid-wicket as he takes off his helmet and raises his bat. His team mates in the dug-out love it and so does Ben Stokes - who gives him a warm hug. 200 up for England as well
Thakur to Bairstow, 1 run, touch fuller around middle and leg, Bairstow drives it down to long-on for one
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, back of a length around off, Bairstow almost chips it back to Thakur who grabs this on one bounce
Thakur to Stokes, 1 run, pitched up by Thakur and it has been driven down to long-on by Stokes
Thakur to Stokes, no run, sliced in front of cover-point by Stokes
Thakur to Stokes, no run, back of a length outside off, keeps straight and skids along the deck as Stokes gets beaten on his cut

Thakur to Stokes, FOUR, England cantering towards the target. Runs flowing now. Short and wide outside off, Stokes slashes away from his body and gets an outside edge that flies away to the third man fence. Required run rate is below 7 now
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, on the pads and Bairstow clips it in front of mid-wicket
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, tad short around off, quicker one as Bairstow knocks it in front of covers

Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, SIX, huge hit! A tossed up delivery by Kuldeep Yadav and Bairstow has slogged this over deep mid-wicket for a massive, massive six. Right in the slot and Bairstow takes full toll of it. Rohit ain't pleased with that delivery by Kuldeep Yadav
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, loopy delivery around middle and leg, Bairstow clips it in front of mid-wicket
Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, 1 run, touch short outside off, Stokes cuts it through point for one
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, 1 run, loopy delivery by Kuldeep Yadav and Bairstow drives it down to long-on
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, 1 run, short of a length around middle and leg, Bairstow knocks it down to long-on for one
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, short of a length around off, Bairstow glides it in front of short third man
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, back of a length outside off, Bairstow looks to cut and gets beaten
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, short of a length around off, Bairstow looks to swipe across the line, ends up getting an inside edge onto his thigh pad
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, back of a length around off, Bairstow defends it onto the pitch
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, FOUR, full length ball by Bhuvneshwar, Bairstow frees his arms and bludgeons this past the fielder at mid-off who was very wide
Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, no run, short ball outside off, spinning away from the batsman who has a flash and gets beaten
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, 1 run, fuller delivery around middle and leg, Bairstow drives it along the ground to long-on for one
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, clips this flatter delivery in front of mid-wicket
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, on the pads and Bairstow glances it in front of short fine leg

Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, FOUR, too many freebies by Indian bowlers tonight. Short and wayward down the leg side, Bairstow latches onto it and swipes it away to the long leg fence without any trouble
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, tossed up delivery around off, Bairstow squeezes it back to Kuldeep Yadav
Bhuvneshwar to Stokes, no run, short and quick outside off, Stokes hangs his bat out to chase this and gets beaten due to the sharp bounce

Bhuvneshwar to Stokes, 2 runs, Stokes had clipped this through mid-wicket and he was always keen for a brace. Was a bit casual while coming back for the second and Kuldeep was agile and sharp enough to score a direct-hit from deep mid-wicket. Replays not conclusive, reckons the third umpire and Stokes survives to fight another day
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, 1 run, full and wide outside off, Bairstow square drives this through point for one
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, good length delivery by Bhuvneshwar and Bairstow guides it back at him
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, length delivery that keeps slightly low and Bairstow knocks it in front of covers
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, back of a length outside off, Bairstow chops it in front of point
Thakur to Stokes, no run, looks to scoop this short of a length delivery by shuffling across, connects thin air though

Thakur to Stokes, no run, short of a length around off, this skids along the deck as Stokes gets beaten due to the skiddy nature of this surface. Looks to work across the line, as the ball whizzes past the inside eddge
Thakur to Bairstow, 1 run, slow and short outside off, Bairstow slaps it through cover-point for one
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, short and wide outside off, Bairstow plays a fine square cut, but it has been stopped with a dive at point
Thakur to Bairstow, 2 runs, helps this short ball through square leg as Kuldeep in the deep sprints across, puts in a dive near the fence and flicks the ball inside play
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, goes short outside off and there's good amount of carry as Bairstow arches back and watches it settle in the keeper's mitts

Krunal Pandya to Stokes, SIX, giving away a single hasn't helped one bit. Stokes looks equally dangerous. Camps back in his crease and pulls this short ball over deep square leg for half a dozen. Kohli facing a similar problem, like he did in the previous match
Krunal Pandya to Bairstow, 1 run, short and wide outside off, Bairstow punches it through covers for a single
Krunal Pandya to Bairstow, no run, fired on leg, Bairstow goes down on his knee to play the sweep as he gets hit on the pads
Krunal Pandya to Bairstow, no run, flatter and quicker around off, Bairstow defends
Krunal Pandya to Bairstow, 2 runs, down on his knee as Bairstow slogsweeps this through mid-wicket as Dhawan stops this with a dive in the deep
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, 1 run, short ball around middle and leg, Stokes whips it down to long-on for one
Prasidh to Stokes, 1 run, short of a length outside off, Stokes glides it down to third man for one
Prasidh to Bairstow, 1 run, short of a length outside off, Bairstow steers it down to third man for one
Prasidh to Bairstow, 2 runs, full and quick around middle and leg, Bairstow clips it to wide long-on and takes a couple of runs more
Prasidh to Bairstow, FOUR, 150 up for England with this magnificent off-drive. Tad fuller around off and Bairstow has creamed it straight past Dhawan at mid-off whose dive isn't going to be enough
Prasidh to Bairstow, no run, good length delivery around off, skids along the deck as Bairstow gets an inside edge onto his backpad

Prasidh to Bairstow, FOUR, and now Prasidh commits the mistake of going short. Bairstow swivels and pulls this away to the deep backward square leg fence with ease. The target looks pretty achievable from here on

Krunal Pandya to Stokes, SIX, short and punished! Rocks back in his crease and pulls this short ball over deep mid-wicket for half-a-dozen does Stokes. Told ya, he's in the mood today! Be wary Indian bowlers..
Krunal Pandya to Bairstow, 1 run, straighter and quicker around middle and leg, Bairstow knocks it down to long-on for one
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, 1 run, down on his knee to sweep this through mid-wicket for one
Krunal Pandya to Bairstow, 1 run, flatter around off and Bairstow knocks it down to long-off for a single
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, 2 wides, fired down the leg side, Stokes misses out on his sweep as the keeper fails to grab it
Krunal Pandya to Bairstow, 1 run, tad short outside off, Bairstow cuts it through point for one
Krunal Pandya to Bairstow, no run, pushed through around off, Bairstow eases it in front of covers
Prasidh to Stokes, no run, full and wide outside off, Stokes drives it towards wide mid-off
Prasidh to Stokes, no run, short and quick outside off, good carry as Stokes lets it through to the keeper

Prasidh to Stokes, 2 runs, good running between the wickets there. Stokes had clipped this through mid-wicket and the throw at the bowler's end was a flat one. Kohli was quick to take down the bails, but Bairstow was even quicker
Prasidh to Stokes, no run, short of a length outside off, Stokes frees his arms and cuts it to point where it has been stopped with a dive
Prasidh to Stokes, no run, looks in the zone does Stokes as he walks down the wicket against this short ball and defends it right onto the pitch
Prasidh to Stokes, no run, short ball around off, Stokes stands tall and defends it into the off side
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, 1 run, tad short around middle and leg, Stokes heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for one
Krunal Pandya to Bairstow, 1 run, quicker one around middle and leg, Bairstow eases it down to long-on for one
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, 1 run, backs away and knocks this flatter delivery into the off side

Krunal Pandya to Stokes, SIX, that's high and certainly handsome! Tossed up delivery by Krunal Pandya, Stokes picks the bones out of this and tonks it over long-on for a massive six. Looked a maximum the moment it left his willow
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, no run, tad short around middle and leg, Stokes knocks it towards mid-on
Krunal Pandya to Bairstow, 1 run, short ball around off, Bairstow punches this through covers for a single
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, 1 run, 77.7kph, on the pads as Bairstow clips this through square leg for one
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, darted on middle and leg, Bairstow nudges this in front of mid-wicket
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, down the leg side as Bairstow works this in front of mid-wicket
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, drifting on the pads as Bairstow clips it in front of mid-wicket. Again a yes-no as they don't risk a run this time around
Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, 1 run, goes down on his knee and slogsweeps this through mid-wicket for one
Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, no run, good amount of flight on this loopy delivery as Stokes guides this back to Kuldeep Yadav
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, 1 run, knocks this tossed up delivery down to long-on for one
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, 2 runs, tossed up delivery outside off, Stokes goes for a drive and gets an outside edge towards third man for a brace
Krunal Pandya to Bairstow, 1 run, tad fuller around middle and leg, Bairstow drives it down to long-on for one
Krunal Pandya to Bairstow, no run, flatter and quicker around off, Bairstow defends this in front of covers
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, 1 run, treks back in his crease and knocks this short delivery down to long-on for one
Krunal Pandya to Stokes, no run, flatter around middle and leg, Stokes nudges this into the leg side
Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, 1 run, rocks back in his crease and bunts this shortish delivery down to long-on as he gets off the mark
Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, no run, tad fuller around off, Stokes pushes this in front of covers

Kuldeep Yadav to Stokes, no run, was a tossed up delivery that came in a touch after pitching. Stokes offers no stroke and given the batsman's reputation, they opt for the review. Pitching outside off, impact outside off and it's missing the off stump by a big margin. India have lost one review

Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, out Roy Run Out!! A superb piece of fielding brings an end to Roy's stay at the crease. India get the much needed breakthrough. Bairstow had flicked this towards mid-wicket where Rohit grabbed it with a dive to his right. A one handed grab and the batsmen were stranded halfway on the pitch. A slight yes-no between them and the non-striker is the one who has to sacrifice his wicket. Pant had ample of time to take down the bails once Rohit had parried the ball at his end. Roy run out (Rohit/Pant) 55(52) [4s-7 6s-1]
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, 2 runs, clips this towards deep square leg and calls for a brace. A better throw at the bowler's end and the non-striker could have been in trouble

Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, SIX, the English openers continue to belt Indian bowlers. Bairstow brings up his fifty in fine fashion as he launches this tossed up delivery right over the bowler's head as the ball goes the distance. Got to the pitch of the delivery and went ahead with his lofted drive to complete a clean strike
Thakur to Bairstow, 1 run, 133.8kph, this might have held onto the pitch and Bairstow is early into his drive. The ball pops up in the air and falls in the vacant mid-on region
Thakur to Roy, 1 run, 114.2kph, off-pace ball, dabbed past backward point for a single
Thakur to Bairstow, 1 run, 130.8kph, short of length, Bairstow walks forward and across before punching it to mid-on's left. Another 100 partnership between Bairstow and Roy
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, fuller than good length, off-stump line, Bairstow pats it to backward point
Thakur to Bairstow, SIX, shot! Strays this fullish ball on the pads and Bairstow superbly picks it up. Whipped over deep square leg. Back-to-back sixes and Thakur will be under pressure..
Thakur to Bairstow, SIX, Bairstow is middling 'em now! Good length, Bairstow stands tall and once again employs the checked lofted on-drive. Hit it straight of long-on on this occasion
Kuldeep Yadav to Roy, no run, defensively pushed to cover
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, 1 run, 83.6kph, full ball, flicked to deep mid-wicket
Kuldeep Yadav to Roy, 1 run, short of length, pulled through backward square leg
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, 1 run, gets down to slogsweep and miscues it to the right of long-on. Hardik takes it on the bounce
Kuldeep Yadav to Roy, 1 run, drilled to long-on

Kuldeep Yadav to Roy, SIX, 19th ODI half-ton for Roy! A big smile on his face. A fullish ball, googly and Roy slugs it over long-on. Hardik jumps but it's just out of his reach. Didn't get it anywhere close to the middle of the bat and he would have had his heart in his mouth for a moment there...
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, fuller length ball, driven to mid-off
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, shorter and just outside off, Bairstow chops it to point off the under edge

Thakur to Bairstow, SIX, 138.8kph, a checked lofted on-drive and he's cleared long-on! Fuller than good length and he didn't go hard at this. A stylish shot and got enough wood to clear the man in the deep - Krunal

Thakur to Bairstow, no run, 132.4kph, wow! This one rears off the deck as it seams away. Bairstow looks to punch on the rise and is beaten on the outside edge. Pant does well to pouch it with a leap to his right
Thakur to Roy, 1 run, 135.9kph, stands tall to tuck this short of length ball and gets a leading edge that goes through cover point
Thakur to Roy, 2 runs, 138.4kph, full and angled in, clipped through mid-wicket
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, 83.3kph, full on leg, Bairstow reverse-sweeps straight to backward point
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, 83.4kph, punched back to the bowler
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, wide, 79.4kph, airy ball down leg, googly, Bairstow misses the sweep and Pant doesn't collect it cleanly. Was mighty close to the batsman's glove
Kuldeep Yadav to Roy, 1 run, 81.9kph, full and on the stumps, Roy crouches low to slog across the line and inside-halves it to deep mid-wicket
Kuldeep Yadav to Roy, no run, 86.8kph, quicker ball that spins in, Roy looks to punch off the back foot and gets an inside edge onto his back pad
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, 1 run, 78.5kph, flighted delivery, fuller and wider, driven down to long-off
Kuldeep Yadav to Roy, 1 run, 82.5kph, leg-stump line, short of length, nudged to square leg off the back foot
Thakur to Roy, 1 run, 133.5kph, full and wide of off, Roy plays an uppish drive through the vacant cover region for a single
Thakur to Bairstow, 1 run, 138.8kph, pitched up delivery, driven all along the carpet to long-on
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, 131.6kph, fuller than good length, defended towards mid-off
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, 133.9kph, fullish ball, knocked to mid-on and the ball goes quickly to the fielder
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, 137.8kph, pitches it up on this occasion, driven off the front foot, can't get it past the Indian captain again
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, 136kph, length ball just outside off, punched firmly from the crease and Kohli throws himself to his left at cover to make an excellent stop
Thakur to Bairstow, wide, 133.9kph, full ball, but Thakur has sprayed this way down the leg-side. Pant has to dive to get to the ball

Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, 1 run, 78.4kph, shorter in length, pitches this one outside leg and Bairstow goes hard on the pull, goes to deep backward square leg on the bounce. Lucky to get away with that delivery
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, 76.8kph, leggie on middle and leg, Bairstow defends it off the inner edge
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, 83.1kph, Bairstow gets down to play the premeditated sweep and misses. A big appeal for lbw, but the impact was well outside off, wasn't turning in enough too
Kuldeep Yadav to Bairstow, no run, 83.2kph, cut hard off the back foot, finds cover point
Kuldeep Yadav to Roy, 1 run, 79.3kph, slower from a shortened length, Roy goes deep in his crease to stab it to long-off
Kuldeep Yadav to Roy, no run, 80.4kph, flighted fullish ball, push-driven to cover off the front foot

Thakur to Bairstow, FOUR, 137.5kph, hint of swing away from the right-hander, but Thakur bowled a bit too short and bit too wide. Bairstow hangs back in his crease to play a cracking back-footed punch through the covers
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, 133.8kph, tighter line and length. On a good length and middle-stump lined, bunted to mid-on
Thakur to Bairstow, FOUR, 134.5kph, short ball, hardly any pace or bounce to trouble the batsman. Bairstow swivel-pulls it powerfully over mid-wicket
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, 131.5kph, shorter and wider, cut hard off the back foot, finds backward point
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, 136.2kph, shuffles across a long way to turn this length ball towards square leg
Thakur to Bairstow, no run, 136.5kph, good length on off and middle, Bairstow gets behind the line and defends it to mid-on
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, no run, 134.3kph, firmly pushed to the left of the bowler
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, no run, stump-to-stump line and that's been knocked back to the bowler
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, 1 run, 131.4kph, Bairstow is on the walk to flick this fullish ball to deep square leg
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, FOUR, edged and four! 133.1kph, poor line from Bhuvneshwar, strays it on the pads and Bairstow tickles it off the inside edge, beats short fine leg's dive to his right
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, 135.3kph, once again Kumar gets the ball to seam in and a shuffling Bairstow misses the glance to wear it high on the pad

Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, 133.2kph, big appeal for lbw, struck down! That looked very close. Seams in from a length and Bairstow ends up playing outside the line as he looked to push/drive through the covers. Got hit on the back leg adjacent to off and ball-tracking shows it to be hitting the top of middle - umpire's call

Prasidh to Roy, FOUR, 137.9kph, not a great ball from Prasidh and Roy pounces. Short and wide outside off, ample width for Roy to free his arms. The right-handed batsman flays the slap up and over cover point. With everyone inside the 30-yard circle, that was an easy shot for Roy
Prasidh to Roy, no run, 139.4kph, hangs back, crouches a bit in an attempt to steer this length ball behind square, can't get it past backward point

Prasidh to Bairstow, 1 run, 138.9kph, fuller length ball, driven to mid-off and Bairstow hares to the other end. Hardik attacks the ball, picks and realeses the ball, but misses the target. Bairstow would have made his ground anyway
Prasidh to Bairstow, no run, punched to mid-off and the batsmen can't steal a single
Prasidh to Bairstow, no run, 140.3kph, very full outside off and Bairstow reaches out to cover-drive, ends up inside-edging it into the on-side
Prasidh to Roy, 1 run, 139.1kph, short ball, pulled in front of square on the leg-side. Deep square leg runs to his left to tidy that up
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, 1 run, 136.3kph, in-angler on middle and leg, worked through backward square leg and Roy will keep the strike
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, no run, 132kph, cuts from the crease but straight to cover
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, no run, 136.7kph, punched to backward point
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, FOUR, four more! 127.8kph, short of length, Roy hangs back and on-punches it straight of mid-on. Shardul gives a chase but he can only escort the ball to the fence
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, FOUR, 135.9kph, dug in short and wide of off, Roy hops and uses the bowler's pace-and-width to his advantage. Periscopes it over the vacant slip region for a one-bounce four
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, wide, 134.8kph, slips one down the leg-side does Bhuvneshwar and it goes past Roy's flick/glance. Pant dives across to his left to pouch it
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, no run, 126.1kph, inswinger, pushed to mid-on

Prasidh to Roy, 1 run, 137.6kph, outswinger, full and well outside off, Roy drives firmly and Kohli times his dive perfectly to his right at extra cover. Saved three runs there did the Indian captain. 13 runs off the over
Prasidh to Roy, no run, 140.6kph, good length delivery outside off, Roy shoulders arms. Good carry-through to the keeper

Prasidh to Roy, FOUR, 135.9kph, Prasidh continues to dole out short stuff and Roy is happy to put it away. Dug in halfway down, the pitch takes off all the venom and Roy gets inside the line before pulling it square of short fine leg
Prasidh to Roy, no run, 138kph, on the shorter side, seams in and skids off the deck and Roy hurriedly pulls, gets an inside edge onto his tummy
Prasidh to Roy, FOUR, 138.2kph, short again, pulled again, four again! This time Roy placed it much squarer. Just above the waist and Roy swivels across before pulling it through square leg
Prasidh to Roy, FOUR, 135kph, harmless short ball, hardly any bounce to trouble the batsman and Roy latches onto it. Waits for the ball, stands tall and authoritatively pulls it through mid-wicket
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, 128kph, skiddy short ball outside off, don't think Bairstow saw that coming. Decides to let it go through to the keeper by dropping his bat and swaying away from it
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, 1 run, strays this in-angler on the pads and Roy glances it to long leg
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, no run, 132.1kph, Bhuvneshwar shortens his length and serves width outside off, slapped hard from the crease and Kohli dives to his right at cover to make a good start
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, 1 run, tucked towards mid-wicket for a quick single after shuffling across

Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, FOUR, 132.9kph, fetches this short one from outside off and pulls it hard and in the gap between mid-on and mid-wicket. Shardul gives a chase but in vain. Rolled his wrists after getting on top of the bounce and he was in total control of his shot
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, 1 run, 128.9kph, walks forward and across to knock a length ball between mid-on and mid-wicket for a sharp single
Prasidh to Bairstow, no run, 135.3kph, very full ball swinging away and Bairstow plays a front-footed drive to mid-off
Prasidh to Bairstow, no run, 144.5kph, pitched up delivery, drilled down the pitch and it hits Prasidh's right boot before deflecting towards cover
Prasidh to Roy, 1 run, 143.4kph, Roy shimmies down the pitch and moves leg-side to bash one through the off-side, toe-ends it to mid-off's left

Prasidh to Roy, FOUR, first boundary of the innings! 140.9kph, full and on the stumps, Roy crouches a bit and caresses the straight drive past the bowler. Superb timing and the quick outfield does the rest
Prasidh to Roy, no run, 138.7kph, fuller and straighter, nudged into the on-side

Prasidh to Roy, no run, in the air ... and safe! 134.6kph, seams away from a back of a length and Roy gets a leading edge as he looks to turn it into the on-side. Fortunately, it falls short of the forward-diving Kohli at cover
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, 1 run, 130.2kph, back of a length, bunted straight to mid-off and the batsmen set off for a risky single. Hardik misses the sticks at the bowler's end and Roy is safe
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, no run, flashes and misses! Bhuvneshwar gets this one to swing away from a short of length and Roy throws his bat for a cut, connects with thin air
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, no run, 131.6kph, Bhuvneshwar pulls his length back by a fraction and Roy finds the man at backward point with his drive

Bhuvneshwar to Roy, no run, 131.8kph, beaten! Fuller than good length, swings in and straightens ever so lightly, Roy goes after it with a push/drive and the ball whizzes past the outside edge. That was mighty close
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, no run, 130kph, another in-curler, Roy jabs at it with no feet movement, off the inner half of the bat and the ball rolls towards mid-wicket
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, no run, 132.1kph, inswinger, Roy looks to knock this length ball towards mid-on/midwicket and gets squared up. A soft leading edge and the ball dies down on the off-side
Prasidh to Roy, 1 run, 135kph, the line is too straight on this short of length ball and Roy helps it on its way to fine leg by flicking it away
Prasidh to Roy, no run, 139.2kph, short of length, punched straight to mid-off
Prasidh to Roy, no run, 140.9kph, Roy leans forward and opens his bat-face to punch, finds point
Prasidh to Roy, no run, 139.4kph, gets forward and meets this length ball with a vertical bat, blocked back to the bowler
Prasidh to Roy, no run, 137.5kph, very full again, curls away a bit on this occasion, driven off the front foot and mid-off is quick to move to his left and stop the single
Prasidh to Roy, no run, 125.8kph, with a slip in place, Prasidh starts with a very full ball, Roy reaches out and goes hard on the drive, miscued to mid-off
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, 135.8kph, good length ball marginally outside off, Bairstow prods forward and towards off before nudging it to mid-wicket
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, 130.5kph, once again there's the forward and across movement from Bairstow, pushes this fullish ball straight to mid-on
Bhuvneshwar to Bairstow, no run, 132.3kph, Bairstow walks forward and across before defending this length ball into the on-side off the top part of the bat
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, 1 run, 131.5kph, inswinger, knocked to mid-on with minimal feet movement for a quick single
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, no run, 127.5kph, flays at this wide-ish short of length ball with a horizontal blade, finds cover
Bhuvneshwar to Roy, 2 runs, 135.1kph, fuller than good length, middle-stump line, Roy pushes at it and inside-edges it through square leg
Topley to Krunal Pandya, 2 runs, slower ball on the pads, wristed away into the gap at deep square leg and they scamper back for the second. India finish on 336!

Topley to Hardik Pandya, out Caught by Roy!! Slower bouncer, wider line and Hardik's pull stroke is skied down to long-off where Roy takes a sharp catch, trekking back a bit. Had to judge this well and he did that. Priceless cameo from Hardik comes to an end. Tell you what, this has been an exceptional 11 deliveries from Topley at the death. Hardik Pandya c Roy b Topley 35(16) [4s-1 6s-4]

Topley to Hardik Pandya, FOUR, Topley didn't miss by much here but that's how cruel the game is. Very full and outside off, width on offer and Hardik blasts the drive past the diving extra cover fielder. Bisected long-off and sweeper cover perfectly
Topley to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, the stock-pace delivery this time, rushes Krunal who is expecting the slower ball. Gets it off the splice towards extra cover where it lands just short of the fielder
Topley to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, slower and shorter, bounces extra and Hardik mistimes the slap-drive to long-off. Great start to the over from Topley
Topley to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, starts with a full toss, nearly a waist-high one, whipped away down to long-on. Just a single
Tom Curran to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, fuller and wider outside off, sliced away to deep backward point
Tom Curran to Krunal Pandya, wide, overdoes the widish line and sprays this away-angler well outside the tramline
Tom Curran to Krunal Pandya, FOUR, smashed over cover! Short of a length, width on offer and Krunal picks his spot. Slaps this over the infield, ensures that it's well wide of long-off. Clean strike
Tom Curran to Krunal Pandya, no run, gets the wide yorker just about right, Krunal can't dig it out and this goes very close to the tramline
Tom Curran to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, slower and shorter outside off, toe-ends the slap down the ground towards long-off

Tom Curran to Hardik Pandya, SIX, brute force from Hardik! Long-off thought he had a chance but this has gone sailing way over his head. Slower ball, short of a length outside off, Hardik still reaches it and flat-bats it with all the power in the world. Excellent hit
Tom Curran to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, very full and wide, drilled away to sweeper cover
Topley to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, slower bouncer outside leg, helped away down to fine leg. Sensational over from Topley! Just 4 off it!
Topley to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, full toss, Hardik miscues the slog to deep mid-wicket. Well short of the fielder

Topley to Hardik Pandya, no run, slower ball, on a shortish length and wide outside off. Pandya tries to slash it away but misses this. The shuffle across early meant that the ump didn't give the wide despite it being outside the tramline
Topley to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, angling into the pads, Pandya whips it away towards deep square leg
Topley to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, fuller and straighter, powered away down the ground towards long-on

Topley to Hardik Pandya, no run, Buttler drops a dolly! What a horror day he is having behind the stumps! Dropped Kohli at a tender stage before and has now put down Hardik. Slower and shortish outside off, the lack of pace deceives Pandya who ends up slicing it uppishly. Was an easy take by Buttler's standards but he ended up parrying it straight up and couldn't get across on the rebound. He'll be gutted, sets really high standards does Buttler
Tom Curran to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, slower ball outside off, shortish, punched away down to long-off

Tom Curran to Pant, out Caught by Roy!! Not sure why this was referred upstairs! Perhaps Roy's confused expression after the catch got the batsmen thinking. Or maybe it's just the trend of controversies that this India-England series has thrown up. Pant sliced this high towards third man, wanted to go over the leg-side but it went off the outside edge and Roy pouched it relatively easily although he tumbled in the end. Just a couple of replays for the third ump to favour the soft signal which was OUT. Ends a match-defining knock from Pant. Pant c Roy b Tom Curran 77(40) [4s-3 6s-7]
Tom Curran to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, pacy low full toss, Pandya looks for that pick up shot, toe-ended towards deep mid-wicket
Tom Curran to Hardik Pandya, SIX, slower ball, shorter and Hardik picks it early. Stands tall and pulls this powerfully. right between deep square leg and deep mid-wicket
Tom Curran to Pant, 1 run, proper wide yorker this time, Pant squeezes it wide of short third man and deep backward point gets across

Tom Curran to Pant, SIX, Pant's one-handed smashes on fire! Curran misses the wide yorker, ends up giving a full toss and it's sliced away over point. All the way. Gee, seems like he doesn't want to use both hands at the moment. Can't blame him too
Sam Curran to Hardik Pandya, no run, swing and a miss! Hardik wanted to send this out of the ground but is way early into the slog, foxed by the slower ball from Curran
Sam Curran to Hardik Pandya, wide, shuffles to and fro early, forcing Curran to go wider with the away-angler, ends up getting it just past the tramline. Buttler isn't happy with the wide call

Sam Curran to Hardik Pandya, SIX, raining sixes here! Curran misses the yorker, feeds a low full toss on the pads and Hardik merrily drop-kicks this over deep backward square leg. Too easy, this is too easy for him

Sam Curran to Pant, 1 run, tries to repeat the stroke, another slot ball that's muscled away one-handed but long-on gets across swiftly and does a fine tag-team effort with long-off to keep the batsmen to just a single. Superb fielding

Sam Curran to Pant, SIX, who wants to use both hands when you can hit them one-handed? Pant is an absolute freak and this shot is incredible. Slot ball alright, but Pant's top hand came off as he launced this straight down the ground. Still comfortably over the ropes. Wowza!
Sam Curran to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, gets the yorker right, leg stump line, squeezed away through square leg

Sam Curran to Hardik Pandya, SIX, a monstrous six first ball for Hardik! This is his zone, and he has the license. Helped by a slower short ball from Curran, sits up nicely and it's muscle-pulled over deep square leg. Went way into the stands
Tom Curran to Pant, 2 runs, fuller and wider outside off, Pant lifts this over extra cover, into the gap and they race back for the second

Tom Curran to Rahul, out Caught by Topley!! Curran strikes an important blow! Clever bowling this, goes for the slower bouncer after a series of yorkers, Rahul wants to pull this over deep square leg but is foxed by the variation. Ends up mistiming it straight down deep square leg's throat. He's unhappy with himself. A fab knock nevertheless, he's put India in pole position for a big late flurry. Rahul c Topley b Tom Curran 108(114) [4s-7 6s-2]
Tom Curran to Pant, 1 run, this is much better from Curran, trying to nail the yorkers and he's getting them fairly alright for the moment. Keeps this very wide of Pant who digs it out through point
Tom Curran to Rahul, 1 run, off stump yorker, well-executed and Rahul jams it out to point where Roy makes a sharp stop

Tom Curran to Pant, 1 run, very full and wide, Pant slices it away through the covers. Sweeper gets around and the batsmen don't take the second run. Rahul wasn't interested. Was an easy two there to be fair but perhaps he is tiring. It's been a hot afternoon
Tom Curran to Rahul, 1 run, in-angling low full toss, whipped away to long-on
Sam Curran to Rahul, 1 run, short ball, cramps Rahul on the pull stroke, off the splice towards the gap at square leg

Sam Curran to Rahul, FOUR, this has been belted away! Full toss, a gift from the younger Curran and Rahul smashes it straight back past the bowler who had to run for cover to protect himself. Long-on has no chance on this outfield
Sam Curran to Pant, 1 run, gets the wide yorker spot on, Pant can only squeeze it towards the point region
Sam Curran to Rahul, 1 run, fuller and outside off, Rahul looks to launch, gets it off the inside half to long-on
Sam Curran to Pant, 1 run, fuller and outside off, drags this off the inner half, towards long-on
Sam Curran to Pant, wide, shortish and very wide outside off, well past the tramline

Sam Curran to Rahul, 1 run, there it is! Fifth ODI ton for Rahul! Out comes that signature celebration of his, covers his ears in jest and gets a good applause from the dressing room. This has been a top knock. Reaches the milestone with a gentle tuck through mid-wicket. He started slowly but has quickly moved through the gears and is now truly back in form after the horror T20I series. Expect him to switch to T20 mode now
Stokes to Rahul, 1 run, slanting in on the hips, tucked away past mid-wicket. Moves to 99
Stokes to Pant, 1 run, angling in on a shorter length, Pant pulls it away hard to deep mid-wicket

Stokes to Pant, SIX, he's making this look too easy! England aren't helping themselves either with the bowling. Mid-off up and yet Stokes goes full, in the slot and Pant launches it over mid-off. Just over the ropes
Stokes to Pant, wide, tries to keep it wide of Pant's reach but ends up spraying well beyond the tramline
Stokes to Rahul, 1 run, fuller and angled into the pads, worked away past mid-wicket
Stokes to Rahul, no run, stifled appeal for a strangle down leg but that came off the pad. Was angling into Rahul who missed the leg glance as this went through to Buttler
Stokes to Rahul, no run, angling in on middle, Rahul pats it back to the bowler

Tom Curran to Pant, FOUR, Pant is toying with the bowling now. Premeditates the paddle scoop, gets inside the line and helps it past the short fine leg fielder. England have a problem here, a big problem. Brings up his 2nd ODI fifty! It's a proper limited-overs knock, ran his singles early and is now starting to tee off

Tom Curran to Pant, SIX, Pant is dealing in sixes here. Gets a half-volley on the pads and this is wristed powerfully over deep square leg. The deep fielder was behind square and Pant placed this precisely
Tom Curran to Pant, wide, slower bouncer but too high and wide, left alone

Tom Curran to Pant, no run, Pant wins the DRS battle again! England thought they had him this time, so did the ump. Sharp bumper from Curran, rushed Pant on the pull and the ball bobbled straight up for Buttler to settle under it. The initial feel was that there was glove but Pant reviewed instantly, and that was a giveaway. Replays confirm that there was a bit of the arm and then helmet, but no bat/glove
Tom Curran to Rahul, 1 run, short of a length again, into the body and Rahul swivel-pulls to deep backward square leg

Tom Curran to Rahul, FOUR, more runs! Curran is under severe pressure here. Tries to overcompensate the length and goes short but it sits up nicely for Rahul. Swivel-pulled. and wide of the fine leg fielder to his left

Tom Curran to Rahul, SIX, a classical Rahul stroke! Gets a wide half-volley and he lofts nonchalantly over cover. All class, pure timing and easily over the ropes. Seems like he's also starting to flip the switch

Stokes to Pant, no run, premeditates the paddle scoop as Stokes goes fuller and just outside leg stump, Pant fails to connect and the ump opts to side with the bowler, and doesn't wide this. Marginal one
Stokes to Rahul, 1 run, fuller and angling into Rahul who push-drives this through mid-on
Stokes to Pant, 1 run, fuller and on the pads, glanced away nicely behind square leg
Stokes to Pant, SIX, back-to-back sixes for Pant! Slower ball from Stokes but it's quite full and Pant picks the variation early, waits and smears it over long-on for a flat maximum
Stokes to Pant, SIX, can't bowl there to Pant, he'll dismantle you. Stokes goes full and on the pads, it's whipped away over backward square leg. Lovely pick up, clears the ropes
Stokes to Rahul, 1 run, very full and outside off, driven crisply through the covers

Tom Curran to Pant, no run, Pant survives! Premeditated the reverse lap but the length was too full and it seemed like he had been rapped on the pad as this sneaked past leg stump and raced away to the fine leg fence. The ump gives in to England's appeal, only for Pant to review it straightaway. Replays show that there was a bit of bottom edge on it and would probably have missed leg stump in anycase. Will be a dot ball as it was given OUT on-field. Pant isn't amused with this but that's the rule
Tom Curran to Pant, no run, swing and a miss! Curran went wider with the away-angler, Pant tries to muscle it over cover but fails to connect
Tom Curran to Rahul, 1 run, angling into the pads, worked gently past mid-wicket
Tom Curran to Pant, 1 run, slower and shorter outside off, Pant smacks the pull but straight to deep mid-wicket

Tom Curran to Pant, FOUR, crunched! Short and wide, asking to be hit and Pant slashes it hard through point. Sweeper was in front of square on the off-side and can't get across in time. Was a free hit of sorts for Pant who went up and over the infield
Tom Curran to Rahul, 1 run, slower ball on the pads, Rahul nudges it softly through mid-wicket and they think about the second run but have to be content with single

Topley to Pant, FOUR, Pant is starting to up the ante now. This is short from Topley but not high enough to threaten Pant who swivels and nails the pull through mid-wicket. The deep fielder was at square leg
Topley to Rahul, 1 run, fuller and on off, Rahul shuffles a bit and wrists this towards mid-on
Topley to Pant, 1 run, shortish and outside off, Pant hangs back and dabs it towards cover. Quick single

Topley to Rahul, leg byes, 1 run, very full and around leg stump, right where Rahul loves it for the pick-up shot but he doesn't connect and deflects this off the pads to short fine leg. He'll know that he's missed out

Topley to Rahul, 2 runs, miscue but clears mid-on comfortably and they snare a brace. Was the off-cutter from Topley, got stuck into the pitch and Rahul couldn't control the pull stroke. Got enough to get it over the infield
Topley to Rahul, no run, shortish and angling across Rahul who stands tall and punches to point

Adil Rashid to Pant, SIX, Pant gets hold of this one and it's dumped over deep mid-wicket. A tad too full from Rashid, tries to keep it wider but the fuller length allows Pant to go through with the slog sweep. Shuffled a tad early and clobbered this
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, loopy leg break outside off, Rahul reaches out and pats it into the gap at cover
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, gives the charge early, allows Rashid to fire it shorter and wider, punched away to sweeper cover
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, quicker one on the pads, whipped away off the back foot to deep square leg
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, just short of long-on! Pant tries to go big downtown, but ends up miscuing the loft. Fortunate that this doesn't go straight to hand
Adil Rashid to Pant, no run, flatter and fuller outside off, jammed back to the bowler
Topley to Pant, 1 run, dug in short and Pant controls the pull well to deep mid-wicket

Topley to Rahul, 1 run, good running! This is shortish and Rahul rises on his toes to dab it gently in front of cover. Quickly called for the run and Pant was electric as he sped across to make it with ease at the danger end. Topley tried a bit of football stuff to hit the stumps but misses. Wouldn't have mattered anyway
Topley to Rahul, no run, angling in from outside off, jabbed from the crease towards point
Topley to Rahul, FOUR, s-m-a-s-h-e-d! Half-tracker from Topley at gentle pace and Rahul doesn't miss out. Rocks back quickly and pummels the pull over mid-wicket. Nearly went all the way
Topley to Pant, 1 run, gives the charge early, forcing Topley to go shorter, nudged towards square leg
Topley to Rahul, 1 run, shortish and outside off, punched off the back foot towards deep point
Adil Rashid to Pant, no run, turning googly, Pant watches it spin across him and through to Buttler
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, low full toss and Rahul has hammered this straight back past the bowler with a lot of power. Long-off is quick though, and gets across to stop it in time
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, speared on leg stump, glanced gently to short fine leg
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, flatter one outside off, a touch shorter and Rahul hangs back to bunt this past Rashid, towards long-off
Adil Rashid to Rahul, no run, more flight this time, wider lines and Rahul checks his shot, back towards Rashid
Adil Rashid to Rahul, no run, fuller and outside off, Rahul reaches out and defends gently to point
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, drifting into the pads, Rahul works it through square leg. Ends Moeen's spell, a very tidy one considering that the pitch has had nothing in it for the spinners
Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, skids through off the deck, leg stump line, nudged to mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, pushed through quicker once more, middle and leg line, knocked gently to mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, flatter and sliding in on leg stump, Rahul tucks it wide of the mid-wicket fielder and they pinch a run
Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, floated wider outside off, Rahul reaches out and taps this to short mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, quicker one, sliding into Pant who nudges this towards short fine leg
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, loopy googly on the pads, Pant nurdles this through mid-wicket and runs the first one hard but Rahul rightly declines the second run
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, tossed up fuller outside off, driven through the covers
