Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, full toss on the pads, wristed away towards deep backward square leg
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, aerial slice but through the gap at cover, towards sweeper. Was on the shorter side and Rahul didn't quite middle the cut as well as he would have liked
Adil Rashid to Rahul, no run, tossed up nicely around middle, Rahul lunges and defends
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, flatter one on the pads, worked away towards square leg
Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, guided back to the bowler by Rahul to end the over

Moeen Ali to Rahul, FOUR, what was Stokes trying to do there? A short ball by Moeen Ali and Rahul has punched it towards covers powerfully. Stokes in his quest to anticipate and grab this, does a blunder and the ball beats him to the fence
Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, slightly short ball around middle and leg, Pant nudges it through the on side for one
Moeen Ali to Pant, no run, dances down the wicket and knocks this tossed up delivery back to the bowler
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, drives this tossed up delivery down to long-on for one
Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, tossed up delivery around off, Rahul gets an inside edge onto his pads as he looks to defend

Adil Rashid to Kohli, out Caught by Buttler!! And our wait for a Kohli century continues.. And once again Rashid gets him! Was on a length around off and Kohli went back in his crease to play the cut shot. A thick outside edge is induced and Buttler doesn't make a mistake this time around. Good knock, nevertheless. Kohli c Buttler b Adil Rashid 66(79) [4s-3 6s-1]
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, slightly short around middle and leg, nudged through mid-wicket
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, a legbreak by Adil Rashid and it has been nudged through the leg side by Kohli for one
Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, lot slower at the off stump and Kohli has defended this in front of point
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, full and wide outsisde off, Rahul drives it through covers for one

Adil Rashid to Rahul, SIX, that's gone the distance! Had to! A tossed up legbreak by Adil Rashid, was bowled on a length. And Rahul shimmies down the wicket to launch it over the bowler's head as he swings his arms
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, tad short around off and Rahul rocks back and puts this into the gap at cover-point as he ends the over with one
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, as easy as you like as Kohli bunts this offbreak past Moeen Ali, an easy run at long-on once again
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 2 runs, short ball by Moeen Ali outside off and Kohli rocks back and slaps it through covers for a couple of runs
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, eased straight down the pitch as Moeen Ali goes full
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, back in his crease to knock this short ball to long-on for one

Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, second fifty of the series for KL Rahul! Raises his bat and has a hand shake with his skipper as soon as he gets there. Was down the track to play this tossed up delivery as he eased it down to long-on

Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, 84.9kph, tad short around middle and leg, Kohli works this in front of mid-wicket as he plays it with a closed bat face. Not pleased with himself for not having played that into a gap
Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, quicker one around off, Kohli knocks it in front of short mid-wicket
Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, short in length around off and Kohli has guided this back to Adil Rashid
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, slices this through point and although the initial call was for a couple of runs, Kohli settles for one, sending his partner back
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, a tossed up legbreak around off and Kohli plays inside out, easing it through mid-off for one
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, driven down to long-off as Kohli is back on strike
Moeen Ali to Kohli, no run, played with the spin as Kohli clips this offbreak in front of square leg
Moeen Ali to Kohli, no run, lot quicker around off and Kohli has guided this back to Moeen Ali
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, knocked into the gap at covers as Moeen Ali goes short
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, slices this through point for a single

Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, 100-run stand up between KL and Virat as the former knocks it straight down the pitch. Runs have come from both the ends and the pair meets halfway to celebrate with a little hand shake and hug
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, a tossed up delivery by Moeen Ali as Kohli eases it down to long-on
Adil Rashid to Rahul, no run, darted on off and Rahul has punched this in front of extra cover
Adil Rashid to Rahul, no run, short ball by Adil Rashid and Rahul guides it down to long-on for one
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, on the batsman's pads as Kohli works it in front of square leg
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, tossed up delivery on a length as Rahul eases it into the gap at covers
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, tossed up delivery around off and it has been pushed in front of covers for a quick run
Adil Rashid to Kohli, SIX, short and punished! A long hop by Adil Rashid and Kohli has pulled it over deep square leg for an authoritative six. That's the first biggie of this match

Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, fifty up for the run-machine! Might not have scored a century since ages, but keeps bringing up these small milestones every now and then. Rocks back in his crease and punches this short delivery to long-on for one
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, tossed up delivery on a full length as Rahul drives it to long-on
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, tad short around middle and leg, Kohli bunts it down to long-on for one
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, an off-break on a full length as Rahul drills this to long-on for one
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, punches this off his back foot through covers for a single
Moeen Ali to Kohli, no run, shimmies down the wicket and nudges this flighted delivery in front of square leg

Adil Rashid to Rahul, FOUR, googly to finish the over! Rahul reads it well, rocks back and places his square cut to perfection. Beats the fielder inside the ring initially and also manages to get this past the fielder who was sprinting across near the fence
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, nicely driven as Adil Rashid offers a legbreak on a full length, it's a single at long-off
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, a lot slower through the air around off, Rahul eases it into the gap at covers
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, full and straight on the batsman's pads as Kohli nudges this into the pocket at mid-wicket
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, reads the googly in time and whip-drives this to long-on for one more
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, tossed up delivery around off, Kohli drives this into the pocket at covers
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, played with soft hands in front of point as he retains strike with a quick single
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, short and quick outside off, Rahul rocks back and steers this through backward point
Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, directed at the middle and leg stump as Rahul guides this back to the bowler
Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, rocks back and cuts this offbreak in front of cover-point who charges forward, grabs the ball and denies them a single
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the ball as Kohli drills this down to long-on
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, short ball spinning into the batsman as Rahul bunts this past the fielder at mid-on
Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, fired on a flat trajectory around off, not much spin as Kohli pats it in front of cover-point
Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, fuller and quicker around off, Kohli defends it off his front foot
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, good amount of flight around off, Rahul drives this through cover-point for one
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, drives this flighted delivery past the bowler and takes a single
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 2 runs, goes back in his crease and works this legbreak through square leg for a couple of runs
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, a short ball by Adil Rashid and it has been knocked down to long-on for one
Moeen Ali to Kohli, no run, spinning down the leg side as Kohli nudges this next to the keeper on the leg side
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, tad short around off, Rahul knocks it into the gap at covers for a single
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, knocks this legbreak down to long-on and gets KL Rahul back on strike
Moeen Ali to Kohli, no run, opens his bat face and glides this in front of point
Moeen Ali to Kohli, no run, nudged in front of short mid-wicket by Kohli
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 2 runs, drives this towards sweeper cover as the fielder in the deep misfields and allows them to take a brace

Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, dropped! Big mistake by Buttler as he has put down a regulation chance. Was a legbreak outside off and Kohli got an outside edge as he attempted a drive. Buttler gets his gloves to it as the ball nutmegs him. How costly is this going to prove?
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, goes inside out and drives this flighted delivery to long-off
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, flighted delivery by Adil Rashid and it has been eased through mid-on by Kohli

Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, rotates the strike with ease as he drives this along the ground to long-on
Moeen Ali to Kohli, no run, shimmies down the wicket to play this, but Moeen Ali goes short and Kohli has to settle with a bunt towards short mid-wicket

Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, played with the spin as Rahul nudges this offbreak in front of mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 2 runs, straying on Rahul's pads as the middle order batsman works it through square leg with soft hands and comes back for the second
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, driven back at Adil Rashid who gets his hand to it with a dive and parries this towards mid-on
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, whip-driven to long-on by Kohli as Adil Rashid goes full with this legbreak
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, good amount of flight on this legbreak as Rahul eases it down to long-on for one
Adil Rashid to Rahul, no run, drives this towards extra cover where it has been stopped with a dive inside the ring
Adil Rashid to Rahul, FOUR, glorious drive! A loopy legbreak around off and Rahul has creamed it through the gap at covers with impeccable timing. 50-run stand up for the third wicket
Adil Rashid to Rahul, no run, quicker delivery around off, Rahul guides it back to Adil Rashid
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, eased down to long-on by Rahul for one
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, tad short around middle and leg, Kohli works it through the leg side for one
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, knocks this shortish delivery down to long-on for a single
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, played with the spin as Kohli works it into the pocket at mid-wicket for a single
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, on the shorter side outside off, Rahul treks back and slices it through point for one
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, walks down the track and drives the offbreak to long-on for a gentle single
Tom Curran to Rahul, no run, back of a length around off, Rahul defends it

Tom Curran to Rahul, 1 run, 129kph, short of a length around middle and leg, Rahul nudges this into the gap at mid-wicket for one
Tom Curran to Rahul, no run, 129.2kph, drifting on the batsman's pads and Rahul has worked it in front of mid-wicket with a closed bat face watchfully

Tom Curran to Rahul, no run, slightly full ball around middle and off, this one straightens off the deck as Rahul ends up getting a leading edge back to the bowler. Almost got squared up there did Rahul
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, on the shorter side around off, Rahul camps back in his crease and knocks this into the gap at covers as he retains strike for the first ball of the next over

Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, loopy delivery around off, Kohli transfers his weight onto the front foot and drives this to long-on
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, short ball around off, Rahul rocks back and punches it to sweeper cover for a single
Tom Curran to Kohli, no run, 129.4kph, length ball around off, defended into the off-side adjacent to the pitch, no single there

Tom Curran to Rahul, 2 runs, good-looking shot! A shortish ball and Rahul short-arm-jabs the pull to the left of deep mid-wicket
Tom Curran to Rahul, no run, 129.3kph, good length delivery, punched from the crease and Roy makes a sliding stop to his right

Tom Curran to Kohli, 1 run, 125kph, Kohli walks forward and across, clips a fullish ball towards square leg and runs the first run hard but he has to settle for a single as the fielder is quick to get to the ball
Stokes to Kohli, 1 run, 134.6kph, dug in short, Kohli gets into a good position and rolls his wrists to play a controlled pull shot to deep mid-wicket. 10 runs off the over
Stokes to Kohli, wide, 133kph, shortish ball just outside leg, Kohli gets inside the line to pull it fine and fails to make contact. Was mighty close to the batsman's glove
Stokes to Rahul, 1 run, 129.7kph, length ball on leg, bunted to mid-on's right for a quick single
Stokes to Kohli, 1 run, 129.6kph, back of a length outside off, steered to third man
Stokes to Rahul, 1 run, 130.9kph, leans across and clips this full ball to mid-wicket

Stokes to Rahul, FOUR, 136.3kph, Stokes fires in a yorker and Rahul has somehow managed to squirt it away. Brought his bat down at the right time and the ball trimmed the outer-and-lower part of the bat before rolling through the gap between the keeper and first slip
Stokes to Kohli, 1 run, 116kph, Stokes tries a slower ball and ends up bowling a high full toss, Kohli is taken aback and ends up tapping it to cover
Tom Curran to Rahul, no run, 130.2kph, in-seamer, Rahul is cramped for room and can only knock it back to Tom Curran
Tom Curran to Rahul, no run, 131kph, length ball that holds its line around off, Rahul taps it into the off-side adjacent to the pitch with a squared up stance
Tom Curran to Kohli, leg byes, 1 run, 128.6kph, short of length, Kohli shuffles and misses the glance, off the pad and it dies down on the leg-side

Tom Curran to Kohli, FOUR, streaky! 130.6kph, Kohli jogs down the pitch and almost gets undone by the inward movement which also had extra bounce. The Indian captain pushed at it with hard hands and got an inside edge that not only eluded the stumps but also beat the keeper comfortably. Dribbles away to fine leg
Tom Curran to Rahul, 1 run, 129.2kph, shorter and straighter, tucked to deep backward square leg
Tom Curran to Rahul, no run, 132.8kph, Rahul walks across before pushing a fullish ball down the pitch
Stokes to Rahul, 1 run, 136.5kph, overpitched outside off, a firm drive to sweeper cover off the front foot follows
Stokes to Rahul, no run, 135.8kph, full and angled in, Rahul gets half-forward and meets it with a straight bat, rolls to mid-on
Stokes to Rahul, no run, 133.4kph, short of a good length, knocked towards mid-on and there's a 'yes-no' situation. Safe!
Stokes to Kohli, 1 run, 134.1kph, steered behind square on the off-side and beats Roy to his left at backward point
Stokes to Rahul, 1 run, surprised short ball, hit the deck hard and got good lift on it did Stokes. Rahul is late on the pull and gets a bit of a top edge that falls in the vacant square leg region
Stokes to Rahul, no run, 137.4kph, full and around off, tapped to backward point with an opened bat-face
Tom Curran to Kohli, no run, 130.4kph, good length delivery, tapped to cover
Tom Curran to Rahul, 1 run, 131.7kph, full and wider outside off, Rahul is on the move (forward) as he drives and outside-edges it to third man
Tom Curran to Rahul, no run, 128.6kph, fuller than good length, off-and-middle-stump line, defended back to the bowler
Tom Curran to Kohli, 1 run, 128.8kph, fuller in length, Kohli walks down a long way and moves across towards off in the process to flick it through backward square leg
Tom Curran to Kohli, no run, 131.3kph, in-angler outside off, left alone
Tom Curran to Kohli, no run, 129.8kph, Kohli leans into a cover-drive against this length ball, off the top part of the bat and it falls short of the cover fielder
Stokes to Kohli, 1 run, 135.1kph, shortish ball, Kohli rides the bounce and taps it towards cover point for a single

Stokes to Kohli, 2 runs, 133.8kph, short ball, Kohli miscues the pull towards wide mid-on as he gets it off the top part of the bat. Curran scores a direct-hit at the bowler's end and the batsmen come back for the second as the ball defletcs away off the stumps
Stokes to Kohli, no run, 137kph, Kohli leans across and plays a good-looking drive against this full-and-wide ball, Roy puts in a full-length dive to his right at backward point to save the run
Stokes to Rahul, 1 run, 135kph, Rahul stays back, waits for the wide-ish length ball and runs it down to third man
Stokes to Rahul, no run, 131.7kph, short of a good length, Rahul hangs back to punch and miscues it to point
Stokes to Rahul, no run, 131.7kph, fuller than good length outside off, a shuffling Rahul shoulders arms
Tom Curran to Kohli, no run, hit-the-deck-hard ball from a good length, left alone on seeing the line outside off. Decked away a bit too
Tom Curran to Kohli, no run, 127.8kph, pitched up, comes in with the angle and Kohli is forward to play the cover-drive, ends up inside-edging it towards mid-on
Tom Curran to Kohli, no run, 129.2kph,, Kohli walks forward and across to defend this length ball on the off-side
Tom Curran to Kohli, no run, good length delivery outside off, good carry-through to the keeper as Kohli shoulders arms
Tom Curran to Kohli, no run, full again, bunted to mid-on

Tom Curran to Kohli, FOUR, 133.7kph, Kohli greets the new bowler with a boundary! Bottom hand power from the Indian skipper. Too full from Tom Curran, Kohli walks forward and across before bringing his wrists into play. Driven firmly and wristily wide of mid-on
Sam Curran to Rahul, no run, 129.2kph, full again, middle-stump line, knocked to mid-on
Sam Curran to Rahul, no run, 129kph, full ball, Rahul gets forward to defend it to cover

Sam Curran to Rohit, out Caught by Adil Rashid!! Oh dear! Sam Curran gets the big fish with a 'hit-me' delivery. A proper half-volley at 129.5kph, it's swinging down leg too. The Indian vice-captain gets inside the line and flicks it away with the swing. But, he's picked the fielder perfectly. Off the face of the bat and Adil Rashid moves to his right at short fine leg. to gobble it up. He could have hit it anywhere behind square, found the fielder instead. Lucky breakthrough for England and they have removed both the Indian openers. Rohit c Adil Rashid b Sam Curran 25(25) [4s-5]
Sam Curran to Kohli, 1 run, shorter in length, Kohli dabs it wide of backward point and Roy makes a good stop to his left

Sam Curran to Kohli, no run, 129.7kph, beaten! Lands on a good length and goes away with the angle around the fourth-fifth stump channel, Kohli expects it to come in on his defensive but the ball whizzes past his outside edge
Sam Curran to Kohli, no run, 126.9kph, short of length, Kohli tucks it to short fine leg and gets rightly sent back by his batting partner
Topley to Rohit, no run, a fullish ball on the stumps and that's been bunted towards mid-on

Topley to Rohit, FOUR, third boundary of the over! A venom-less short ball at 135.6kph and Rohit plays one of his pet shots - the front-footed pull shot over mid-wicket. An authoritative stroke, couple of bounces and into the fence
Topley to Rohit, no run, 136.1kph, goes full and the line is wider, Rohit drives neatly off the front foot but straight to cover

Topley to Rohit, FOUR, 132.4kph, shorter and wider. Another hit-me ball and Rohit takes heavy toll of it. Rocks back in his crease and cracks the cut in front of backward point beating the fielder's dive to his right. Bullets away
Topley to Rohit, no run, 134.6kph, goes for the yorker, no swing now and Rohit toe-ends the push to mid-off

Topley to Rohit, FOUR, 132.4kph, poor ball from Reece Topley. A half-volley on the pads and it's easy pickings for the right-hander. Rohit waits for the ball and flicks it with the swing over square leg for a one-bounce four
Sam Curran to Kohli, no run, 127.6kph, pitched up ball, no movement on this occasion and Kohli fences it to cover
Sam Curran to Rohit, 1 run, 132.1kph, full and outside off, eased through the covers. India decide against the second

Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, 130.7kph, inswinger from a good length, Rohit didn't expect the ball to move in so much. Luckily gets his bat down at the right time and inside-halves the block into the on-side
Sam Curran to Kohli, 1 run, 132kph, leg-stump line, fullish length and Kohli wrists it to mid-wicket
Sam Curran to Kohli, FOUR, 131.9kph, inswinger, but Curran errs with his line. A fullish ball on the pads and Kohli easily glances it fine and sends it to the fine leg fence. First boundary for Kohli
Sam Curran to Kohli, no run, back of a length, Kohli moves back and across to stoutly defend it out

Topley to Rohit, FOUR, first freebie from Topley and Rohit doesn't need second invitations to put it away. A low full toss outside off and Rohit reaches out before flaying it through cover point. Speeds away to the fence
Topley to Rohit, no run, 129.6kph, Rohit is beaten on the inside edge again as he misses the glance against another inswinger. Clearly heading down leg

Topley to Rohit, no run, 136.7kph, fuller than good length, Rohit misses the flick and gets hit on the pad. A big appeal for lbw and England give a thought before deciding against the review. It pitched outside leg and was swinging down the leg-side
Topley to Rohit, no run, 129.1kph, full and slanted across around the fifth stump channel, Rohit decides to let it go at the last moment

Topley to Kohli, 1 run, 134.7kph, yorker, don't think Kohli saw that coming. He was hanging back in his crease but the Indian captain brings his bat down at the right time to squirt it out to backward square leg
Topley to Kohli, no run, 129kph, extra bounce from a length, Kohli moves back and across, hops and drops it into the pitch
Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, 119.1kph, slower ball to cap off the over, Rohit defends with an opened bat-face and backward point is quick to get to the ball
Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, 128.8kph, closer to off from a fullish length and that's been driven straight to cover
Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, 131.7kph, play-and-a-miss! Fuller than good length, angled across the right-hander, Rohit plays this one outside his body for a push and is lucky not to get a nick on it
Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, 132.3kph, defends this full ball to cover
Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, 130.1kph, pitched up delivery, pushed to cover
Sam Curran to Rohit, FOUR, 127.5kph, hint of inswing, but it's overpitched and the Indian opener latches onto it. Rohit gets half-forward and plays a superb straight drive. No one's stopping that
Topley to Kohli, no run, 134.6kph, extra bounce from a length and a shuffling Kohli blunts it adjacent to the pitch on the on-side

Topley to Dhawan, out Caught by Stokes!! Edged and gone! The pressure was built and Dhawan succumbs. 133.6kph, pitched up ball that swings away outside off, Dhawan chases it for a big drive away from his body and gets a thick outside edge. Stokes snaffles it to his right at second slip. England have the early breakthrough. Dhawan c Stokes b Topley 4(17)
Topley to Dhawan, wide, fuller in length, too wide outside off and that's been wided
Topley to Dhawan, no run, on a length and wide of off, left alone

Topley to Dhawan, no run, 131.9kph, short of length, skids off the deck and nips away a bit, Dhawan stays leg-side of the ball and tentatively pokes his bat at it before pulling it back in. Good ball, that
Topley to Dhawan, no run, 132.9kph, sees the line outside off on this length ball and flashes his bat hard for a cut, gets beaten by the extra bounce
Topley to Rohit, 1 run, 131.1kph, shortish ball, Rohit plays a one-legged uppish ball that goes to deep backward square leg on the bounce
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, 127.9kph, pitched up ball that swings away a bit, Dhawan is watchful in his defensive push to cover
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, 130.7kph, full on off, defended back to the bowler

Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, 132.9kph, Dhawan shimmies down the pitch and gets into a tangle as Curran had dropped his length short. Adjusts in the end and fend it into the leg-side off the top part of the bat
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, 127.5kph, Curran pulls his length back and gets it to jag away outside off, no stroke offered
Sam Curran to Rohit, 1 run, 127.6kph, full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket
Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, 127.5kph, pitched up outside off, push-driven to mid-off off the front foot
Topley to Dhawan, no run, 134.8kph, touch too full and Topley gets away with it as Dhawan wrists it straight to mid-on
Topley to Rohit, 1 run, 128.1kph, there's the awkward bounce from a length, Rohit hurriedly blunts this rib-lined ball towards backward square leg for a single
Topley to Dhawan, 1 run, 134.1kph, overpitched outside off, Dhawan cracks the drive off the front foot and the man at cover makes a half-stop diving to his left
Topley to Dhawan, no run, 129.3kph, Topley is getting good lift here. Slightly moves leg-side does Dhawan and lifts his bat up on seeing the line outside off on this length ball
Topley to Dhawan, no run, on a good length, Dhawan lets it on line and Buttler pouches it above his head
Topley to Dhawan, no run, 123.2kph, full and angled in, swings away late outside off and there's good carry-through to the keeper too as Dhawan shoulders arms

Sam Curran to Dhawan, 3 runs, 126.5kph, pitched up outside off, Dhawan gets forward and push-drives through extra cover. Two fielders chase and the man running from cover (Malan) slides and flicks it back towards Moeen Ali save a run
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, 129.9kph, Curran persists with the full length, bowls this further wide, just inside the tramline and Dhawan offers no shot
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, 127.9kph, further full, curls away outside off and Dhawan shoulders arms
Sam Curran to Dhawan, no run, 125.2kph, gets this full ball to swing away outside off and Dhawan plays inside the line to let it go
Sam Curran to Rohit, 1 run, 126.7kph, too straight on this occasion, leg-lined and Rohit gets off the mark by glancing it through square leg
Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, Sam Curran starts with a fullish ball around off, hint of inward movement, Rohit is half-forward to defend it out

T Natarajan to Sam Curran, no run, very full, clubbed down the ground to Hardik at long-on, and what was going to be a comfortabe win for India has turned out to be a surprising win for India! What a phenomenal game we've witnessed today to seal off this series...
T Natarajan to Sam Curran, FOUR, it's overpitched, wide, and that's drilled flat over the covers for four! No matter, India need to bowl a legal ball to win...
T Natarajan to Sam Curran, no run, errs with a full-toss, slapped down the ground to Kohli at long-off, and he's denied the single.
T Natarajan to Sam Curran, no run, full, into the blockhole, Sam Curran squeezes this out towards long-on and denies the single. 12 off 3 now.
T Natarajan to Topley, 1 run, full and outside off, Topley pushes it away in front of square on the off-side for a single

T Natarajan to Sam Curran, out Mark Wood Run Out!! 1 run completed. It's a run-out! It's been referred, but it's out! Natarajan gets it into the blockhole, that's drilled down to long-on, Curran slips at the non-striker's end turning back for the second and Wood is already half way back, has to change directions and dive, but the throw from Pandya is too good. Pant whips off the bails and Wood is short of his ground. Hardik redeems himself yet again. Mark Wood run out (Hardik Pandya/Pant) 14(21) [4s-1]
Hardik Pandya to Sam Curran, 1 run, good length ball on off-stump, tapped on the head towards point for a single
Hardik Pandya to Sam Curran, no run, good length ball, pace off, Sam Curran gets across and decides to push it back towards the bowler

Hardik Pandya to Sam Curran, 2 runs, two consecutive drops! He's gotten across to lap it over square leg, a top-edge towards long-stop, three fielders converging and Natarajan drops it this time! What are India doing?

Hardik Pandya to Mark Wood, 1 run, Shardul has dropped it! That's a disaster! A short ball into the body, Mark Wood has top-edge this towards long-on and Shardul is pedalling backwards, drops it! Hands on Indian heads...
Hardik Pandya to Sam Curran, 1 run, good length ball on off-stump, tapped on the head towards backward point, a misfield from Krishna and they've taken the single now! Curran off strike!
Hardik Pandya to Sam Curran, no run, follows him into the on-side, and that's a cramped defence off the backfoot

Bhuvneshwar to Mark Wood, no run, back of a length ball outside off, Mark Wood defends inside the line and lets it pass. He's played out Bhuvi, and now, it's Curran up against Natarajan and perhaps Hardik.

Bhuvneshwar to Mark Wood, no run, Given out LBW! It's been referred by England. On a back of a length and seaming in, Mark Wood is beaten on the inside edge, and he's struck very high. Nothing on Ultra-Edge. Ball-tracking: pitching outside off, impact in line, wickets missing! That decision has to be reversed. Just sneaking over the leg-stump...
Bhuvneshwar to Sam Curran, 1 run, picks this from a length outside off and slaps this down the ground towards long-on for a single, as Hardik pulls this back in. Chaotic running from England...
Bhuvneshwar to Sam Curran, no run, slower one just outside off-stump, tapped on the head towards point
Bhuvneshwar to Sam Curran, wide, wide down the leg-side this time, and India are falling apart here. An absolute meltdown.
Bhuvneshwar to Sam Curran, wide, far too wide outside off, and that's been called...
Bhuvneshwar to Sam Curran, no run, down the leg-side, Sam Curran misses the glance and gets some pad on it, through to Pant - a stifled appeal, but the umpire is unmoved
Bhuvneshwar to Mark Wood, 1 run, slaps this from a length to sweeper cover for one, and it's Curran back on strike...

Thakur to Sam Curran, FOUR, he's nailed it! Overpitches and that's launched over the in-field towards the wide long-off fence for four! Bang in the middle of three converging fielders and away to the boundary! 18 off the over and this could be costly for India!

Thakur to Sam Curran, 2 runs, slaps a slower short one to deep extra cover for a couple, good work by Dhawan in the deep, and throws it at the non-striker's end, a dive from Wood and he's made it easily...

Thakur to Sam Curran, SIX, England are charging at the business end of this game! He's picked up the change of pace, far too many variations now, and that's been carted over long-on for a gigantic six! This is now the highest score by a No. 8 against India.
Thakur to Sam Curran, no run, short and wide, slapped away hard towards deep extra cover and he's denied the single!
Thakur to Sam Curran, FOUR, full-toss, a bit of width, Sam Curran crunches this with a potent bottom-hand towards deep extra cover for four! India: Panic mode, ON!
Thakur to Sam Curran, 2 runs, off-cutter on a good length, a bit of width on offer, Sam Curran slaps it down to wide long-off for a couple

Hardik Pandya to Sam Curran, 1 run, a hip-high full-toss, that's a top-edge on the pull, and that's in the air towards midwicket, the fielder is running in, and that's fallen short of him! Now I know superstitions don't exist, but could this just be Curran's day?

Hardik Pandya to Sam Curran, FOUR, that's nearly in the blockhole, but he's been made to pay for that error! Gets deep in the crease and swats this wristily away, getting expertly under it and maneuvering it to deep square leg for four!
Hardik Pandya to Sam Curran, no run, short ball, pace off, and that's pulled down towards cow corner - single denied
Hardik Pandya to Sam Curran, no run, lofts another full one down to long-on, on the bounce, and KL collects once again
Hardik Pandya to Sam Curran, 2 runs, lofts a full one down the ground to long-on, where Rahul dives and cuts off a certain boundary, saving a couple of crucial runs for his side
Hardik Pandya to Sam Curran, no run, nearly gets this in the blockhole, and that's swatted away towards midwicket - can't get it past the in-field

Thakur to Buttler, out Lbw!! Loud shout for LBW, this looks close and India will review. Was there an inside edge on that? Buttler was caught in the crease to one that nipped back in. Think it's missed the inside edge, UltraEdge in and it confirms that there's no bat. Onto ball-tracking now - three REDS and Buttler is OUT. This could be a decisive blow for the hosts - the England captain looked so good, but his stay has been cut short. On a good length and nipping back into the right-hander, Buttler was pushing forward and is beaten on the inside edge. The impact was in front of middle and leg, was going on and crashing into the leg-stump. Sam Curran to Hardik Pandya, FOUR, slow, short and four, back of a length and well wide of off, Hardik waits on it and then chops it behind square on the off-side, no one in the deep and it's another boundary
Sam Curran to Hardik Pandya, wide, Curran overcooks and angles this one way down leg, called as a wide, the third of the over
Sam Curran to Hardik Pandya, wide, the bouncer from Curran, but it's short and way over Hardik's head, called as a wide
Sam Curran to Hardik Pandya, no run, short of a length and angling across the right-hander, steered straight to the fielder at backward point
Sam Curran to Hardik Pandya, wide, that's a dangerous delivery from Curran, with the man in the ring, short and angling down leg, Hardik shuffled across on the pull and missed, called as a wide
Sam Curran to Pant, 1 run, short of a length and just outside off, worked wide of mid-wicket for a single
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, dropped short and just outside off, pulled away past mid-wicket for a single
Adil Rashid to Pant, 2 runs, this is excellent batting and running by the Indians - played with soft hands as he turned it to mid-wicket and they scamper back for the second

Adil Rashid to Pant, 2 runs, nicely played, Rashid drifts one on Pant's pads, played with soft hands and he always wanted the second, Hardik Pandya was quick to respond and the thriow was at his end, but he got home with ease

Adil Rashid to Pant, SIX, massive, the wrong 'un and Pant spotted it early, came down the pitch, got close to the ball and then lifts it high and back over the bowler's head, went sailing over the sightscreen for a maximum
Adil Rashid to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, short of long-on, was the wide leg-break and Hardik was looking to lift it back over the bowler's head, almost dragged it down long-on's throat
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, tossed up from round the wicket, worked in front of square on the on-side for a single
Sam Curran to Hardik Pandya, no run, shortish but the line is outside off, Pandya was in a terrible position and avoids it

Sam Curran to Hardik Pandya, FOUR, 129kph, Curran going shorter and down leg upon seeing Pandya shuffling. Would've been a wide but Pandya wanted more. Gets top edge on the pull and sends it past short fine leg
Sam Curran to Pant, 1 run, gets inside the line and whisks it towards square leg
Sam Curran to Pant, no run, slower delivery just outside off, Pant dabs it to point, thought about a run but Pandya said no
Sam Curran to Pant, FOUR, 10/10 for placement from Pant. This was fuller, very pacy and Pant walks into a proper whip across the line and bisects deep mid-wicket and deep square leg with aplomb
Sam Curran to Pant, no run, shorter outside off, Pant gets his weight back and punches it to cover
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, little flatter, worked away to deep mid-wicket
Adil Rashid to Pant, no run, slower and Pant judges the turn before blocking it under his eyes
Adil Rashid to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, turning back in, flicked to square leg
Adil Rashid to Hardik Pandya, no run, slider, zips after pitching. Eased back to the bowler
Adil Rashid to Hardik Pandya, no run, more air from Rashid, Pandya watchfully comes forward to smother it
Adil Rashid to Hardik Pandya, no run, wrong 'un, spinning back in. Pandya is back to nullify it
Topley to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, slower short ball, Pandya gets some top-edge on the pull to deep mid-wicket
Topley to Hardik Pandya, no run, Topley digs this slower ball into the pitch from round the stumps, Pandya podders and checks it back to Topley
Topley to Pant, 1 run, banged in short, Pant swivels, rolls his wrists into this pull to fine leg
Topley to Pant, no run, 132.3kph, full and homing in, turned to mid-wicket
Topley to Pant, no run, slower delivery from Topley, Pant waits and defends it to mid-wicket
Topley to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, wide yorker from Topley, Pandya angles his bat to third man after opening the face
Adil Rashid to Pant, no run, googly, pitched on middle and turns away, Pant carefully blocks

Adil Rashid to Pant, SIX, very fittingly, Pant brings up his fifty in his style. His third in ODIs. Up goes the bat, a few applauses from the dug-out and a congratulatory message from Pandya. The usual tossie from Rashid which Pant wants to club it out of the park. Kneels entirely with his weight down and wallops it over cow corner
Adil Rashid to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, 86.3kph, drifting away outside off, Pandya creates some space and eases it through cover
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, googly outside off, Pant reads it and turns it to square leg
Adil Rashid to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, in a bid to flight the ball, Rashid overpitches outside off. Crisply driven to long-off
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, flipper from Rashid just outside off, Pant gets across and knocks it to mid-wicket

Topley to Hardik Pandya, no run, cutter from round the wicket, shot up out of nowhere to befuddle Pandya, who was first surprised by the bounce and then loosens his grip to fend it into the off-side via his gloves, quite awkwardly
Topley to Pant, 1 run, whipped away to long-on
Topley to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, length, dropped to covers
Topley to Hardik Pandya, FOUR, short, asking for trouble and Pandya's slapped it past point. Pivots back, opens his bat face and the timing is impeccable
Topley to Pant, 1 run, 129.3kph, straying on the legs of Pant, politely glanced away behind square
Topley to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, driven away to sweeper cover

Livingstone to Pant, no run, a near chance but Livingstone didn't pick it at all. Fired flat and quick outside off, Pant stayed in his crease and chipped it back as it gave an impression of stopping on the pitch. Livingstone was prematurely moving to his left, didn't anticipate at all while the ball was coming back at him. Hangs his right leg, but too late.. Livingstone presents a sheepish smile, but he at least made the stop as the ball bounced in front of him
Livingstone to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, well-flighted, flicked away to long-on
Livingstone to Hardik Pandya, no run, spinning away outside off, soft-handed tap to point

Livingstone to Hardik Pandya, FOUR, this is too good batting. Just playing to the merit. Was the leg-break from Livingstone, so much of width on it that Pandya telegraphed his intentions early. Went deep and nails it between point and short third man
Livingstone to Hardik Pandya, 2 runs, short and quicker outside off, Pandya cuts it to the right of point. The fielder couldn't stop it cleanly and they'll pinch the second
Livingstone to Pant, 1 run, drifting on the pads, wristed to square leg

Moeen Ali to Hardik Pandya, SIX, Pant and Pandya are turning the heat back on the England spinners. Ali's figures being dented in this over. 20 off it. Normal off-break, the length's too full and Pandya lowers his stance to hack it over deep square leg
Moeen Ali to Hardik Pandya, SIX, second six of the over. So, Pandya's decided he'll change gears? Ali planting it right in the arc that Pandya craves for; fully loaded up and smoked over cow corner
Moeen Ali to Hardik Pandya, no run, turning in straighter, wristed to mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, arrowed on leg, Pant thrusts his bat forward and bunts it to mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, Ali pulls his length back, worked with the spin through mid-wicket

Moeen Ali to Hardik Pandya, SIX, Pandya says even I am up for it. Luringly tossed up just outside off, Pandya with a clean swing of the arms dumps it straight down the ground. So smooth, so clinical and so easy
Livingstone to Pant, no run, slanted in with the arm on leg-stump, Pant misses it after crouching. Struck on the pad
Livingstone to Pant, no run, flighted delivery outside off, Pant camps back and deep, hits this a tad on the rise in front of the extra cover fielder
Livingstone to Pant, no run, thrashes it to extra cover
Livingstone to Pant, FOUR, this is just bashed over extra cover. Livingstone bowling it too quick, giving the pace Pant wanted.. absolutely decimated

Livingstone to Pant, SIX, one-handed brilliance from Pant. The consistency in which he pulls it off is simply staggering. Here he is again, marching down the track and getting deceived in the flight, was in no position but gave it everything and lost his bottom hand. Gues where the ball has landed? A few empty rows back over long-off. Livingstone is stunned..
Livingstone to Pant, no run, quicker from Livingstone, Pant using his feet again to blunt it
Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, slow but short, Pant uses his wrists to maneuver it away to deep mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Pant, no run, dances out, taps it back to the bowler
Moeen Ali to Pant, no run, angled in quicker, Pant allows it to arrive and jabs it to mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, closes the bat-face and threads the gap by clipping it away behind square
Moeen Ali to Hardik Pandya, no run, stays back to counter this off-break and turns it to square leg
Moeen Ali to Hardik Pandya, no run, nice, loopy off-break, Pandya defends
Livingstone to Pant, no run, marginally overpitches outside off, leaning drive to extra cover
Livingstone to Pant, no run, so, he's bowling the offies to the Southpaw. Rifles on off, quelled
Livingstone to Hardik Pandya, 1 run, 86kph, pitches on off. Pandya settles into a forward block
Livingstone to Hardik Pandya, no run, on the stumps, blocked

Livingstone to Rahul, out Caught by Moeen Ali!! That's a horrible ball and it has fetched Livingstone his maiden ODI wicket. He won't complain and so will England. Change in bowling working magic for the visitors. Ballooned up and it turns out to be a low full toss down leg, Rahul couldn't hit it anywhere he wanted. But instead, goes down and ends up sweeping it to short fine leg where Moeen puts in the dive and pouches it. India lose another in-form batter. Just seen the replays, Rahul's one hand came off the handle as he went too hard on the stroke. Rahul c Moeen Ali b Livingstone 7(18)
Livingstone to Pant, 1 run, too short outside off, Pant bottom-hands the drill towards deep extra cover
Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, ventures down and gets yorked, jams the drive past the bowler to long-off
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, floater now from Ali, Rahul is happy to ease it down to long-on for a single
Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, darted in with the angle, helped away along the ground to deep mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Pant, no run, tosses from round the stumps, Pant inches forward in solid defence
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, fired in quicker, whipped to long-on

Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, "Catch" was the shout, Sam Curran at deep mid-wicket charged in but it just drops a couple of metres short of him. Dangerous heave from Pant, not getting to the pitch and dragging it uppishly off the bottom
Adil Rashid to Rahul, no run, overpitches at 85.2kph, Rahul finds the fielder at extra cover with a push-drive
Adil Rashid to Rahul, no run, flighted nicely, driven back
Adil Rashid to Rahul, no run, slowish, Rahul keeps it out
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, works it away into the leg-side
Adil Rashid to Pant, FOUR, the Pant scoop. Slower and turning in, Pant premeditated it, skates low and takes his eyes off after lapping it over the keeper. How do you place a fielder there?
Adil Rashid to Pant, wide, Rashid's lost his line and bowls it down leg

Adil Rashid to Pant, FOUR, what was that from Pant? Yes, he's known to play some outrageous shots but nothing points that he was fully in control of this. Leg-stump leg-break, Pant went deep and closed his bat face early in aiming for the whippage. Somehow manages to place it in the gap at deep square leg
Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, chips down the track to negate the turn and tickles it to mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, too flat from Ali, knocked down to long-on
Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, flat, whippy-swat to deep mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Pant, no run, 89.3kph, arm-ball just outside off. Pant half-bends and dabs it to point
Moeen Ali to Pant, no run, goes round the stumps and keeps it tight, defended to the left of the bowler
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, spinning back in, Rahul opens up and forces it through cover

Adil Rashid to Pant, SIX, Pant doing Pant things. This is just how he plays. The situation doesn't bother him much. When he thinks it's in the zone, will go for it. Rashid tosses the leg-break above the eye-line, Pant loading some power and muscularly launching it over long-on
Adil Rashid to Pant, 2 runs, a rare loose delivery from Rashid. Gives too much of air but the line is down leg. Pant kneels down and paddles it fine. Two fielders give chase and Pant will get two
Adil Rashid to Pant, no run, dart, straighter. Tucked to the left of mid-wicket
Adil Rashid to Pant, no run, wrong 'un (85.9kph), Pant respects by getting back and smothering it
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, tosses it enticingly outside off, Rahul leans across and cracks the drive to the right of sweeper cover
Adil Rashid to Rahul, no run, slides it on leg, Rahul misses the flick and wears it on the pad
Moeen Ali to Rahul, 1 run, straightening just outside off, Rahul comes forward and opens his bat face to direct it towards backward point
Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, he's mixing his line and lengths so cleverly is Ali, once more pat down the pitch
Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, some drift for Ali at 90.9kph, Rahul plays it back to the bowler
Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, shorter, Rahul stays back and punches it to Ali
Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, turns in this off-break, clipped to mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, 89.7kph, down the track comes Pant and softly parks it at mid-wicket
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, leggie, turning in. Pant steps aside and wrists it to deep square leg
Adil Rashid to Pant, no run, skidding on, Pant hangs back and gently checks it to extra cover
Adil Rashid to Pant, 2 runs, googly just outside off, Pant jumps deep and cuts it square on the off-side, big gap there and will pick up two
Adil Rashid to Rahul, 1 run, flatter, Rahul pushes it to cover who misfields and gives away a single
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, loopy delivery on the pads at 80.9kph, picked away behind square
Adil Rashid to Pant, no run, flighted, Pant displays a closed-bat face nurdle to mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, sits back and nudges this to mid-on
Moeen Ali to Rahul, no run, flings in more quicker with the arm, Rahul defends

Moeen Ali to Kohli, out Bowled!! Castled! Huge, huge blow for India. Kohli wears the same reaction on his face when he was dismissed in Chepauk not too long ago, coincidentally by Ali only. So from 103/0, India have slipped to 121/3. England's spin-twins bringing them back into the game. Wasn't a ripper by any means; just a floaty off-break which spun back in from outside off, Kohli went back and made too much of room for himself to get into a tangle. Gets cramped for room in trying to punch it through the off-side and it pings the leg-stump. What a wicket for England. Kohli b Moeen Ali 7(10) [4s-1]
Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, worked to mid-wicket
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, slower and Kohli uses his feet to power it back using his magical wrists. Pant comes in the way and the deflection rolls dribbles away to long-on
Moeen Ali to Pant, 1 run, a fluent forward press and dinks to covers
Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, lunges into the toss-up and deadbats this into the wicket
Adil Rashid to Pant, 1 run, overspinner on middle, Pant hangs back and whips it away towards deep square leg for a single

Adil Rashid to Dhawan, out Caught&Bowled! That's as soft as it can get. That was very full, Dhawan was down the wicket to whip it away into the on-side, but ends up merely chipping it back towards the bowler, who throws himself to his left to pick up a return catch amidst his followthrough. The two well-set men are gone, and India are quickly forfeiting the advantage of a solid platform. Dhawan c and b Adil Rashid 67(56) [4s-10]
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, 2 runs, spins down the leg-side, Dhawan works it away towards fine leg for a couple
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 1 run, tossed up outside off, Kohli reaches out and whip-drives a slice square of the wicket for a single
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, 1 run, short and wide, a rank half-tracker, spared by Dhawan as he slaps it to sweeper cover for just a single
Moeen Ali to Kohli, no run, gets leg-side of the ball and pushes this towards cover with the spin
Moeen Ali to Kohli, no run, zips through outside off, Kohli stays low and steers this with an open face towards point
Moeen Ali to Dhawan, 1 run, skids through low from middle towards leg, Dhawan gets back and whips it away towards square leg for a single
Moeen Ali to Kohli, 1 run, down the wicket and worked away towards backward square leg for one
Moeen Ali to Kohli, no run, spins back in from a shorter length, hurries through a little, punched off the backfoot towards mid-on
Moeen Ali to Dhawan, 1 run, onto the thigh, tucked away off the backfoot to backward square leg for one
Adil Rashid to Kohli, no run, Kohli goes leg-side of the ball and whip-drives it back to the bowler with the turn
Adil Rashid to Kohli, 3 wides, angling down and hurrying down the leg-side, Kohli misses the paddle, Buttler misses, and that's down the leg-side for a treble of wides
Adil Rashid to Kohli, FOUR, not particularly short, skids through towards the thighs, Kohli rocks back and whips his wrists through the pull, gets it away to the backward square leg fence for four

Adil Rashid to Rohit, out Bowled! He's been outdone by the googly! Definitely didn't read this one from the hands, got forward, the open face and and the general away-momentum of the hands suggest that he was playing for the leg-break, and as a result, it sneaked through the gap between bat and pad to crash into the stumps. That's the end of Rohit Sharma for the day, and the Indian top-order's problems against Rashid continue. Rohit b Adil Rashid 37(37) [4s-6]
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, 1 run, works this off the legs to deep mid-wicket for one
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, 2 runs, dropped short, Dhawan rocks back and pulls this away towards backward square leg for two

Adil Rashid to Dhawan, no run, given not out, and England are reviewing this LBW call. Nothing on UltraEdge as Dhawan misses the glance off the frontfoot. Ball tracking: pitching outside leg, and England lose their review. NOT OUT it is.
Stokes to Dhawan, 1 run, checks a fuller ball down towards mid-off for a quick single, and that brings up the century stand between these two!
Stokes to Rohit, 1 run, defends this off a good length spot into the off-side and they scamper through for a quick single
Stokes to Dhawan, 1 run, clips this off the pads to deep mid-wicket for one
Stokes to Dhawan, FOUR, short and wide, Dhawan absolutely murders this, cutting it away through deep backward point fence for four
Stokes to Rohit, 1 run, glides this short of length one down to third man for a single
Stokes to Rohit, no run, good length ball on middle and off, Rohit gets forward and defends
Adil Rashid to Rohit, 1 run, stays back and works this one to mid-wicket for a single
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, 1 run, gets forward and defends this towards point for one

Adil Rashid to Dhawan, FOUR, a tad short, Dhawan rocks back and pummels this with a pull towards deep square leg for four. That's his fifty, off just 44 balls, his 32nd half-century in ODI cricket, and he raises his bat to the dressing room...
Adil Rashid to Rohit, 1 run, sits up from a length, Rohit stays low and slaps it away towards sweeper cover for one
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, 1 run, googly, a little short, Dhawan whips it away off the backfoot towards square leg for a single
Adil Rashid to Dhawan, no run, zips through from outside leg, Dhawan tries to work it into the on-side, misses, gets it off the pads into the on-side. Big appeal, but pitching outside leg
Stokes to Rohit, FOUR, short and wide, and that's hammered away with a cut to third man for four. India turning it up here!
Stokes to Dhawan, 1 run, short ball, and that's been pulled away towards deep mid-wicket for a single
Stokes to Dhawan, no run, taps a back of a length ball on the head towards cover point
Stokes to Dhawan, wide, far too short, and that's been called a wide as it flies over Dhawan
Stokes to Rohit, 1 run, short, doesn't rise a lot, and that's pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single
Stokes to Dhawan, 1 run, back of a length ball on the pads, worked away to backward square leg for a single
Stokes to Dhawan, no run, good length ball on off-stump, Dhawan defends off the backfoot
Mark Wood to Rohit, FOUR, short of length ball with some width, 139.5, Wood falling over again, Rohit taps it late on the head and glides it down to third man for four
Mark Wood to Dhawan, 1 run, 140ks, short ball, Dhawan flamingo-pulls this down towards cow corner for a single
Mark Wood to Dhawan, no run, good length ball on off, Dhawan defends off a half-cock towards mid-off. Mark Wood falls over. What else is new?
Mark Wood to Dhawan, no run, short ball, Dhawan arches back and allows it to go through...
Mark Wood to Dhawan, FOUR, banged in short from the round the wicket angle, into the hip, and that's a short-arm pull to deep mid-wicket for four
Mark Wood to Dhawan, 2 runs, rides the bounce and glides a bumper down to square third man for a couple
Stokes to Dhawan, 1 run, short of length ball, no width again, Dhawan runs it down late to third man for one
Stokes to Dhawan, no run, short of length ball on the hip, Dhawan tries tucking it away off the backfoot, only manages to fend it into the wicket
Stokes to Rohit, 1 run, banged in short, Rohit pulls this one down to deep square leg for a single
Stokes to Dhawan, 1 run, seams away with the angle from a good length, trapping Dhawan on the backfoot, and inducing an outside edge that goes through the vacant cordon for a single towards third man
Stokes to Dhawan, no run, short of length ball without width, Dhawan tries to create some and cut it away, ends up getting an under-edge to Buttler, nearly chopping onto the stumps
Stokes to Rohit, 1 run, back of a length ball outside off, Rohit pokes and steers it away towards third man for one

Mark Wood to Dhawan, 2 runs, good length ball on the pads, 141.4km/h, worked away off the pads towards deep midwicket, Liam Livingstone does some good work diving across and pulling that in, the umpires are checking if he's made contact with the boundary whilst in contact with the ball, and looks like he hasn't - looks like he's saved his team a couple of runs with his athleticism...
Mark Wood to Rohit, 1 run, taps a skidder just outside off on the head to short third man for one
Mark Wood to Dhawan, 1 run, 143.6km/h good length ball on middle and off, Dhawan taps this late towards mid-off and takes off for a sharp single
Mark Wood to Dhawan, no run, fuller length and wide outside off, Dhawan drives this towards cover point, but not with the best timing, and it's been cut off with a dive
Mark Wood to Dhawan, no run, short of length ball at 139.5km/h, zero width, Dhawan is forced to hop and drop it into the wicket

Mark Wood to Dhawan, FOUR, the runs are starting to flow now! Not the widest delivery, a back of a length ball, Dhawan uses those monster forearms and creams that through deep backward point for four! CRUNCH!
Topley to Rohit, FOUR, nailed the timing on this one too! A tad too full on the pads, Rohit pounces on this and whips it away to deep mid-wicket for four
Topley to Dhawan, 1 run, back of a length ball on the thigh, worked away towards mid-wicket for a quick single

Topley to Dhawan, FOUR, SHOT - OF - THE - DAY (T&C apply). A half-volley, alright, but Dhawan leans in and checks a drive between mid-off and short cover for four. Nailed the timing on that, and not a soul moved before it reached the fence
Topley to Dhawan, FOUR, pad-lined rubbish from Topley, Dhawan clips it away towards backward square leg for four. Bonus.
Topley to Dhawan, no run, steers this length ball with an open face towards backward point

Topley to Dhawan, FOUR, intent or recklessness? He's not moved his feet much, but throws his hands at a fullish wide one, gets it off the toe and just over short cover to the sweeper cover fence for four
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, good length ball on off-stump, 142.5km/h, Rohit stays back and defends from the crease - that's a maiden to begin with for Wood
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, 140.5km/h, stays low from a length just outside off, Rohit crouches to cut it away square of the wicket, but that slides under his bat through to the 'keeper
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, 144.3km/h, very full delivery on middle and leg, Rohit check-wrists this away towards mid-on
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, 140.3km/h, not as much width as he thought, tried to run a skiddy length ball down to third man, but the attempted tap on the head go an under-edge towards the keeper
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, 139.9km/h, a bit of swing away, very full, but far too wide, and Rohit shoulders arms
Mark Wood to Rohit, no run, full and wide outside off, 139.7km/h, Rohit reaches out and drives it towards short cover, as the fielder moves to his right to cut it off
Topley to Dhawan, no run, charges a short of length ball and slashes it towards point, but can't get it through

Topley to Dhawan, no run, seams back in from a good length outside off, Dhawan gets across to drive through mid-off, but the inward movement ensures an inside edge into the pad and it rolls down the wicket
Topley to Dhawan, no run, short of length ball just outside off, a hop and a tap on the head into the off-side
Topley to Dhawan, no run, good length ball on middle, Dhawan stands his ground and defends it right back
Topley to Dhawan, no run, jagging away off the seam, but pitched a little too wide outside off, Dhawan leaves this alone
Topley to Dhawan, wide, a bit of swing away, far too wide outside off-stump, and Dhawan shoulders arms. Wide called by the umpire...
Topley to Dhawan, FOUR, short, not particularly wide, but wide enough - uses his wrists and finds the gap between backward point and cover point to deep backward point for four
Sam Curran to Dhawan, 1 run, turns this away off the legs towards backward square leg for a single

Sam Curran to Dhawan, FOUR, uh oh! What happened there? Short and wide, slipped out of his hand, Dhawan reached out for the cut, perhaps didn't need to, airbrone at some point, and got it over a leaping Malan at cover point for four
Sam Curran to Rohit, 1 run, back of a length ball on the thigh, worked late towards mid-wicket for a quick single
Sam Curran to Rohit, wide, short ball, but that's soaring over his head, and that's been called a wide
Sam Curran to Rohit, no run, good length ball just outside off, angling away, Rohit gets forward and defends compactly
Sam Curran to Rohit, FOUR, angling into the pads, and that's clipped away with nonchalance to the deep mid-wicket boundary for four. Effortless stuff from Rohit Sharma.

Sam Curran to Rohit, FOUR, oh that's been bludgeoned! An overpitched ball with width, Rohit gets room to free his arms in his arc, and swings through the line, flat over mid-off and away to the long-off fence for a one-bounce four
Topley to Dhawan, no run, that's a beauty! Seams away from a back of a length, and beats Dhawan's backfoot defensive on the outside edge
Topley to Dhawan, FOUR, fuller but he's sprayed it down leg, Dhawan gets some bat on the glance and deflects it away to the fine leg fence for four
Topley to Dhawan, no run, short of length ball in the channel, Dhawan shoulders arms
Topley to Dhawan, no run, a bit of seam away from off-stump, after pitching on a good length, and that's fended with an open face towards cover point
Topley to Rohit, leg byes, 1 run, back of a length and into the hip, a swivel pull with the front-leg up down to fine leg for one
Topley to Rohit, no run, pitching outside leg and going onto the pads, skidding through, Rohit is late on the glance and misses, struck high on the thigh, big appeal, but far too high

Matt Henry to Kohli, out Caught by Phillips!! Gone now. India in serious trouble. You can't do that Phillips. You just can't. He gets up and wears a big smile on his face. Shell-shocked fans in the crowd - mostly Indians. They are trying to process what just happened. DK on air just before this ball called Phillips the best fielder in the world and this is an out of the world catch at backward point. Better than the one he took against Pakistan? That's for you to decide. It's cut hard and flat and the ball is absolutely flying to his right, he picks it late and with an outstretched right hand grabs it even as he is horizontal to the ground. And the ball stays intact even when he goes to ground. You need special skills to take a catch like that. The look on Kohli's face when he saw the catch being taken was priceless. Absolute shock on his face. Replays show that Phillips caught it clean and was airborne - a cameraman's delight, for him to capture that. Unreal catch. Kohli c Phillips b Matt Henry 11(14) [4s-2]
