Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, cuts the legbreak off the back foot and can't pierce the ring on the off-side
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, worked off the back foot to the right of mid-wicket

Sandakan to Dhawan, FOUR, it's getting bad to worse for Sri Lanka! Dhawan steps out and drives the full delivery towards mid-on, the fielder puts in a dive and deflects the ball off his palm into the fence. There was pace on the delivery but a well-timed dive could have been ideal for Sri Lanka, wasn't to be...
Sandakan to Dhawan, no run, tucked off the back foot to the left of mid-wicket
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, 1 run, fraction short on the stumps, Pandey goes on the back foot and pulls it to the right of deep mid-wicket

Sandakan to Manish Pandey, FOUR, this guy has the wrists of a Jos Buttler! Makes room on the off-side, sees the ball dipping on a fuller length and gives it a proper whip of the wrists on the drive wide of mid-off. Proper bottom hand biff...
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, SIX, typical Manish Pandey! Waltzes out of his crease, gets closer to the pitch of the delivery and slams it clean over long-off for an 83-metre maximum
Sandakan to Dhawan, 1 run, flighted outside off, Dhawan strides across and drives it down to long-off
Hasaranga to Dhawan, 1 run, gets across and works the quicker delivery wide of mid-wicket
Hasaranga to Dhawan, no run, googly on off-stump, Dhawan hangs back and drops it with soft hands on the off-side
Hasaranga to Dhawan, no run, too full on the stumps, squeezed back to the bowler
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, 1 run, touch fuller outside off, Pandey lunges across and drives to long-off
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, floated up outside off, Pandey drives and can't beat the gap at cover

Hasaranga to Dhawan, 1 run, fifty for the Indian skipper! It's his 33rd in ODIs and he gets there with a gentle tuck on the leg-side. A warm round of applause from the dressing room and Dhawan acknowledges it with a raise of the bat
Karunaratne to Dhawan, 1 run, swivels on this short ball and plays the pull to the right of deep square

Karunaratne to Dhawan, FOUR, a bit of luck for Dhawan, but he won't mind that! Goes hard at a short and wide delivery and chops it off the thick inside edge that bounces once before flying to the left of the keeper. The fielder at fine leg puts in a dive but ends up parrying it into the ropes...

Karunaratne to Dhawan, FOUR, plenty of width outside off and Dhawan doesn't miss out! Transfers his weight onto the back foot and slashes it past backward point beating the diving effort of Sandakan in the deep
Karunaratne to Manish Pandey, 1 run, 133ks back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot to the left of sweeper cover
Karunaratne to Dhawan, 1 run, the slower short ball outside off, Dhawan plays the ramp and gets it to the right of square third man
Karunaratne to Dhawan, no run, length ball angling away outside off, Dhawan cuts and finds backward point. 7th dot in a row
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, allows the googly to spin in and hurriedly jabs it to the right of mid-wicket. A maiden over and it's the first of the innings
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, full delivery on off-stump, Pandey lunges across and blocks it to cover
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, spinning away outside off, punched off the back foot to the left of cover
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, quicker and wider of off, cut away to the left of backward point
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, floated full on the stumps, driven to the left of the bowler
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, looped up on the stumps, Pandey restrains his instincts on the drive and ends up chipping it to the left of the bowler
Karunaratne to Manish Pandey, 1 run, uses the pace and width on this 137ks short of length delivery to guide a single down to third man
Karunaratne to Dhawan, 1 run, 125ks short ball outside off, Dhawan gets on his toes and steers it with an open face down to third man
Karunaratne to Manish Pandey, 1 run, 129ks goes short and angles it into the body, Pandey swivels on the pull and gets it to the right of deep mid-wicket
Karunaratne to Dhawan, 1 run, short of length wide of off, chopped away behind point for an easy single
Karunaratne to Dhawan, no run, full outside off, Dhawan checks his drive to the right of cover. Pushed it with an open face and didn't go full-throttle on the shot
Karunaratne to Manish Pandey, 1 run, digs it short outside off, Pandey opens the bat face and glides a single fine of third man
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, 1 run, drops it short outside off, Pandey cuts and gets it to deep backward point for a strike-retaining single
Hasaranga to Dhawan, 1 run, Dhawan misses out on a low full toss. Goes for the slogsweep but hits it a lot squarer than he would have wanted, on the bounce to the fielder at deep backward square
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, 1 run, well flighted outside off, Pandey flat-bats the drive to the left of sweeper cover
Hasaranga to Dhawan, 1 run, allows the ball to spin in and works it off his pads to the left of square leg
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, 1 run, stays leg-side of the loopy legbreak and drives it along the ground to wide long-off
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, floaty full delivery on the stumps, Pandey flicks and finds the man at mid-wicket
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, 1 run, knocks the full toss down to long-on
Sandakan to Dhawan, 1 run, cuts this to sweeper cover
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, 1 run, punches down to long-on
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, wide, flighted up down leg, Pandey misses out on the paddle-swat
Sandakan to Dhawan, 1 run, drifting in on leg, nudges it through midwicket
Sandakan to Dhawan, no run, crouches low and late-cuts to backward point
Sandakan to Dhawan, 2 runs, clips it through midwicket with Sandakan pushes it through the air
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, doesn't pick the googly. He's back in the crease as the ball turns in and strikes him on the pad. Comfortably missing leg
Hasaranga to Dhawan, 1 run, taps this wide of cover for a single
Hasaranga to Dhawan, no run, a bit short at the stumps, Dhawan pulls gently to midwicket
Hasaranga to Dhawan, 2 runs, full toss outside off, driven to sweeper cover
Hasaranga to Dhawan, no run, pushed through flat on off, Dhawan dabs it towards backward point

Hasaranga to Dhawan, no run, A review, surely? Dhawan goes for it after being given out LBW. Just looked like there was quite a bit of turn on this leg-break, might be missing leg. He's on the front foot as well. We'll find out soon enough. Flighted up on middle, ripping in past the inside edge and striking him on the pad. It's missing leg stump. Hasaranga's joy shortlived
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, no run, overpitched outside off, driven to cover

Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, out Caught by M Bhanuka!! Good length ball turning away outside off, Kishan is drawn forward looking to defend but feathers it behind. Well pouched by Bhanuka. Kishan's belligerent knock on debut comes to an end. Really high on entertainment value. But Sandakan finally has his man. Has bowled well today so far. Ishan Kishan c M Bhanuka b Sandakan 59(42) [4s-8 6s-2]
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, no run, almost gets too close to the pitch here and jams it back to the bowler after stepping out
Sandakan to Dhawan, 3 runs, a bit short outside off, Dhawan chops it fine. Hasaranga gives chase and pulls it inside the boundary
Sandakan to Dhawan, no run, looks to knock it into the off-side, anticipating turn but it slides on to catch him on the thick inside edge that rolls towards midwicket
Sandakan to Dhawan, no run, flighted up outside off, driven to cover
Hasaranga to Ishan Kishan, no run, finds backward square again as he sweeps
Hasaranga to Dhawan, 1 run, pulled to deep midwicket
Hasaranga to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, full toss on leg, sweeps to backward square
Hasaranga to Ishan Kishan, 2 runs, overpitched outside off, hammers it down the ground and long-on somehow manages to get across and save the boundary
Hasaranga to Dhawan, 1 run, clips it with the turn through square leg
Hasaranga to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, punches off the back foot to long-on
Sandakan to Dhawan, 2 runs, converts it into a full toss with his use of feet and flicks wide of mid-on. Wanted a third but was sent back
Sandakan to Dhawan, no run, cuts it to backward point
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, length ball snaking in, might've been the googly, Kishan hurriedly turns it through midwicket
Sandakan to Dhawan, 1 run, drifting in on leg, Dhawan nudges it into the on-side
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, driven to long-off
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, wide, almost spooked by Kishan's initial press, throws it well wide outside off. Kishan lets it go
Sandakan to Dhawan, 1 run, flighted up, Dhawan pushes to long-off
Asalanka to Dhawan, 1 run, sliding in on middle and leg, Dhawan clips it through square leg
Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, down the pitch to smack it to long-off
Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, FOUR, now he has fifty on ODI debut, as he did on his T20I debut. Rocks back in the crease and pulls over midwicket
Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, FOUR, there he goes, taking the spinner on again and putting him to the sword. Smokes it through extra cover
Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, no run, shimmiies down, realises he's not to the pitch and defends
Asalanka to Dhawan, 1 run, cuts this through to deep point
Asalanka to Dhawan, wide, sliding down leg, Dhawan looks to paddle-swat it fine but misses
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, no run, length ball pushed through on off, Kishan defends
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, FOUR, smokes the drive through extra cover. Sandakan flights it up outside off but it's too full. Captain having a chat with him
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, no run, tossed up outside off, Kishan slog-sweeps to mid-on
Sandakan to Dhawan, 1 run, flighted up outside off, driven to sweeper cover
Sandakan to Dhawan, no run, nudges it to cover
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, plays with the turn through the covers
Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, pushes down to long-off

Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, SIX, tipped over the ropes by Chameera! He was pedalling back at the long-on boundary, wasn't on the ropes to begin with. Might have made the difference here, although the boundaries are long so the fielders might feel obliged to come in a bit. Kishan steps out to the pitch and can't get underneath it well enough as he swings down the ground. Chameera, right back at the ropes or not, should've taken it. He got both hands over his head, got to the ball but failed to hold on
Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, no run, another shimmy but this time he's nowhere near the pitch with the length being pulled back. Manages to keep it out in defence
Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, 2 runs, shortens the length outside off, turning away, Kishan steers it past backward point
Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, FOUR, shimmies down briskly, gets a full toss and whacks it over the bowler's head
Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, no run, sliding in with the arm, Kishan defends forward
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, length ball turning away wide, driven through to sweeper cover
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, no run, a bit short, skidding through on Kishan who gets the pull high on the bat and spoons it in the air. Goes on the bounce to mid-on
Sandakan to Dhawan, 1 run, flighted up outside off, eased down to long-off
Sandakan to Dhawan, no run, punches wide of cover who makes a good stop running to his right
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, length ball turning away wide of off, chopped through the covers
Sandakan to Dhawan, 1 run, tossed up outside off, driven with the turn to sweeper cover
Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, no run, length ball skidding through outside off, steered to point
Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, no run, turned to midwicket in defence
Asalanka to Ishan Kishan, no run, 85kph, length ball outside off that turns very slightly, Kishan defends to cover
Asalanka to Dhawan, 1 run, a bit short at the stumps, helps the pull to deep backward square
Asalanka to Dhawan, no run, sliding in from a length, Dhawan punches down the pitch
Asalanka to Dhawan, no run, drifting in around off from round the wicket, spins away from a length and Dhawan defends forward
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, no run, a bit short outside off, Kishan slaps it to backward point
Sandakan to Dhawan, 1 run, driven down to long-off as Sandakan flights it up
Sandakan to Dhawan, no run, plays it to cover
Sandakan to Dhawan, no run, length ball sliding through just outside off, Dhawan defends from a crouched position with his back knee on the ground
Sandakan to Dhawan, no run, diving stop at short cover to deny Dhawan
Sandakan to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, flat on off, turning away from back of a length, Kishan punches wide of mid-on
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, back of a length on middle, steers it to backward point
Chameera to Ishan Kishan, leg byes, 1 run, back of a length on leg, goes off the thigh pad behind square
Chameera to Ishan Kishan, wide, another bouncer and another wide, this one probably for height with Kishan not getting close with his attempted pull
Chameera to Ishan Kishan, wide, short down leg, misses the pull
Chameera to Dhawan, 1 run, short outside off, late-cuts it to third man
Chameera to Dhawan, wide, good length delivery down leg, Dhawan tries whipping it away but misses
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, short of length on middle, blocked
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, beaten on the outside edge, dangling the bat away from the body with the angle leaving him
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, back of a length on leg, strikes Dhawan on the pad as he misses the clip
Dhananjaya de Silva to Ishan Kishan, FOUR, takes it on the full and whips it over midwicket. A hat-trick of fours to finish the over as India continue to rocket along
Dhananjaya de Silva to Ishan Kishan, FOUR, bludgeoned through mid-on. Another quick shimmy, hard hands through the line of the ball and managing to keep it down this time

Dhananjaya de Silva to Ishan Kishan, FOUR, slices it in the air, the fielder runs to his left at long-off, puts in the dive but can't get to it. Kishan is not messing around that's for sure. A little shimmy to the pitch, goes really hard down the ground but gets it off the outside half. Lucky there
Dhananjaya de Silva to Ishan Kishan, no run, slidies in with the arm, snaking past the inside edge and onto back leg. Was going down leg as the appeal is turned down
Dhananjaya de Silva to Ishan Kishan, no run, looks to slog again but gets a thick inside edge onto pad
Dhananjaya de Silva to Ishan Kishan, no run, flighted up outside off, Kishan mistimes the slog to mid-on
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, cuts this to backward point
Chameera to Dhawan, 2 runs, short into Dhawan, pulls it away wide of long leg

Chameera to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, balloons up off Kishan's gloves, over the keeper's reach. Was hurried by the short ball as he tried taking it on. Deflects off the gloves, the keeper leaps but it's over him
Chameera to Ishan Kishan, no run, lets this short ball go as he collapses on his knees
Chameera to Dhawan, 1 run, back of a length on leg, clips it to long leg
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, back of a length delivery across off, beats Dhawan on the outside edge with him going half-heartedly after it
Dhananjaya de Silva to Ishan Kishan, no run, disappointed with himself for drilling this straight back to Dhananjaya. Was overpitched and Kishan wanted to dish out more punishment
Dhananjaya de Silva to Ishan Kishan, FOUR, Dhananjaya fires this full and wide, perhaps anticipating another charge but Kishan reaches out for it and drills it through point
Dhananjaya de Silva to Ishan Kishan, SIX, box-office stuff. Ishan Kishan charges out first ball and clobbers it down the ground. Don't think he got all of it, but the swing of the bat was vicious

Dhananjaya de Silva to Prithvi Shaw, out Caught by Avishka Fernando!! First ball from Dhananjaya to Shaw and he gets rid of him! All of Sri Lanka heaving a sigh of relief as the move works like a treat. Shaw tries taking him on without having a look, but he's done in the flight here. It lands shorter than anticipated as he looks to slog through midwicket. Top hand almost comes off and he slices it to long-on. Prithvi Shaw c Avishka Fernando b Dhananjaya de Silva 43(24) [4s-9]
Dhananjaya de Silva to Dhawan, 1 run, into midlde and leg, Dhawan nudges it behind square
Dhananjaya de Silva to Dhawan, no run, skidding in from round the wicket, Dhawan defends forward

Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, leg byes, FOUR, tries ducking under the short ball but is hit on the helmet. The neck protector was ripped out on impact and went flying past the stumps. Physio is out for the concussion test as per protocol. Shaw looks fine

Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, oh goodness. This is mesmerising batting. Back of a length just outside off, can't fault Chameera with this but Shaw stands and delivers. Smokes the back foot punch through cover
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, no run, driven on the up but for once it's not in the gap
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, no run, digs it short, Shaw happy to get under it. This is probably how he'll tackle it when it's dug in
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, tries a slower one but it disappears all the same. Right in the slot for Shaw, way too full, and he drives neatly through extra cover
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, no run, ducks underneath the bouncer
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, back of a length across off, taps it into the extra cover region for a single
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, no run, short and wide again, misses out this time as he mistimes the slap to cover
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, now this is timing and power. The ball deserved punishment and rest assured Shaw meted it out. Short and wide, slaps it over cover

Udana to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, oh the way it goes off his bat. The magic of timing. Good length across off, Shaw opens the face and guides it, just guides it through point and it races across the outfield after finding the gap
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, already a bit of an exhibition he's put on. Quality strokeplay. Full delivery across off, Shaw leans into it and drives gorgeously through extra cover
Udana to Dhawan, 1 run, short outside off, Dhawan late-cuts to third man
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, no run, short of length outside off, belted to short cover. Got away with that, Chameera
Chameera to Dhawan, 1 run, short of length delivery across off, chopped down to third man
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, 3 runs, back of a length on middle, Shaw clips it through square leg. Long chase for the fielder, enough time for three
Chameera to Dhawan, 1 run, short of length across off, Dhawan looks to punch through the off-side but drags it off a thick inside edge down to fine leg
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, lets it go just outside off

Chameera to Dhawan, FOUR, now Dhawan. That's the fifth boundary of the innings in 13 balls. Full toss outside off, driven away through the covers. Actually he just opened the face to find the gap, the timing did the rest
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, keeps peppering the boundaries. And the bowlers aren't helping themselves. Straying too straight, clips it through midwicket
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, no run, back of a length, Shaw looks to clip it away but misses and is struck on the pad. Was pitching outside leg so no danger there
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, no run, back of a length on off, blocked down the pitch from the crease
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, no run, slanting away wide outside off, Shaw leaves it alone
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, 2 runs, just can't get it right at the moment. Straying on the hips, clipped wide of long leg and back for two
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, wide, down the leg-side for the third wide in four attempts
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, back of a length on leg stump, Shaw shuffles across and glances it away fine for four. Poor start from Udana
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, wide, a wide outside off now as Udana angles it too far across. Shaw was tempted to chase after it but seemed to withdraw
Udana to Prithvi Shaw, wide, bit of swing back in, but it's down leg
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, back of a length on middle, blocked down at his feet, playing late from the crease
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, yorker length outside off, beats Dhawan as he tries to squeeze it away
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, one slip gone out already. Chameera changes tack, bowls straighter and Shaw gets it down to fine leg
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, last one through extra cover, this one through point. Flashes it away for four. Short and wide, Shaw's timing brilliant again as he cuts it away

Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, and he's away with one of those crisp punches off the back foot. Back of a length just outside off, and he doesn't need much width does he. Such lovely hands, superb timing
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, no run, back of a length around middle, turns it to midwicket

Bhuvneshwar to Chameera, out Chameera Run Out!! A run-out to finish the innings as Sri Lanka manage to post a formidable total. Bhuvneshwar nails his yorker this time around and Chameera jams it back to the bowler. They decide to go for the run, but Bhuvneshwar collects the ball and calmly has an underarm direct-hit at his end with Chameera no where in the frame. Chameera run out (Bhuvneshwar) 13(7) [4s-1 6s-1]
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 1 run, full and wide outside off, Karunaratne plays a flashy drive through cover-point for a single

Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, SIX, what a superb shot! Bhuvneshwar misses out on his yorker, bowls a low full toss and Karunaratne has whipped it over deep mid-wicket for the second successive maxmum of the over. Looks a formidable score all of a sudden

Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, SIX, crucial runs for Sri Lanka! 250 up! A length delivery by Bhuvneshwar and Karunaratne has bludgeoned it over long-on where he manages to clear the fielder stationed near the boundary

Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 2 runs, very full ball by Bhuvneshwar, almost a yorker and Karunaratne jams it out in front of long-on for a couple of runs. The fielder fired a throw at the bowler's end, but it wasn't a great one as it sailed over the stumps
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, FOUR, low full toss by Bhuvneshwar and Karunaratne has managed to clear Chahal at square leg as he executes his uppish flick and gets four runs

Hardik Pandya to Chameera, 2 runs, heaves this towards deep square leg as the ball drops in front of the fielder who dives in front of him, but Pandey does well to back up and collect the ball. Gets rid of it soon as well, however, Chameera is quick to sprint back for the second run

Hardik Pandya to Chameera, no run, slower bouncer by Hardik Pandya, Chameera is very early in shot as he tries to pull it, but the ball comes off the helmet and flies towards short third man. He had no clue where the ball was and had left his crease, but the fielder staioned at short third man decides not to go for a throw at the batsman's end as there was no one backing up. The physio is out in the middle to have a check on Chameera who is good to go

Hardik Pandya to Chameera, SIX, this is even better! Another short ball by Hardik Pandya, allows the batsman to go deep back in his crease as Chameera hammers the pull over deep mid-wicket for half-a-dozen. That'll make him feel a lot better and he can probably take this confidence when he comes out to bowl

Hardik Pandya to Chameera, FOUR, much needed boundary for Sri Lanka! A short of a length delivery by Hardik Pandya and this ball slides onto the bat nicely. Chameera rocks back in his crease and pulls it into the vacant mid-wicket region for four runs
Hardik Pandya to Karunaratne, 1 run, another cutter by HP as Karunaratne heaves it into the leg side as he reads the lack of pace slightly late
Hardik Pandya to Karunaratne, no run, slower delivery by Hardik Pandya, Karunaratne looks to swipe through the leg side, and gets hit on the pad
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 1 run, slower one outside off, slightly full and Karunaratne has sliced this over point as the ball drops in front of the man who was charging in from the deep
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 2 runs, fired into the blockhole by Bhuvneshwar and Karunaratne has squeezed it towards wide mid-on as they manage to take a coupe of runs more
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 2 runs, worked in front of square leg and by the time the fielder could get there, they call for the second and complete it

Bhuvneshwar to Chameera, 1 run, short of a length around middle and leg, this ball seams into the batsman as Chameera tries to punch it off his back foot and gets an inside edge towards the left side of the keeper
Bhuvneshwar to Chameera, no run, back of a length outside off, Chameera rocks back and knocks it into the off side
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 1 run, good length delivery outside off and Karunaratne has sliced this through cover-point for one
Hardik Pandya to Karunaratne, 1 run, worked off his hips through the on-side for a single to end the over

Hardik Pandya to Udana, out Caught by Chahar!! Hardik Pandya gets Udana with a slower delivery. Looks to go big against the length ball and completely mistimes his lofted drive. Chahar at deep mid-on settles under the skier and takes it. That's Sri Lanka's eighth wicket down. Udana c Chahar b Hardik Pandya 8(9)
Hardik Pandya to Karunaratne, 1 run, short ball by Hardik Pandya and Karunaratne has pulled this to fine leg on one bounce
Hardik Pandya to Udana, 1 run, banged into the pitch by Hardik Pandya and Udana has tucked it into the on-side for one
Hardik Pandya to Karunaratne, 1 run, 132kph, short in length and Karunaratne works it into the pocket at mid-wicket with a closed bat face
Hardik Pandya to Udana, 1 run, 134.9kph, short of a length around off, Udana taps this in front of point and scampers across to the bowler's end
Bhuvneshwar to Udana, 1 run, goes full does Bhuvneshwar and Udana has chipped this to long-on as he retains strike
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 1 run, heaved through mid-wicket by Karunaratne for a single
Bhuvneshwar to Udana, 3 runs, short ball by Bhuvneshwar, Udana pulls it over mid-wicket and just manages to clear Chahal who then sprints back and stops it with a slide in the deep
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 1 run, clipped through the on-side by Karunaratne for a single
Bhuvneshwar to Udana, 1 run, drives the full ball to mid-off, takes on the fielder's arm and completes a quick run before the bails at the bowler's end were dislodged due to a direct-hit
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 1 run, good length delivery around off, Karunaratne eases it to mid-off for a single
Hardik Pandya to Udana, no run, ends the over with a bouncer as Udana ducks for cover
Hardik Pandya to Karunaratne, 1 run, slower length ball by Hardik Pandya and it has been nudged towards mid-on by Karunaratne
Hardik Pandya to Udana, 1 run, pushed into the pocket at cover by Udana for a single
Hardik Pandya to Karunaratne, 1 run, short ball by Hardik Pandya and Karunaratne has pulled this towards deep mid-wicket on a bounce or two
Hardik Pandya to Karunaratne, no run, slower one by Hardik Pandya, and off-cutter on a full length and Karunaratne defends it off his front foot
Hardik Pandya to Karunaratne, leg byes, 2 runs, drifting down the leg side as the ball tickles Karunaratne's thigh pad and rolls towards fine leg
Chahal to Udana, no run, floated on off and Udana has driven this towards cover

Chahal to Shanaka, out Caught by Hardik Pandya!! Another one bites the dust! Chahal gets the big fish in his last over of the innings. A tossed up legbreak by the spinner and Avishka chips it straight to the fielder at cover as it comes off the splice of his willow. Chameera to Chahar, no run, tries another cute dab, gets another soft outside edge, but the keeper will cut this off

Hasaranga to Chahar, no run, it's a dot. It's a one-run over. And incredibly, it's a moral victory to the Indians. They've played him out, and Chahar's kept out a googly, rocking back in his crease and punching it out to cover

Rajitha to Chahar, 1 run, 131.4kph, yorker. Dug out to long-on. 49, and the lone torchbearer of India's hopes ..

Picked up Prithvi Shaw first and now gets the much-needed wicket of Krunal to deliver the final nail in the coffin? Sri Lanka can't lose it from here, surely. Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, this is going to be a huge problem for Krunal. All the teams would be keeping a close eye on how he's playing the short ball and so far he's looked awful to say the least. It was a real effort ball from Karunaratne and Krunal was all over the place with his swivelling movements. Doesn't get anywhere close and misses the pull by a long way, the ball pings him on the side of the helmet and lobs over the keeper to his left
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, 2 runs, 128ks length delivery outside off, Krunal crunches it through extra cover and gets it to the left of the fielder in the deep

Sandakan to Suryakumar Yadav, out Lbw!! The first real defensive shot SKY tried to play against a spinner and it caused his downfall. He will be gutted for failing to convert this knock into a big one, but nevertheless a fine knock from the Mumbai lad. The ball pitches outside off and turns in from a good length to hit SKY plumb in front of middle, just a few inches past the inside edge and the umpire took his own, sweet time before rasing the dreaded finger. Excellent decision by Dharmasena and Sri Lanka firm favourites to win this now. What a turnaround this has been from the home side. Sandakan was expensive in his first spell and was taken off the attack after SKY smashed him to all corners and now comes in to claim the big fish. Top stuff. Suryakumar Yadav lbw b Sandakan 53(44) [4s-6]
Sandakan to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, allows the ball to turn into the pads and nudges it in front of short fine for a quick single
Sandakan to Krunal Pandya, FOUR, a loopy full toss outside off and Krunal says 'thank you' before slapping it through extra cover off the strong bottom hand. No chance for the fielder in the deep
Sandakan to Krunal Pandya, no run, lunges across and gets a tiny inside edge on the forward block
Sandakan to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, goes on the back foot and cuts the shorter delivery to sweeper cover

Sandakan to Suryakumar Yadav, FOUR, quicker and it's been belted past the diving extra cover fielder. Maiden ODI fifty for Suryakumar Yadav. Warm round of applause from the dressing room and no real celebrations in the middle. If anything, he is looking even more composed and determined and that's not a good sign for Sri Lanka...
Sandakan to Suryakumar Yadav, wide, full and sliding down the leg-side, SKY misses the sweep
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, the short ball barrage continues.... Krunal decides against the risk option and lets it sail through to the keeper
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, short and angling away wide of off-stump, Krunal arches back and lets it pass
Karunaratne to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, punches the 133ks length delivery in front of extra cover and rushes through for a quick single
