Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, looks to play the ramp now and gets beaten on the top-edge

Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, a wild slog from Krunal and he's missed it completely! Skiddy 129ks back of a length delivery that pitches outside leg and smashes Krunal on the forearm as he swipes and misses
Sandakan to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, flatter on the stumps, SKY flicks and finds mid-wicket
Sandakan to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, quicker and just outside off, SKY drives and picks out mid-off
Sandakan to Suryakumar Yadav, 2 runs, floated up on the stumps, SKY plays the typical whip off his legs to the left of deep mid-wicket. Easy double
Sandakan to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, full on the stumps, Krunal lunges across and drives to the right of mid-wicket
Sandakan to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, touch short on and around off-stump, SKY hangs back and punches to the right of the diving bowler for an easy single
Sandakan to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, full and wide of off, Krunal goes hard on the drive and gets it to the left of sweeper cover

Karunaratne to Suryakumar Yadav, 2 runs, chips the drive in the air but gets it wide of the diving fielder at cover. Was a change of pace from Karunaratne and SKY picked it off the hand to play the stroke through extra cover, Hasaranga makes a fine stop in the deep to prevent the boundary
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, full and wide of off, Krunal pings the drive off the toe-end and gets it to the right of long-off
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, 129ks lifter outside off, too wide and Krunal lets it go
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, 122ks fuller outside off, Krunal drives crisply and picks out the fielder at extra cover
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, FOUR, dug in short and Krunal goes for the pull looking to fetch it from well outside off, a thick top-edge and it flies over the keeper for a boundary
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, slower back of a length delivery outside off, Krunal cuts and picks out backward point
Sandakan to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, gets on the full ball and slams the drive along the ground to sweeper cover
Sandakan to Krunal Pandya, no run, slower and just outside off, punched straight to cover
Sandakan to Krunal Pandya, no run, gets his line right and keeps it around off, Krunal strides across and defends
Sandakan to Krunal Pandya, no run, loopy and dips on leg-stump, Krunal plays a cute flick and finds short fine
Sandakan to Krunal Pandya, 2 runs, goes hard at a full and wide delivery and gets the drive through extra cover, good running follows...
Sandakan to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, flighted on middle and leg, SKY forces the drive to the left of mid-wicket
Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, walks inside the line of a slower length delivery and nudges it square on the leg-side for a strike-retaining single
Shanaka to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, slower short ball on the body, Krunal swivels and pulls to the right of fine leg. Fumble again and the duo decide not to risk a second on this occasion
Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, tucked to mid-wicket and a fumble by the fielder there enables the single for the duo
Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, walks across and punches the length delivery to the right of the bowler
Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, 2 runs, stays leg-side of the length delivery and punches it along the ground to the left of deep extra cover
Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, slower full delivery outside off, SKY checks his drive in front of mid-off
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, short and angling away outside off, Krunal lifts his bat and lets it go
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, 126ks bumper on the stumps, Krunal ducks under it. Was a touch down the leg-side and was a fifty-fifty call for the umpire...
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, the slower length delivery that slides across the left-hander to beat him on the cut, was a belated thought from Krunal and couldn't get anywhere near it
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, 135ks full and slanting away wide of off, Krunal is happy to let it pass
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, full and angling away wide of off-stump at 131ks, Krunal shoulders arms
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, 133ks full outside off, Krunal strides across and defends it to mid-off
Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, full on off-stump, played back to the bowler
Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, this skiddy slower back of a length delivery holds on the surface outside off and hits the splice on the push to mid-wicket
Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, wide, tries the slower ball yet again and loses radar, slips it well down the leg-side past SKY's attempted glance
Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, another slower delivery and SKY has picked this, waits for it to angle in and pushes it wide of cover
Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, slower fullish delivery and SKY fails to pick it, commits to the drive and chips it off the splice to the right of short cover
Shanaka to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, very full outside off, Krunal slices the drive to the left of backward point and rushes through for a quick single
Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, middles the punch once again and gets it to the left of the fielder at mid-off
Karunaratne to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, length delivery outside off, punched away to sweeper cover

Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, 1 run, in the air and falls wide of the diving fielder! Lots happening in the middle. The short ball gets big on Krunal and the pull finds the top-edge, only to drop inches short of the diving mid-wicket fielder to his left. The fielder ran back and did well to get there, but the bowler isn't pleased and feels he should have done better...
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, good length just outside off, Krunal plays out a solid defensive push into the off-side
Karunaratne to Krunal Pandya, no run, skiddy length delivery angling away with extra bounce outside off, Pandya looks to cut and gets beaten on the top-edge

Karunaratne to Suryakumar Yadav, leg byes, 1 run, huge lbw appeal but that's missing leg! SKY misses the flick against a length delivery and the angle was clearly going down the hill, the duo rush through for a quick single and nearly present a run-out opportunity at the bowling end. Not to be, the throw was wide and missed the target

Karunaratne to Suryakumar Yadav, FOUR, SKY will not bog down! He is not letting the boundary ball go scot-free! Short and wide of off-stump, he slashes and gets it square on the off-side leaving no chance for the fielders in the deep

Shanaka to Hardik Pandya, out Caught by de Silva!! The Sri Lankan skipper is turning it on here. Sri Lanka are cock-a-hoop and why wouldn't they be. Hardik Pandya gone for a third-ball duck. He's played this miles in front of his body and to make matters worse, went with hard hards and ended up offering catching practice to the man at mid-wicket. The fullish length delivery that doesn't rise as much just outside off, Hardik was on the shuffle and looked to chip it on the leg-side, finds DDS to perfection. Hardik Pandya c de Silva b Shanaka 0(3)
Shanaka to Hardik Pandya, no run, digs it short wide of off, Pandya was nearly tempted into a pull and restrains his instincts to shoulder arms at the last moment

Shanaka to Hardik Pandya, no run, dropped! How costly would that prove? A full delivery shaping in just outside off, Hardik goes with hard hands on the drive and chips a low catch back to the bowler who fails to hold on. Hands-on-head moment for the Sri Lankan skipper
Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, fuller on the stumps, driven down to long-on

Shanaka to Suryakumar Yadav, out Manish Pandey Run Out!! Unlucky and unfortunate, Manish Pandey has to go. He was starting to look good and will be disappointed. SKY smokes a straight drive that's so straight that it hit the stumps at the bowling end. The Sri Lankan skipper, somehow, manages a touch (palm) on his dive and Manish Pandey was nowhere in the frame. Was backing up a little too far and was perhaps thinking about a quick single. Not to be. Manish Pandey run out (Shanaka) 37(31) [4s-3]
Shanaka to Manish Pandey, 1 run, back of a length delivery outside off, Pandey punches it wide of cover for a quick single
Karunaratne to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, on a good length and asking for off-stump, SKY shows some respect and bunts it back to the bowler
Karunaratne to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, gets fuller and SKY's drive goes off the toe-end towards mid-on

Karunaratne to Suryakumar Yadav, FOUR, SKY does not bother looking at the trajectory of the ball. He knows he's middled it and walks down the pitch nonchalantly to show some glove-love to his partner. A short ball outside off, he gets up on his tippy toes and ramps it for a one-bounce boundary over the keeper
Karunaratne to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, back of a length delivery at the pads, SKY flicks and can't get it past the fielder at square leg
Karunaratne to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, 131ks back of a length delivery on the stumps, punched back to the bowler
Karunaratne to Manish Pandey, 3 runs, Pandey getting into his groove now! A full delivery on the pads and he plays a static flick wide of mid-on, almost a boundary again!

Hasaranga to Suryakumar Yadav, 2 runs, this shot made SKY's IPL team-mate Hardik Pandya run across the boundary toblerones to applaud one of the most eye-pleasing shots in cricket. The inside-out loft! Can anyone play it better than SKY? Gets under the full delivery and executes the stroke to perfection. No force, sheer timing and the fielder at deep extra cover had to put in a desperate dive to prevent the boundary
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, 1 run, touch quicker on the stumps, punched down to long-on
Hasaranga to Suryakumar Yadav, 3 runs, forces Hasaranga to shorten the length and uses the width to steer it with soft hands between backward point and slip. Nearly a boundary there...
Hasaranga to Suryakumar Yadav, 2 runs, goes for the slogsweep and drags it off the thick inside edge through mid-wicket. Easy two

Hasaranga to Suryakumar Yadav, FOUR, SKY is putting up a clinic of 360 degree batting here! Sinks to one knee, picks the googly and scoops it from a fuller length over the keeper to his left. Ever heard of a method to madness?
Hasaranga to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, tossed up just outside off, driven to the left of the bowler

Rajitha to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, SKY isn't happy with himself for he's mistimed one here! Was shaping up to flick this fullish length delivery wide of mid-wicket and gets a thick leading edge that flies to the left of sweeper cover
Rajitha to Suryakumar Yadav, 2 runs, a classic whiplash off the pads and he's got this to the left of deep mid-wicket for another couple of runs

Rajitha to Suryakumar Yadav, 2 runs, this is modern day batting at its very best! Sees Rajitha hit the good length and still senses a boundary opportunity by opening the bat face late trying to run it fine of third man, Sandakan just about manages to get there in time with a slide to prevent the boundary
Rajitha to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, back of a length on and around off-stump, SKY sits back and pokes it into the off-side

Rajitha to Suryakumar Yadav, FOUR, whoa! What timing! You cannot help but admire the pure outrageous skill of this lad. Does not overcommit, waits for the length ball to arrive on the pads and crisply punch-flicks it in the gap between mid-on and mid-wicket...
Rajitha to Manish Pandey, 1 run, 134ks short of length delivery wide of off, Pandey opens the bat face and guides it down to third man
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, 1 run, fuller and straighter, pushed down to long-on for an easy single and that will be drinks!
Hasaranga to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, so easy on the eye this lad! Stays leg-side of the full delivery and drives it all along the ground to sweeper cover
Hasaranga to Suryakumar Yadav, no run, too full on off-stump, SKY looks to jam it out into the off-side and gets it off the thick inside edge in front of cover

Hasaranga to Suryakumar Yadav, FOUR, that is a SKY special and you must have seen it a million times in the IPL! Unleashes those whippy wrists on the full delivery and gets the ball flying over mid-wicket for a one-bounce boundary. No fielder there and hence the risk and reward...

Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, 1 run, a direct hit would have been curtains for Suryakumar Yadav! Pandey tapped this in front of cover and called his partner through for a quick single, SKY was hesitant initially but put in a full-length dive which eventually saved him despite a fine glovework from the keeper
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, strides across and blocks the fuller delivery off the inside edge on the leg-side
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, 1 run, fuller on middle and leg, Pandey dinks it down to long-on and keeps strike with that single

Sandakan to Manish Pandey, FOUR, Pandey is finding his rhythm here... A low full toss and he's absolutely picked the bones out of it, thumped it on one knee and piereced deep mid-wicket and deep square leg to perfection. The Sri Lankan head coach isn't pleased with what he's seeing and he's slamming the railings in frustration...
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, 2 runs, short and wide of off, Pandey jumps on the back foot and slashes the cut to the left of sweeper cover. Easy two...
Sandakan to Suryakumar Yadav, 1 run, fuller on the stumps, SKY's off the mark with a push down to long-on
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, 1 run, pushed down to long-on

Sandakan to Manish Pandey, FOUR, doesn't miss out this time! Pandey takes full toll of this low full toss and hammers the sweep to the left of deep mid-wicket who fumbles horribly to enable a much-needed boundary for India...

Hasaranga to Dhawan, out Lbw!! Never a good idea to sit deep against the spinners who can bowl it at a quicker pace. Dhawan was on the back foot, waiting to pick the turn and perhaps play a defensive push. Hasaranga though smartly got this to pitch in line with middle stump and the ball just skids across straight to hit the top of middle stump. Dhawan was struck plumb in front and the Sri Lankan skipper looked pretty confident before opting for the review. Dhawan lbw b Hasaranga 29(38) [4s-6]
Hasaranga to Dhawan, no run, tossed up outside off, forward and blocked back to the bowler
Hasaranga to Dhawan, no run, tossed up outside off, Dhawan strides across and drives it straight to mid-off
Hasaranga to Dhawan, no run, cut away and can't get it past the fielder at backward point
Hasaranga to Dhawan, no run, gets forward and defends the quicker delivery into the off-side
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, 1 run, missed out on a boundary ball yet again! A dipping full toss and Pandey goes for the swipe, only to drag it off the lower half to the right of long-on
Sandakan to Dhawan, no run, flighted just outside off, Dhawan blocks off the front foot
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, 1 run, allows the ball to rip from a shorter length and cuts it in the gap between backward point and cover
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, 2 runs, goes on the back foot and tucks the quicker delivery wide of short fine for an easy couple of runs
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, no run, jumps down the track looking to take Sandakan straight for a big hit, but Pandey ends up jamming it off the toe-end back to the bowler
Sandakan to Manish Pandey, no run, flatter and quicker on the stumps, Pandey drives it back to the bowler
Sandakan to Dhawan, 1 run, slower and fuller from front of the hand, Dhawan pushes with soft hands in front of cover and races across for a quick single

Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, 2 runs, gets a thick outside edge on the push and the ball flies to the right of short third where Rajapaksa tumbles before hauling the ball. He seems to have gotten into an awkward position there and has gone off the field. Hope it's nothing serious...
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, no run, lunges across and drives the fuller delivery to cover
Hasaranga to Dhawan, 1 run, quicker and shorter, Dhawan forces the pull and picks out the man at deep mid-wicket
Hasaranga to Dhawan, no run, googly just outside off, Dhawan hops back and blocks with soft hands
Hasaranga to Dhawan, no run, floated full on middle and leg, Dhawan drives to the left of the bowler who fields in his followthrough
Hasaranga to Manish Pandey, 1 run, a horrid drag down and Pandey, in his quest to use more muscle, plays the pull to the left of deep mid-wicket. Missed out on a boundary there...
Rajitha to Dhawan, no run, skiddy back of a length on and around leg-stump, Dhawan sits on the back foot and drops it with soft hands on the leg-side

Rajitha to Dhawan, FOUR, a Shikhar Dhawan special that! Picks the length (short) early and swivels on his back foot to play the short-arm-jab past mid-wicket with absolute perfection. Plenty of power and timing on that...
Rajitha to Dhawan, no run, full and gets a touch closer to off, Dhawan shows a straight bat as he pushes the drive to cover
Rajitha to Dhawan, no run, slanting away across the left-hander from a length, the Indian skipper is happy to shoulder arms
Rajitha to Manish Pandey, 1 run, 131ks length delivery angling in at the pads, Pandey hops and drops it in front of mid-wicket for a quick single
Rajitha to Manish Pandey, wide, loses radar and sprays the full delivery well down the leg-side, necessitates a dive from the keeper to his left

Rajitha to Manish Pandey, no run, proper teasing stuff this from Rajitha! Keeps it full and gets some late movement inward outside off, Pandey's laden-feeted drive fetches nothing. Beaten on the inside edge
Chameera to Manish Pandey, 1 run, 141.5kph back of a length delivery and Pandey dangles his bat away from the body, the outside edge runs down to third man and Sandakan tidies up, just a single
Chameera to Manish Pandey, no run, banged into the surface, Pandey stays leg-side and flat-bats it to mid-on, struck it well but straight to the fielder
Chameera to Manish Pandey, no run, leg-cutter and Pandey spotted, he just delayed his bat swing and drilled it straight back, Chameera does well to get some hand on it in his followthrough
Chameera to Manish Pandey, no run, fuller and around off, Pandey drives and mid-off stops it with a slide
Chameera to Manish Pandey, 2 runs, 142.2kph delivery that thuds into the bat and makes it turn, the ball rolls through the mid-wicket region and Pandey jobs back comfortably for the second
Chameera to Manish Pandey, FOUR, 145.5kph half volley on the pads and Pandey doesn't need a second invitation, he just uses the pace on the ball and flicks it past a diving mid-on fielder
Rajitha to Dhawan, no run, fuller and slanted across the left hander, Dhawan shoulders arms
Rajitha to Dhawan, no run, 132.7kph back of a length delivery around off, Dhawan dabs it to backward point
Rajitha to Dhawan, no run, on a length and outside off, Dhawan lifts his bat and lets it go
Rajitha to Dhawan, no run, optimistic shout for LBW. Dhawan misses the flick and wears it on the pad, the impact was around leg-stump and was clearly going down leg
Rajitha to Manish Pandey, 1 run, 133.3kph delivery straying onto the pads, Pandey clips it past mid-wicket and crosses over
Rajitha to Manish Pandey, no run, back of a length on off, Pandey blocks it into the leg-side
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, good length ball around off, Dhawan is right behind the line to defend

Chameera to Dhawan, no run, almost, almost had him! A well-directed short ball and Dhawan survives. He tries to get on top of the bounce but is not able to, softens his grip and fends it uppishly into the off-side. The ball lands well in front of the incoming backward point fielder
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, 139.6kph delivery angled across, Dhawan stabs it in front of backward point
Chameera to Manish Pandey, 1 run, short and at the body, Pandey rides the bounce and takes it backward of square leg, happy with a single

Chameera to Dhawan, 1 run, now just evades the fielder.. He's living dangerously. Short ball ploy almost worked, Dhawan tried to help it along the way but there's a fielder at backward square, DDS leaps to his left but the ball is well out of his reach

Chameera to Dhawan, no run, Dhawan is testing his luck here. Another ball that goes past his edge. Short of length delivery outside off and Dhawan is half-hearted in his attempted cut shot, the ball flies over his top-edge
Chameera to Dhawan, wide, swinging down leg and that's a good take by Bhanuka, flies to his right and makes a one-handed save. Stop four..

Rajitha to Ishan Kishan, out Bowled!! Dragged on! Sri Lanka are cock-a-hoop. Mickey Arthur even sports a smile on his face. They needed early wickets and have got them. Angled across the southpaw, Kishan's feet don't move as he tries to flay it through the off-side, only manages an inside edge that smashes into the stumps. Ishan Kishan b Rajitha 1(4)
Rajitha to Dhawan, 1 run, back of a length around off, Dhawan opens the bat face and guides it towards third man

Rajitha to Dhawan, no run, that's better. Keeps it in the channel around off-stump and Dhawan plays down the wrong line, he stays rooted to the crease and brings his bat down outside the line, beaten on the inside edge
Rajitha to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, slanted across the left hander, Kishan uses that and steers a single to third man
Rajitha to Ishan Kishan, no run, ouch! That will hurt. Short of length delivery and Kishan is cramped on the pull shot, misses and is struck on the box. He grimaces in pain and goes down..
Rajitha to Ishan Kishan, no run, back of a length around off, Kishan drops it with soft hands into the off-side and searches for the single to get him off the mark
Rajitha to Ishan Kishan, wide, sprays this well outside off, cutting the guideline and Kishan is happy to let it pass
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, on a length and outside off, Dhawan lifts his bat and lets it go

Chameera to Dhawan, FOUR, oh no! Rajitha is having a horrible time in the field. Another misfield and another boundary. Short ball but plenty of width on offer, Dhawan cracks it uppishly towards third man and Rajitha could not judge the skid on the ball, he's beaten for pace
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, beaten! The double bluff from Chameera. He set the field for the short ball and pitched one up, Dhawan does not come fully forward as he pushes, beaten on the outside edge

Chameera to Dhawan, FOUR, streaky! Dhawan is tentative in this over. Back of a length around off, Dhawan's late in bringing his bat across and the inside edge goes over the stumps, the pace of Chameera means fine leg had no chance to get around

Chameera to Dhawan, no run, some excitement from behind the stumps for a LBW appeal. Chameera was not interested. Back of a length and Dhawan misses the flick, rapped on the pads and the impact was down leg
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, on a length and around off, Dhawan drives and ekes out an inside edge onto the pad

Hasaranga to Prithvi Shaw, out Bowled!! Cleaned up! Hasaranga is pumped. He lets out a roar and then does a fist pump. Much needed breakthrough for Sri Lanka. Bringing the spinner on early has worked. Shaw got out to the off-break of DDS last game and now to the leg-break of Hasaranga. It was the wrong 'un and Shaw did not pick it, he saw the length and lined-up for the cut, misses and the ball crashes into off-stump. Prithvi Shaw b Hasaranga 13(11) [4s-3]
Hasaranga to Prithvi Shaw, no run, loads it with flight and lands it in the blockhole, squeezed out to cover
Hasaranga to Dhawan, 1 run, flighted on leg-stump, Dhawan nudges it into the vacant mid-wicket pocket
Hasaranga to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, fraction short and around off, Shaw cracks it hard and straight to cover-point, a half stop allows them to cross over

Hasaranga to Prithvi Shaw, no run, uhhh! That was agonisingly close to the stumps. Tossed up and Shaw went hard on the drive, the inside edge hits the pad and rolls past off-stump. He didn't even try to push it away
Hasaranga to Prithvi Shaw, no run, flighted around off, Shaw prods forward and defends to mid-wicket

Chameera to Dhawan, FOUR, another over that has yielded three boundaries. Short ball at the body, Dhawan plays the one-legged pull, just used the pace and helped it backward of square leg. Sandakan runs across, slides and pushes the ball in, but since it was rolling back he tried to flick it in but that time his boot was touching the rope
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, good length attacking the stumps, Dhawan is right behind the line to defend

Chameera to Dhawan, FOUR, now Dhawan strikes back to back boundaries. Already pressure put back on Sri Lanka. Very full delivery and all Dhawan had to do was place it right, he just pushes it straight back past Shaw and the timing takes care of the rest

Chameera to Dhawan, FOUR, that's really poor. Sri Lanka have to be better than this in the field. Short ball angled across the left hander, Dhawan ramps it on the bounce to third man and Rajitha makes a hash of it, allows it to burst through his fingers and reach the fence. There's no excuse for this fumble as it went at a nice height
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, 135.2kph delivery that's leg-lined, Dhawan turns it to mid-wicket
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, fuller and outside off, Dhawan drives and picks out cover. He timed it well but could not find the gap

Rajitha to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, hat-trick of boundaries. Shaw once again providing a quick start. This was a half volley on the pads and most Indian batsmen are good there, flicked away elegantly in front of square and the ball races away to the fence

Rajitha to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, back to back boundaries. Rajitha overcompensates, feeds a half volley around off, Shaw is not missing out, he drives it straight and beats a squarish mid-off comfortably

Rajitha to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, shot! Not a bad delivery by any means. Even the Pandya brothers enjoyed it in the dugout. Good length ball on off, the high backlift comes down hard on the punch and creams it straight of mid-on. He doesn't even bother to run..
Rajitha to Prithvi Shaw, no run, 136.8kph pitched up delivery and Shaw mistimes the drive to mid-off. The bat turned on impact and robbed the shot of all the timing
Rajitha to Prithvi Shaw, wide, another down leg and this is too far for Shaw to reach, good diving take by Bhanuka
Rajitha to Prithvi Shaw, wide, sprays a very full delivery down leg, Shaw makes no contact with the glance and India are off the mark
Rajitha to Prithvi Shaw, no run, fuller and drawing Shaw into the drive, struck unconvincingly back to Rajitha and he fumbles, no harm done as Shaw didn't want to risk a single
Rajitha to Prithvi Shaw, no run, hint of away movement. Good length ball shaping away, Shaw plays it late and knocks it to backward point

Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, FOUR .. and a helicopter will finish it off. He's put his entire top-order to shame, and big time. Kumar misses his yorker, but still, it's not meant to be drilled down like this was. Anyway, a shuffle, getting behind the line, and a whip straight back down the ground

Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, FOUR, some Caribbean swagger now rubbing in. It's a slower one outside off, into the pitch. Karunaratne shuffles, waits, and then with a proper slice, carves it over extra cover
Bhuvneshwar to Rajitha, 1 run, rides the bounce nicely, waiting on it to punch it down to long-off

Bhuvneshwar to Sandakan, out Sandakan Run Out!! Quite a nice foxy slower back of a length delivery. Sandakan swings, misses, and instantly scoots off to get Karunaratne on strike. Alas, Karunaratne doesn't want to. And before he can turn back and get in, Kishan's already run half way down and nailed an under-arm hit. Sandakan run out (Ishan Kishan) 0(1)
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 1 run, slower length delivery, sliced uppishly, but straight to sweeper cover
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, wide, slow, outside off. A little too greedy this in trying to keep it away from Karunaratne, ending up straying way outside

Bhuvneshwar to Chameera, out Caught by (sub)Devdutt Padikkal!! The usual: slow, full, in the slot as Chameera finally connects on his crouched hoick. Ends up miscuing it high, where backward square leg settles under comfortably under. Chameera c (sub)Devdutt Padikkal b Bhuvneshwar 2(5)

Chahar to Karunaratne, FOUR, tries a bouncer, but with Chahar's harmless pace, there's enough time for Karunaratne to walk inside the line and pull it away behind square. It's right in his first ODI tail-wagging territory
Chahar to Karunaratne, FOUR, wow. Plain, wow, stuff. Chahar overcooks, and Karunaratne steps out, full-facing a loft downtown, holding on then to his high-elbowed pose. Again, wow ..
Chahar to Karunaratne, 2 runs, 127.9kph, low full toss, smashed back down the pitch, deflecting off Chahar's shoe into an empty mid-wicket
Chahar to Karunaratne, wide, slower bouncer. Too short, too high, too easy. Karunaratne doesn't even bother
Chahar to Chameera, 1 run, 130.1kph, the quicker yorker now, swerving in through the air, as Chameera whips, inside-edging it onto his pads, and then into the covers
Chahar to Chameera, no run, another floaty full one well outside off. Chameera continues standing his ground, crouching, swinging, missing
Chahar to Chameera, no run, slow, wide outside off. Chameera has an almighty hoick, way too early, and way inside the line
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 2 runs, wide yorker, and Karunaratne fetches this from well past the tramline, drilling it through sweeper
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, no run, 115.7kph, neat change up, foxing Karunaratne with the lack of pace as he slaps, and misses
Bhuvneshwar to Chameera, 1 run, 125.8kph, hangs back, opens his bat face and dabs it behind point
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 1 run, shuffles, tapping it off the back foot, in front of mid-off for a quick one
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, FOUR, short, slow, wide. Karunaratne throws his bat out, gets an under-edge, and gets it fine of short third man

Bhuvneshwar to Asalanka, out Caught by (sub)Devdutt Padikkal!! Slower length delivery, off-cutter. Asalanka has to manufacture all the pace on this one as he sinks down to slog. Nope, can't, ending up dragging it off the inside half straight down deep mid-wicket's throat. Nevertheless, it's been a key knock this from Sri Lanka's perspective, and he's tired the Indians enough to not even bother gathering around to celebrate. Asalanka c (sub)Devdutt Padikkal b Bhuvneshwar 65(68) [4s-6]
Chahar to Karunaratne, 2 runs, 125.8kph, seam up, full, on off, whipped wide of mid-wicket, and Shaw certainly isn't the quickest outfielder, certainly not to cut off the second
Chahar to Asalanka, 1 run, on middle, good length, glanced straight to short fine leg, but that's not stopping singles
Chahar to Asalanka, no run, another cutter, going across, with Asalanka clearing his front leg to punch. Nah, misses
Chahar to Karunaratne, 1 run, 107kph, full, floaty, slow again. A shuffling drive through extra cover
Chahar to Karunaratne, no run, 118.9kph, slow, nipping in on the stumps. Karunaratne's taken by surprise, settles in the end to block

Chahar to Karunaratne, 2 runs, slow, good length, sticking in the pitch. Karunaratne punches it wide of long-off,and the lack of pace, a checked shot, and some crazy running helps pinching the second pretty easily
Bhuvneshwar to Asalanka, 2 runs, 115.9kph, back of a length, and Asalanka stays on top of it to pull it round the corner
Bhuvneshwar to Asalanka, FOUR, thick edge, through the slips. Asalanka makes room, wafts, tries lofting it over mid-off. Never mind, third man would do just as fine
Bhuvneshwar to Asalanka, 2 runs, back of a length, tummy-lined, swatted away in front of square, where Krunal cleans up getting across from deep mid-wicket
Bhuvneshwar to Asalanka, no run, 122.7kph, spots the charge down and shortens his length. Also goes across him wide outside off to beat his cut
Bhuvneshwar to Asalanka, no run, 112.3kph, knuckle ball, full, outside off, sucking Asalanka on the forward drive, only to come on slower than he'd anticipated, for a checked one, to cover
Bhuvneshwar to Karunaratne, 1 run, 120kph, length, outside off. Karunaratne shuffles, punching it in front of mid-off for a quick one
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, no run, short again, cut again, but Yadav finds some extra bounce to beat him on it
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, no run, short, but doesn't quite give him the room, and Asalanka ends up with a cramped cut to point
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, FOUR, too full, feeding the V, and Asalanka's found his slogging groove here. Quickly getting down, and nailing an empty square leg, keeping it along thr ground as well
Kuldeep Yadav to Karunaratne, 1 run, again, short, slow, wide, cut, sweeper
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, 1 run, short, wide, chopped away to the right of sweeper
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, FOUR, hammered through. Gets forward, close enough to the pitch of it, and drills it with the spin over extra cover. Not a bad way to get to a fifty -- first in ODIs too ..
Chahal to Karunaratne, no run, beats him -- drawing him forward, dipping in front, and spinning away. Just the perfect end to what's been a real top spell: 10-1-50-3
Chahal to Asalanka, 1 run, another lean, flicking, through square leg
Chahal to Karunaratne, 1 run, floated up outside off, carved away with a nice lean, to cover's left
Chahal to Karunaratne, 2 runs, very loopy, wide, sliced hard and straight to Dhawan at cover, who lets the ball pop up and over him off his palm, thereby leaking an extra run
Chahal to Asalanka, 1 run, full, around off, and another quiet nudge round the corner
Chahal to Karunaratne, 1 run, flat, short, spinning away. Swatted along the ground, and deep mid-wicket is quick to get across and intercept
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, no run, shuffles, sits, slogs, misses, thanks to Kuldeep and his slow sharp turners sneaking under
Kuldeep Yadav to Karunaratne, 1 run, googly again, full, drifting across, nice forward pressing tap in front of cover
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, 1 run, very short, but very slow and just not coming on for Asalanka to time his cut right. To deep sweeper
Kuldeep Yadav to Karunaratne, 1 run, googly, but leg-lined. And nudged off an opened up stance into mid-wicket
Kuldeep Yadav to Karunaratne, no run, on middle, Karunaratne clears out his front leg to squeeze this straight to cover
Kuldeep Yadav to Karunaratne, no run, it's the 43rd over, but Yadav's still looping them up, outside off, as Karunaratne pushes it back down the pitch off the inside half
Chahal to Karunaratne, 1 run, big forward press, defending it in front of point, softly enough
Chahal to Asalanka, 1 run, darts it in quicker, with Asalanka poking it in front of short third man, and despite some running confusion, the single's pinched
Chahal to Karunaratne, 1 run, pretty short, slow, spinning away. Karunaratne goes behind, waits on it, and stabs it through point
Chahal to Asalanka, 1 run, slow, on the legs, as Asalanka waits on it to nurdle it round the corner
Chahal to Asalanka, 2 runs, shuffles, sits, sweeps a delivery that's not all that short. Deep square leg will clean up
Chahal to Asalanka, no run, spinning into the thighs. Asalanka gets across, then steps away onto his back foot, and misses his glance completely
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, 1 run, flat again, on middle, and a leaning clip round the corner
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, FOUR, flat, on middle. And Asalanka starts with a dance, getting nice and close, before sitting down and slogging full-blooded, just short of the deep mid-wicket ropes
Krunal Pandya to Karunaratne, 1 run, hangs back, punching it off an opened-bat face through point
Krunal Pandya to Karunaratne, 2 runs, quite a miscued paddle, with the ball squirting off the toe-end through mid-wicket instead. Nevertheless, +2 ..
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, 1 run, spins back in from an off-line, cramping an already room-making Asalanka, who has to adjust in cutting it down to deep point
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, no run, goes reverse-sweeping, looking to drag this ball from well down leg, and ends up gloving it onto his face
Chahar to Karunaratne, no run, shortens the length and Karunaratne pulls straight to mid-wicket
Chahar to Karunaratne, wide, ruins his chance of a wicket-maiden. Slips the knuckle ball down leg and Karunaratne makes no connection with the glance
Chahar to Karunaratne, no run, bouncer on the stumps, Karunaratne ducks inside the line and evades it comfortably
Chahar to Karunaratne, no run, off-pace delivery and Karunaratne waits to defend it back to Chahar
Chahar to Karunaratne, no run, 130.1kph fullish delivery and Karunaratne knocks it to mid-on
Chahar to Karunaratne, no run, back of a length around off, Karunaratne gets right behind the line and defends

Chahar to Hasaranga, out Bowled!! Knocked 'im over! This is a brilliant delivery. Hasaranga is fooled completely by Chahar's wizardry. First ball of a new spell and he starts with a dipping knuckle ball, Hasaranga did not pick it and his feet remain stuck together, also played down the wrong line, the ball landed around the yorker length and crashed into the base of middle-stump. Almost a Malinga-esque dismissal apart from the slingy action. Hasaranga b Chahar 8(11) [4s-1]
Bhuvneshwar to Asalanka, no run, back of a length around off, Asalanka punches it straight to backward point
Bhuvneshwar to Hasaranga, 1 run, dropped with soft hands in front of backward point, Hasaranga looks up at his partner and they scamper through
Bhuvneshwar to Hasaranga, no run, once more a pull shot attempted off a not-so-short delivery, mistimed to mid-on
Bhuvneshwar to Hasaranga, no run, on a length and around off, Hasaranga dabs it straight to backward point
Bhuvneshwar to Hasaranga, no run, attacks the stumps, Hasaranga sits back and bunts it to mid-wicket

Bhuvneshwar to Asalanka, 1 run, in the air and safe.. Not all that short to play the pull and hence Asalanka gets it high on the bat, lobs over the bowler and lands just wide of Krunal coming across from mid-on

Krunal Pandya to Hasaranga, FOUR, lovely shot! This was right in the slot but still had to be put away. Krunal tossed it up invitingly outside off and Hasaranga takes the invitation, he goes inside out with his loft and collects a one bounce four
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, 1 run, shortens the length and Asalanka tucks it towards mid-wicket, quick single
Krunal Pandya to Hasaranga, 1 run, throws it up a bit wider and Hasaranga eases it to long-off
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, 1 run, drifted across the left hander and Asalanka swipes it powerfully to deep mid-wicket, just a single
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, no run, once more not much pace on the ball and Asalanka is not able to connect with his flick, struck on the pad outside leg
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, no run, very slow as per Krunal's standards, Asalanka misses the nudge and the ball rolls off the pad to short fine
Bhuvneshwar to Hasaranga, no run, back of a length around off, Hasaranga stabs it into the off-side

Bhuvneshwar to Hasaranga, leg byes, FOUR, uhh! Bit of movement. Nip-backer that catches Hasaranga rooted to the crease, he's beaten on the inside edge and struck on the back thigh, the ball beats a diving Ishan Kishan to his right and runs away to the fence
Bhuvneshwar to Asalanka, 1 run, once more tries to force it through the off-side and the outside edge rolls to third man

Bhuvneshwar to Asalanka, no run, wanted to run it down to third man but is defeated by the extra bit of bounce, the line and length was perfect to play the dab but he couldn't get on top of the bounce
Bhuvneshwar to Hasaranga, 1 run, too straight - on middle and leg, Hasaranga tucks it near the short fine leg region
Bhuvneshwar to Asalanka, 1 run, angled across the left hander, Asalanka squirts an outside edge to third man
Chahal to Asalanka, 1 run, tossed up on middle and leg, Asalanka nudges it square on the leg-side and keeps strike
Chahal to Asalanka, no run, tucked towards mid-wicket and there's a loud call of "wait" for the single
Chahal to Asalanka, FOUR, risky but well-executed. There was no one sweeping on the off-side and Asalanka wanted to take advantage, he makes room and cuts it off the stumps through the cover region
Chahal to Hasaranga, 1 run, sliding on and Hasaranga works it off the pads backward of square leg

Chahal to Shanaka, out Bowled!! Cleaned up! Chahal has his third. And another budding partnership that's been nipped out before it could do any damage. Smart piece of bowling from the leggie. He was tossing 'em in his last over, Shanaka stayed on the backfoot expecting a flighted delivery but this was the slider, skidded on and went past before the bat could come down, crashes into off-stump. Shanaka b Chahal 16(24) [4s-1]
Chahal to Asalanka, 1 run, googly on leg-stump, Asalanka nurdles it towards short fine leg
Krunal Pandya to Shanaka, no run, very full delivery and Shanaka squeezes the drive straight to cover
Krunal Pandya to Shanaka, no run, turn for Krunal. Shortens the length and gets it to spin across, Shanaka is left dangling his bat away from the body, beaten on the outside edge
Krunal Pandya to Shanaka, no run, tossed up around off, Shanaka defends it to the left of Krunal

Krunal Pandya to Shanaka, no run, played with soft hands in front of cover and Shanaka wanted a single, sent back rightly as Pandey swoops down and flings a throw at the striker's end, the ball takes a deflection off Shanaka's bat but the batsmen don't run
Krunal Pandya to Shanaka, no run, fullish delivery and Shanaka flicks it towards mid-wicket, Dhawna dives and stops
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, 1 run, another leg-lined delivery that's tucked away to deep square leg, for a single
Chahal to Asalanka, 1 run, slows it up but on leg-stump, nudged square on the leg-side and Asalanka retains strike
Chahal to Shanaka, 1 run, tossed up around off, Shanaka eases it down to long-off
Chahal to Shanaka, FOUR, poor delivery and Chahal knows. He lets out a grunt as soon as he bowled that. Down leg and no one in the deep behind square, easy pickings for Shanaka as he sweeps it away
Chahal to Asalanka, 1 run, in the air and just short. Asalanka wanted to go inside out but is deceived by the lack of pace, chips it towards long-off and the ball lands well in front of Shaw
Chahal to Asalanka, no run, flighted delivery and Asalanka reverse sweeps straight to backward point, struck it well but picked out the fielder
Chahal to Shanaka, 1 run, lands it a bit too full and Shanaka drives to long-off
Hardik Pandya to Shanaka, 1 run, 131.1kph full delivery that's driven straight down, Hardik fails to stop it with his right boot and Shanaka crosses over to retain strike
Hardik Pandya to Shanaka, no run, on a length and around off, Shanaka defends back to Hardik
Hardik Pandya to Shanaka, no run, hard hands on the drive and the thick inside edge rolls to mid-wicket
Hardik Pandya to Shanaka, no run, 127.3kph fullish delivery around off and Shanaka pushes firmly to cover
Hardik Pandya to Shanaka, no run, 117.5kph slower ball on off, Shanaka bunts it to mid-wicket
Hardik Pandya to Asalanka, 1 run, leg-lined delivery and Asalanka flicks it to deep square leg

Chahal to Shanaka, 2 runs, shortens the length outside off, Shanaka punches it square of the wicket and the pair scamper back for the second, he placed it wide of sweeper which allowed him to take the extra run
Chahal to Asalanka, 1 run, down leg and Asalanka nudges it backward of square, quick single
Chahal to Shanaka, 1 run, uses his feet, gets close to the flighted delivery and eases it to long-off
Chahal to Shanaka, no run, slower and fraction short, Shanaka cuts it close to cover
Chahal to Asalanka, 1 run, comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and works it to deep mid-wicket
Chahal to Asalanka, no run, half tracker down leg, Asalanka misses out as he pulls it straight to short fine
Kuldeep Yadav to Shanaka, 2 runs, spinning down leg and Shanaka helps it along the way with a neat leg-glance, Shaw gives chase and keeps it down to a brace. Good over for Sri Lanka, 11 runs from it
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, 1 run, shortens the length immediately after being hit, knocked square on the off-side

Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, FOUR, Asalanka was itching to have a go. Finally succeeds to get his boundary. Flighted delivery and Asalanka is down on his knee to play the slog sweep, struck it well and hit it to the vacant deep mid-wicket region
Kuldeep Yadav to Shanaka, 1 run, turning in and Shanaka works it towards mid-wicket
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, 1 run, drifting into the left hander, Asalanka nudges it into the mid-wicket pocket

Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, 2 runs, short and turning away outside off, would have been a wide had Asalanka let go, instead he chases and slaps it in front of square, wide of sweeper cover and that allows the pair to come back for the second, Shanaka had to put in the dive to make his crease

Chahar to Asalanka, 1 run, in the air and safe. Lands right between two fielders. Banged into the surface and the ball keeps climbing, Asalanka hooks and the top-edge goes up towards square leg, Krunal runs in and Pandey runs back but both cannot get there to take the catch
Chahar to Shanaka, 1 run, on a length and outside off, Shanaka punches it square and sweeper tidies up, only a single
Chahar to Shanaka, no run, off-pace delivery around off, Shanaka angles it to backward point
Chahar to Asalanka, 1 run, back of a length delivery close to off, Asalanka knocks it square towards point and quickly crosses over
Chahar to Asalanka, no run, bouncer around off, Asalanka arches away and allows it to sail over him
Chahar to Asalanka, wide, that's a poor call. It was well inside the guideline as it went past the southpaw. Asalanka tried to fetch the slower delivery from outside off and missed it by a long way
Chahar to Asalanka, no run, short of length delivery around off, Asalanka rides the bounce and angles to backward point
Kuldeep Yadav to Shanaka, no run, wrong 'un and Shanaka tried to sweep against the spin, missed and is struck on the forearm
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, 1 run, overcooks the flighted delivery, full toss and Asalanka sweeps to deep backward square, just a single
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, no run, very slow and turning away, Asalanka sits back and knocks it down the wicket
Kuldeep Yadav to Shanaka, 1 run, flighted delivery that's leg-lined, nurdled backward of square leg
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, 1 run, drops it short and is slapped straight to sweeper cover
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, no run, goes for the sweep and toe-ends it straight to mid-wicket
Chahar to Asalanka, 1 run, another knuckle ball and Asalanka did not spot it, he pushed with hard hands and the outside edge runs down to third man
Chahar to Shanaka, 1 run, short ball at the body, Shanaka jabs it to deep square leg
Chahar to Asalanka, 1 run, width on offer and Asalanka slaps it in front of square, just a single
Chahar to Asalanka, no run, angled across the left hander, Asalanka goes hard on the drive and ekes out an inside edge onto the pad

Chahar to de Silva, out Caught by Dhawan!! Finally a catch is taken off Chahar's bowling. He was really unlucky in his first spell but is all smiles now. Another Sri Lankan batsmen who has thrown it away. de Silva showed his cards early by backing away to leg, Chahar slipped in the knuckle ball and deceived him completely, chipped towards mid-off and Dhawan runs to his right to complete the catch. de Silva c Dhawan b Chahar 32(45) [4s-1]
Chahar to de Silva, 2 runs, wanted to attack first ball, backs away and seeks to go over extra cover, squirts a thickish inside edge backward of square leg, easy two
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, no run, floated up outside off, Asalanka pushes it to cover
Kuldeep Yadav to de Silva, 1 run, flighted on the leg-line, nurdled round the corner - to backward square leg
Kuldeep Yadav to de Silva, wide, spinning down leg, de Silva misses the glance and Ishan Kishan is quick to whip the bails, the back feet was always planted in the crease
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, 1 run, fraction short and turning away, Asalanka carves it to sweeper cover
Kuldeep Yadav to de Silva, 1 run, turning into the right hander, de Silva clips it to deep mid-wicket
Kuldeep Yadav to Asalanka, 1 run, googly and Asalanka picked it late, worked it towards square leg
Kuldeep Yadav to de Silva, 1 run, flighted around off, de Silva eases the forward press to long-off
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, no run, drifted across off, stays low a touch, Asalanka bunts it to mid-wicket
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, no run, comes down the track and turns it gently to mid-wicket
Krunal Pandya to de Silva, 1 run, sliding onto the pads, de Silva flicks it to deep square leg
Krunal Pandya to de Silva, no run, bit more flight on this delivery and de Silva defends off the frontfoot
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, 1 run, slower but going on with the angle, Asalanka steers it to short third man
Krunal Pandya to Asalanka, no run, slanted across from round the wicket, Asalanka slaps it straight to point

Bhuvneshwar to Avishka Fernando, out Caught by Krunal Pandya!! This was exactly what I was referring to when he reached his fifty. He had not thrown it away but upon reaching the landmark he felt he had the license to go after the bowling. Picked a not-so-short delivery to play the pull and top-edged it straight up, Krunal tracks back from mid-on and takes a good catch. Much needed wicket for Bhuvi as he went wicketless in the first ODI. Avishka Fernando c Krunal Pandya b Bhuvneshwar 50(71) [4s-4 6s-1]
Bhuvneshwar to de Silva, 1 run, once more moves to leg and is followed, flicked to deep square leg and the duo settle with a single
Bhuvneshwar to de Silva, no run, keeps it close to off-stump, de Silva stabs it straight to backward point

Bhuvneshwar to de Silva, FOUR, smashed! de Silva made room and Bhuvi tried to follow him, but landed it right in the slot and de Silva creams it through the line past his partner. Not a muscle moved..

Bhuvneshwar to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, fifty for Fernando. He has not thrown it away like the first ODI. But the job is half done. He now needs to convert it into a big score. All of his team mates are on their feet applauding. He acknowledges it with a bat raise. Hint of space outside off and Fernando dabs it down to third man
Bhuvneshwar to Avishka Fernando, no run, 124.7kph back of a length delivery, Fernando drops it near backward point and searches for a single, sent back
Krunal Pandya to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, drifting into the pads, Fernando nurdles it round the corner and retains strike

Krunal Pandya to Avishka Fernando, FOUR, fabulous shot! Much needed one. First boundary after 97 balls. He has been playing the inside out drive but this was the inside out loft, struck it over extra cover and the ball sped away to the fence
Krunal Pandya to Avishka Fernando, no run, slower and hint of turn, Fernando pokes it in front of backward point
Krunal Pandya to Avishka Fernando, no run, flighted outside off, Fernando pushes it straight to extra cover
Krunal Pandya to de Silva, 1 run, flatter and outside off, de Silva directs it in front of square and towards sweeper cover
Krunal Pandya to de Silva, 2 runs, comes down the track and is met by a shortened length, nudged through mid-wicket and the pair scamper back for the second
Bhuvneshwar to Avishka Fernando, no run, 130.3kph delivery arrowed in on off, Fernando blocks it back to Bhuvi
Bhuvneshwar to de Silva, 1 run, 127.2kph good length ball outside off, de Silva dabs it fine and thinks about the second, not there
Bhuvneshwar to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, not all that short but Fernando still managed to play the cross-batted shot, struck it along the ground and straight to deep mid-wicket
Bhuvneshwar to de Silva, 1 run, strays onto the pads and is picked away in front of square, just a single
Bhuvneshwar to de Silva, no run, bit of extra lift on this delivery, hit the good length spot and climbed more than de Silva expected, he softened his grip and stabbed it safely into the off-side
Bhuvneshwar to de Silva, no run, good length ball around off, de Silva defends with the bat and pad close together
Krunal Pandya to Avishka Fernando, no run, much wider and Fernando has to reach for it, mistimed to cover
Krunal Pandya to de Silva, 1 run, tossed up around off, de Silva drives to long-off
Krunal Pandya to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, bit more flight and Fernando stays forward to ease it to long-off
Krunal Pandya to de Silva, 1 run, quicker and flatter, de Silva directs it square past point and rotates the strike
Krunal Pandya to de Silva, no run, shortens the length, de Silva sits back and knocks it to Krunal
Krunal Pandya to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, gives a bit of room and slaps it along the ground to long-off
Kuldeep Yadav to de Silva, no run, googly and de Silva did not pick it, closed the bat face and the leading edge rolls in front of backward point
Kuldeep Yadav to de Silva, no run, floated up and drawing de Silva into the drive, off the inner half and back to Kuldeep
Kuldeep Yadav to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, tossed up around off, Fernando punches it to long-off

Chahal to Rajapaksa, out Caught by Ishan Kishan!! There's not an iota of luck in this one. It's just dreamy leg-break bowling. So Chahal welcomes Rajapaksa with a top-spinner, drifting across just outside off, dipping in front of him to draw him onto the forward defence, only to then hold its line, and take the slightest of kisses on the outside edge through to the keeper. Rajapaksa c Ishan Kishan b Chahal 0(1)

Chahal to M Bhanuka, out Caught by Manish Pandey!! And much like the recent Sri Lankan batting trend, Bhanuka throws it away. He's danced down, made Chahal's delivery into a loopy full toss, and shockingly has picked out short mid-wicket to perfection with his flick. Real soft stuff. Real loose stuff. Real greedy stuff. And for India, real lucky stuff. M Bhanuka c Manish Pandey b Chahal 36(42) [4s-6]

Chahal to M Bhanuka, 1 run, full, on off, leaning flick, mid-wicket

Chahal to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, a forward pressy push, through sweeper

Chahal to Avishka Fernando, no run, full, drifting into the legs, something Fernando makes room to in squeezing back down the pitch

Bhuvneshwar to Avishka Fernando, no run .. and there's the inswinger. But on a back of a length, and safely outside off for Fernando to block it off his back foot
Bhuvneshwar to Avishka Fernando, no run, a tad wider, sixth-stump perhaps, good length, swinging away. Left

Bhuvneshwar to Avishka Fernando, 2 runs, edged, but just wide of second slip. Well, well. Another seam-up outswinger on that fourth-stump channel, and Fernando has an angled-batted push at it, with the ball flying off the outside edge, past a diving Pandey
Bhuvneshwar to Avishka Fernando, no run, 121.2kph, a slight shuffle across, tapping the outswinger towards cover

Rahul Chahar to Ramesh Mendis, 1 run, SL win! Swept through square leg to prevent the whitewash. Ramesh Mendis trusting the sweep to get there against Rahul Chahar

Tossed up on the stumps, Dananjaya makes room and drives beautifully in the air, well wide of extra-cover. In the gap and it is four. The umpires make the no-ball call even as Dananjaya signals for the free-hit while running

Rahul Chahar to Karunaratne, out Stumped!! Brilliant from both Rahul Chahar and Samson. The bowler landing the ball on a length, drawing Karunaratne forward and beating the defence with a sharp turner. Samson was alert to whip the bails off and Karunaratne had dragged his back foot out of the crease. Can Sri Lanka still choke from here? Don't rule it out yet! Karunaratne st Samson b Rahul Chahar 3(10)
Rahul Chahar to Karunaratne, no run, the googly, a bit too full and smothered
Rahul Chahar to Ramesh Mendis, 1 run, there comes the sweep. His go-to shot. Gets it behind square

Rahul Chahar to Ramesh Mendis, no run, woah! Caught at slip and the Indians are excited. But Dharmasena - who has had a poor game so far - shakes his head. Off the back thigh and a top call from Dharmasena. Ripper of a leggie, opens Ramesh Mendis up completely on the back foot defence. Missed the edge and a good take by Dhawan but all to no avail
Chetan Sakariya to Karunaratne, no run, pushes this length ball outside off to backward point and shouts 'no' immediately

Chetan Sakariya to Karunaratne, no run, back of the hand slower delivery, grips a little but Karunaratne has it covered with a block
Rahul Chahar to Ramesh Mendis, no run, that is the one where he comes around the umpire to bowl. Seen that many times in the IPL. Tempter of a leggie outside off, left alone

Rahul Chahar to Karunaratne, no run, slightly not full, allows Karunaratne to adjust and defend that safely back down the track

Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, out Caught by Prithvi Shaw!! Shaw catches that. But has it come too late for India? Spitting cobra [leggie] from a good length, Avishka Fernando who has played so well so far, gets forward to defend but the ball turns ever so slightly to take a thick edge which is gobbled up by gully. Rahul Chahar to Ramesh Mendis, 1 run, shortish leggie outside off, chopped away to sweeper cover

Hardik Pandya to Avishka Fernando, no run, short of length on the stumps, defended

Rahul Chahar just doing the simple thing by tossing it up outside off and asking the batsman to make a mistake. Ramesh Mendis almost obliges with a weak push

Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, tossed up outside off, Avishka Fernando gets forward and drives to long-off
