Gowtham to Asalanka, no run, Gowtham applauds that effort by Saini at backward point. The pacer dives to his right and cuts off runs. Asalanka steered that late but a good fielding effort means it is a dot
Gowtham to Asalanka, 2 runs, flat on the stumps, Asalanka gets low and paddles it fine of fine leg for two
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, gets forward and eases it to long-on

Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, no run, dropped! Manish Pandey it is at mid-wicket. Tough catch but Pandey is a very good fielder, flicked powerfully after stepping out and the pace on that made the ball burst through Pandey's hands. He tried to gather the rebound, but it landed out of his reach
Hardik Pandya to Asalanka, no run, sharp bouncer, but down leg, Asalanka lets it go
Hardik Pandya to Asalanka, no run, overpitched around off, Asalanka drives sweetly but can't thread it in the gap. Finds mid-off
Hardik Pandya to Asalanka, no run, slower delivery on off, Asalanka gets forward to defend solidly to mid-off
Hardik Pandya to Asalanka, no run, down leg, Asalanka closes the face of the bat too early and misses the flick. Takes one on the thigh pad
Hardik Pandya to Asalanka, 2 runs, pitched up outside off, Asalanka opens the face of the bat and drives wide of the diving backward point fielder, two more
Hardik Pandya to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, he is banging the pitch hard as he always likes to do. This is outside off and Avishka Fernando steers it to third man
Hardik Pandya to Avishka Fernando, wide, Samson appeals but that is nowhere close to the bat or glove. Short and down leg, Avishka Fernando swings and misses

Gowtham to Asalanka, FOUR, that must be the slowest an international fielder has run to save a ball which was not travelling that fast. Is Saini injured? Otherwise it is a shambolic effort. Gowtham can only smile. Well-played by Asalanka as he waited for the ball to turn and tapped it on its head, directed it wide of Saini at short third and the rest you know
Gowtham to Asalanka, no run, slides on to off, Asalanka defends from the crease to backward point
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, bit more air, Avishka Fernando gets forward to drive to long-on
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, no run, flat length ball, punched back down the track
Gowtham to Asalanka, 1 run, soft hands on the forward-defence, wide of cover for a quick single
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, shortish, flattish offbreak, nudged to the left of short fine

Navdeep Saini to Asalanka, no run, Asalanka had to wait for that slower one to arrive and when it does, he can only take it on the full and drive it to point. One hand came off the bat handle as he played that
Navdeep Saini to Asalanka, no run, rising short ball, Asalanka rises too and drops it near his feet
Navdeep Saini to Asalanka, no run, short and outside off, Asalanka thought about the slash/cut but decides against it
Navdeep Saini to Asalanka, 2 runs, full on the pads, flicked to the right of deep square leg, quick running gives them an easy two
Navdeep Saini to Asalanka, no run, short but doesn't rise high, Asalanka sits and sways away to leave
Navdeep Saini to Asalanka, no run, full and outside off, the sucker delivery, Asalanka lets it go
Chetan Sakariya to Asalanka, 1 run, predictable from Chetan Sakariya. The same delivery and Asalanka nudges it around the corner

Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, the back of the hand slower one, but on a fullish length, Avishka Fernando waits and taps softly to third man for a single. The key there was Fernando didn't press forward like Dhananjaya
Chetan Sakariya to Asalanka, 1 run, dug in short, on the stumps, short-arm jabbed to deep square
Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, round the wicket to Avishka Fernando now and fullish outside off, steered safely to third man
Chetan Sakariya to Asalanka, 1 run, full outside off, Asalanka drives hard but straight to the fielder at sweeper cover

Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, no ball, 1 run, and again. This is poor from Chetan Sakariya. Maybe he is trying too hard. Swung though as he attempted the yorker, turned out to be a low full-toss, swung away behind square

Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, no ball, another back of the hand slower delivery but this doesn't bounce as much and more importantly Avishka Fernando has compactly defended this off the back foot. Uh-oh! Chetan Sakariya has overstepped again. Free-hit coming up
Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, no run, full and just outside off, Avishka Fernando pushes it to mid-on
Navdeep Saini to Asalanka, no run, angled across on a short of length, Asalanka lifts his bat and lets it go

Navdeep Saini to Asalanka, no run, where is Avishka Fernando running to? Direct hit and gone. Dravid has his hands on his head and smiles. Defended to cover and for some reason Fernando set off. No run there, but luckily for him the fielder missed
Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, back of a length outside off, dabbed down to third man
Navdeep Saini to Asalanka, 1 run, fullish on the pads, Asalanka nudges it through square leg and they are happy with just one
Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, short of length and angled in, Avishka Fernando clips it to fine leg
Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, no run, fullish outside off, Avishka Fernando gets forward and eases it to the backward point fielder

Chetan Sakariya to de Silva, out Caught&Bowled!! What has happened there? That is the back of the hand slower delivery and it has completely done de Silva in. The batsman came forward to defend but is surprised by the extra bounce from a good length, tries to defend, but it takes the glove and lobs straight up, Chetan Sakariya runs forward to complete the catch. Is that the opening India need? de Silva c and b Chetan Sakariya 2(9)
Chetan Sakariya to de Silva, no run, overpitched outside off, de Silva gets forward and drives nicely, but can't beat cover
Chetan Sakariya to de Silva, no run, short of length on the thigh, de Silva misses and is struck on the thigh pad. Too high to be given LBW

Chetan Sakariya to de Silva, no run, has that pitched outside leg? Must have. No it is a thick inside edge onto the pad. That saves de Silva. Chetan Sakariya too realises that and aborts his appeal for LBW. Full and de Silva in trying to flick, got an edge
Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, short of length outside off, dabbed down to third man
Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, wide, slips it down leg, wide called
Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, no run, short of length on off, Avishka Fernando stabs it straight to the fielder at backward point
Rahul Chahar to de Silva, no run, tossed up just outside off, de Silva gets forward to block
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, flat delivery on off, speared through, Avishka Fernando flat-bats to long-on
Rahul Chahar to de Silva, no ball, 1 run, shortish googly, de Silva picks it and works it to deep mid-wicket. Rahul Chahar has overstepped and it will be a free-hit
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, slower on middle and leg, Avishka Fernando gets forward and pushes this to long-on
Rahul Chahar to de Silva, 1 run, sliding down, flat, turned around the corner
Rahul Chahar to de Silva, no run, tossed up outside off, de Silva gets forward and defends with an open bat face to backward point
Rahul Chahar to de Silva, no run, tossed up on off, de Silva gets forward to block

Chetan Sakariya to Rajapaksa, out Caught by Gowtham!! Can this be caught? Yes and what a good catch it is too. Gowtham with a running take to his right at fine leg. Chetan Sakariya has his arms aloft in celebration. Maiden ODI wicket for him. Big moment for him. Short ball, down leg, Rajapaksa helps this along and it's not an easy catch but Gowtham covered good ground before tumbling to take it cleanly. India needed this badly. After the wicket, Dhawan has a little pep talk with the team, geeing them on. Rajapaksa c Gowtham b Chetan Sakariya 65(56) [4s-12]

Chetan Sakariya to Rajapaksa, FOUR, that is a shocking drop by Nitish Rana at deep square. Third time Rajapaksa has been let-off by India today. Pulled straight to Rana and he goes reverse-cup with two hands, but the ball bursts through. Chetan Sakariya is a disappointed man. What's worse is that the ball has bounced away to the boundary
Chetan Sakariya to Rajapaksa, no run, short of length on off, tucked to mid-on
Chetan Sakariya to Rajapaksa, 2 runs, slower delivery outside off on a length, Rajapaksa drives on the rise, wide of sweeper for two

Chetan Sakariya to Rajapaksa, no run, Chetan Sakariya appeals for LBW but Dharmasena shakes his head and he is right. Full and speared in at the toes, Rajapaksa flicks and misses. Rapped on the pad but going down
Chetan Sakariya to Rajapaksa, no run, good stop by the diving cover fielder. Rajapaksa charges Chetan Sakariya and drills the drive but is intercepted with a dive
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, 1 run, nudged softly in front of square leg, and despite the slight miscommunication, they'll sneak in the single eventually
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, no run, flat, on the stumps, defended back
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, FOUR, just a tad short, and Gowtham's pace is more than enough for Rajapaksa to use the width to dab it past the keeper. Some nice easy run-milking here
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, flat, full, on the legs, clipped round the corner
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, no run, forward, tossed up on off, wristed out, short mid-wicket
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, no run, walks entirely across his stumps, jabbing it to leg
Chetan Sakariya to Rajapaksa, no run, 128kph, length, on middle, shuffling nudge to mid-wicket
Chetan Sakariya to Rajapaksa, no run, gets squared up on this away-nipper, skewing off the thick outside-half to backward point

Chetan Sakariya to Rajapaksa, FOUR, quick sharp short one. Rajapaksa finds himself in an awkward cramped position as he pulls, gets one hand off his bat handle as well, but has enough meat off the toe-edge to fly quickly into fine leg
Chetan Sakariya to Rajapaksa, no run, back of a length, and a shocking defence down the wrong line entirely, much like a new batsman to the crease
Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, 124.2kph, leg-lined now, glanced behind square
Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, no run, 126.6kph, back of a length tummy-line, hurried defence back
Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, no run, full, on off, Rajapaksa gets across and drives it back down the pitch
Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, FOUR, and now rubs it in with some extravaganza. He reverses, against the spin, behind point. There really aren't many better ways to be getting to your maiden fifty

Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, FOUR, another tough drop. Rajapaksa slogs this alright, flat, and Sakaraiya, after running across to his right from deep square leg, gets it overhead, but the pace on the ball gets it to pop over
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, short, flat, on middle, tucked round the corner
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, no run, loopy in-drifter on the legs, Fernando, with his advance, takes it on the full, and nurdles it to short mid-wicket
Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, 1 run, a dance, getting yorked, to hoick it off the toe-end to long-off
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, no run, sticks a touch in the pitch as Fernando looks to shuffle and tuck, only to lose shape and end up chipping, again, safely, in front of mid-wicket
Nitish Rana to Rajapaksa, 1 run, full, leg-lined, wristed into mid-wicket

Nitish Rana to Rajapaksa, 2 runs, top-edges this slog-sweep, fetching it from well outside off. But luckily for him, there's nobody at deep mid-wicket. Gowtham sweeps across from deep square leg, flicking it back in
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, flat, length, shuffling nudge round the corner
Nitish Rana to Rajapaksa, 1 run, full, on off, and a neat checked steer wide of point for a quick one
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, flat, short, on-punch to long-on
Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, no run, forward, lining it up, and nudging with the spin to leg, defensively
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, nicely flighted up, full, on middle. Fernando steps away a touch and drives through the line, with the spin, to long-off
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, no run, presses forward on the defence, as the leg-break grips and rips past
Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, 1 run, another charge, this time with a hoick. Miscued. But falls well short of long-on

Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, FOUR, steps out, steps away, and goes inside-out. Chahar, in fact, darted it wider on spotting Rajapaksa in his advancing act, but it doesn't matter, his levers are long enough, and so is his connection
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, slowly spinning in from middle, Fernando lines it up, has all the time to, and nurdles into square leg
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, nudges it off his legs round the corner, and gets himself his fifth ODI fifty. It's been really neat
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, no run, full, tossed up around the stumps, driven down to the bowler's right who dives and stops

Nitish Rana to Rajapaksa, 1 run, dropped. A slog-sweep he doesn't fully get hold of, dragging off the inside-half, and Dhawan flies full-length to his left at short mid-wicket, gets his hands to the ball as well, but just doesn't hold on
Nitish Rana to Rajapaksa, no run, full, on middle, a bat-pad stuck forward defence
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, flatter, on off, and quite softly tucked away after the initial shuffle, round the corner
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, no run, full, wide, squeezy-slap to cover
Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, 2 runs, cheeky stuff, using Chahar's pace on offer with an early shuffling sit, and a scoop over leg-slip
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, overpitched outside off, driven with the spin, down to long-off
Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, 1 run, flat, on the legs, tucked wide of mid-wicket

Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, byes, FOUR, beats everyone. So Fernando dances down, is nowhere to the pitch of it, and the ball spins in sharply down leg. Samson, probably blinded by the batsman, doesn't go leg-sided, and leg-slip doesn't dive either
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, flat, quite short, on the hips, tucked away into mid-wicket
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, no run, short, spinning away, a backing-away defensive punch to keep it out
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, a walking drive through the line, down to long-off
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, no run, looped, full, on off, solid, quiet, block
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, no run, too wide, but Fernando still cannot cut it away right, stabbing it straight to point
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, no run, fuller, drawing him forward in defence
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, no run, slower, shorter, spinning in sharply to cramp a room-making Fernando, who can only keep it out
Nitish Rana to Avishka Fernando, no run, flat, short, outside off. Fernando shuffles across and punches it back down the pitch
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, no run, tossed up on off, leaning smother
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, dances down, but settles for a quiet punch to long-on
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, no run, very full, on off, squeezed back down
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 2 runs, full, but leg-lined, and a leaning nudge to short fine leg
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, wide, and back overcompensating with one spinning well down leg

Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, FOUR, delicate. Deft. Classy. Gowtham darts it flat. short, with a lot of room. And Fernando, instead of going hard, stays back in the crease and dabs it deliciously past the keeper
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, leg byes, 2 runs, spinning in sharply from middle, past the glance, but kissing the thigh pad past the keeper

Hardik Pandya to Rajapaksa, FOUR, overpitched, with width, and Rajapaksa leans, driving off a bent knee, through extra cover. Sakariya sweeps across in the deep, dives, gets a palm but deflects it onto himself with ball bouncing off him into the ropes
Hardik Pandya to Rajapaksa, wide, 136.8kph, quick, down leg, back of a length, past the nurdle, without a tickle
Hardik Pandya to Rajapaksa, no run, 137.1kph, length, off-lined, skidding through as Rajapaksa hurries in defence
Hardik Pandya to Rajapaksa, no run, 138.8kph, back of a length, just outside off, shuffling defence

Hardik Pandya to Rajapaksa, FOUR, another jaffa of an in-nipper, cutting Rajapaksa in half as he weaves his bat inside in desperation, getting a slight tickle off the inside-edge past the diving keeper
Hardik Pandya to Rajapaksa, no run, full, just outside off, pushed straight to cover
Hardik Pandya to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, nipping into the legs, glanced to fine leg
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, flat, angling in on middle and leg, tucked wide of mid-wicket for a quick one. A better pick up from Hardik could've made things close
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, 1 run, a mistimed slice, but no worries, there's no extra cover in the ring
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, no run, goes sweeping, misses, gets struck on the front leg. But this one's much simpler, it's clearly going down leg
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, no run, big plonk in front, pushing it away

Gowtham to Rajapaksa, no run, flat, angling in, with Rajapaksa playing for spin and playing entirely down the wrong line to end up getting struck on the back leg. Well, well. The LBW appeal did sound really good. But India don't review, perhaps suspecting an inside-edge. Oh, also, HawkEye tells us it's too high
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, forward, wristing it down to long-on
Hardik Pandya to Rajapaksa, FOUR, typically short again. Rajapaksa goes for a hook, gets a glove, and gets it lobbing over the keeper
Hardik Pandya to Rajapaksa, FOUR, pulled with some swagger into cow corner. Rajapaksa rises with the bounce, one-legged, and swats

Hardik Pandya to Rajapaksa, no run, 133.3kph, good sharp quick bouncer, Rajapaksa jumps up with it, getting into a slightly awkward position, but safely fending it away by his feet. Oh in fact he's jammed it off his glove onto his helmet, and it looks like he needs some sort of treatment on his thumb
Hardik Pandya to Rajapaksa, 2 runs, throws his hands at it, somehow inside-outing this slice over extra cover. No real control behind this, with Pandya's slower one nearly foxing Rajapaksa here
Hardik Pandya to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, straying into the legs, clipped to deep square leg
Hardik Pandya to Avishka Fernando, 2 runs, in-angling tummy-line, and a hopping, shuffling glance round the corner
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, no run, teaser just outside off, and left alone
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, no run, again, tight on the stumps, a bit of a push from Rajapaksa down the pitch
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, no run, on middle, good length, full-faced forward smother
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, FOUR, neat. It's the arm ball from Gowtham, but Rajapaksa, after backing away, finds a way to chop this from a leg-stump line through point and cover
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, fuller, drawing Fernando forward for a flicky-defence to mid-on
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, no run, spins in big, something Fernando covers off his back foot and tucks to mid-wicket
Navdeep Saini to Rajapaksa, no run, cuts him in half. Sharp jag in, sneaking well under Rajapaksa's loose short arm jab
Navdeep Saini to Rajapaksa, FOUR, tries cutting it through the covers, but somehow has dragged this straight down the ground. The ball doesn't quite come on to the bat
Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, a pretty loose wafty drive away from his body, outside-halving it to third man
Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, no run, nips in again, around off, quietly nudged around to leg
Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, no run, 135.4kph, in-nipping back of a length, shuffling block, dropping it by his feet
Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, 2 runs, a chipped glance off his legs, through square leg
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, no run, forward, lining it up and keeping it out
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, pitched up, around off, driven down to long-on
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, no run, shuffle, closing his bat-face and knocking it around to mid-wicket
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, 1 run, drifting into the toes, clipped round the corner. First runs ..
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, flat, back of a length, spinning in and cramping Fernando up, who can only just tuck it round the corner
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, no run, flat, spinning in on off, shuffling back-footed, straight-batted defence
Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, no run, steps out a touch, gets too close for comfort, and can only dig it out
Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, no run, spinning in on off, solidly blocked
Rahul Chahar to Rajapaksa, no run, loopy yorker, and Rajapaksa can only jam it back down the pitch
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, quick shuffle, taking it off his legs and tucking it into mid-wicket
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, no run, forward, pushed out to extra cover
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, FOUR, overcooked freebie outside off. Fernando lays in, leaning, flaying, through extra cover
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, no run, grip, bounce, rip -- drawing Rajapaksa forward just outside off, only to spin past his defensive poke
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, no run, again, full, on off, shuffling forward block
Gowtham to Rajapaksa, no run, tossed up on middle, and Rajapaksa shows respect, full-faced

Gowtham to M Bhanuka, out Caught by Chetan Sakariya!! Sweeps, and sweeps it straight to square leg. It's not the most planned maiden dismissal, but surely Gowtham won't complain. Bhanuka'a walked across his stumps to a very full delivery, gone sweeping almost in premeditation, hasn't gotten under the length, and has ended up finding square leg in the circle to perfection. Too impatient, too soon. M Bhanuka c Chetan Sakariya b Gowtham 7(17) [4s-1]
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, flat, full, on middle, wristed away through mid-wicket
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, 5 wides, another nervous line down leg. Fernando now shuffles early, sits, slog-sweeps, misses. And worse, the keeper misses too
Gowtham to Avishka Fernando, FOUR, real juicy drag down this, spinning in as well to end up down leg. Fernando swivels, heaves, gets it safely behind square
Rahul Chahar to M Bhanuka, no run, spinning away off a length, something Bhanuka looks to flick, only to end up with a leading-edge down the pitch
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, a little too full, as Fernando leans out to the pitch of it in driving through the line to long-off
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, no run, sharp rip, outside off, and Fernando half-pokes away from his body, half-leaves, gets fully beaten
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, no run, tossed up outside off, squirted off the outside-edge to point
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, no run, missed slog. It's the leggie, and Fernando plays all around it to get struck on the body in front of middle. Never mind, it's pitching down leg
Rahul Chahar to Avishka Fernando, no run, googly to start, quick, off a length, skidding in, hurried back-foot block
Chetan Sakariya to M Bhanuka, no run, beats the flashy punch. Nips in sharply, gets a bit of extra bounce spitting over the cramped attempt
Chetan Sakariya to M Bhanuka, FOUR, 129.9kph, bang in the slot .. and Bhanuka gets the release, slicing it uppishly, straight down the ground
Chetan Sakariya to M Bhanuka, no run, 128.8kph, slightly shorter. Bhanuka shapes up to cut, but doesn't quite have the width to be doing it, inside-halving it instead towards cover
Chetan Sakariya to M Bhanuka, no run, 128.1kph, much tighter, on a length, on off, defended
Chetan Sakariya to M Bhanuka, no run, 131.7kph, stays back, using the in-angle to work it to mid-wicket
Chetan Sakariya to M Bhanuka, no run, a neat cover punch, so neat that it finds cover straight
Navdeep Saini to M Bhanuka, 1 run, length, just outside off, dabbed down to third man

Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, 3 runs, 138kph, pretty short, outside off, and Fernando waits for it on his back foot to punch away through sweeper. And Pandey's chase-cum-dive by the boundary saves one whole run
Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, no run, 142.8kph, back of a length just outside off, shuffling knock to mid-wicket
Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, no run, fifth-stump just outside off, punched away to mid-off
Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, no run, 139.2kph, fuller, getting Fernando driving, as he checks his shot, chipping in the end, and Dhawan dives at mid-off to cut it off
Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, SIX, 136.9kph, pace, down leg, a sitter of a length. Fernando whips, gets enough bat, and flies easily over fine leg
Chetan Sakariya to M Bhanuka, no run, pitched up outside off, Bhanuka premeditates a big full-blooded cut, and isn't even close to connecting
Chetan Sakariya to M Bhanuka, no run, 129.4kph, shuffling across on the back foot, blocking back
Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, 126.3kph, tummy-lined, tucked away wristily behind square
Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, no run, length, around off, punched back down the pitch
Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, FOUR, length, width, and nicely sitting up as Fernando walks across, frees up his hands, and slaps it through sweeper
Chetan Sakariya to Avishka Fernando, no run, sharp in-jagger off a cramping back of a length, getting Fernando hopping awkwardly as he jabs his bat in the way and keeps it out
Navdeep Saini to M Bhanuka, no run, a no-feet swat across the line, and finds it whizzing over
Navdeep Saini to M Bhanuka, no run, back of a length again, into the body, and another leg-clearing pull, mistiming it to mid-on
Navdeep Saini to M Bhanuka, wide, a leg-cleared big flashy slap. Saini's smartly anticipated though, and has slipped it wide across off. Alas, too far says the umpire
Navdeep Saini to M Bhanuka, no ball, 137.4kph, sharp quick bouncer, hurrying Bhanuka up, who's quick to duck. Meanwhile, Saini has overstepped
Navdeep Saini to M Bhanuka, no run, 139kph, length, on off, a lined up, slightly squared up, defence
Navdeep Saini to M Bhanuka, 2 runs, 141.5kph, streaky leading-edge, with Bhanuka looking to flick across the line, and ending up with squirting it over short cover. Just sheer pace ..
Navdeep Saini to M Bhanuka, no run, nice fizzy shape away, seam-up, going across off a back of a length, and Bhanuka half-pokes off his back foot
Navdeep Saini to Avishka Fernando, 1 run, 140kph, gentle away-seam, off a length outside off, something Fernando lines up off his back foot and punches neatly through the covers

Chameera to Navdeep Saini, out Caught by Avishka Fernando!! Chameera ends the innings. India have been bowled out with almost four overs to go. Fantastic short ball, at the chest of Navdeep Saini who can only fend at it, the extra pace of Chameera means that the ball carries to the backward point fielder running in. Dananjaya to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, short, flat, outside off, spinning away. Slapped through sweeper
Dananjaya to Prithvi Shaw, no run, forward lean, nudging it away through square leg
Dananjaya to Samson, 1 run, full, flat, leg-break. Samson stays deep in his crease, and knocks it somewhere into mid-wicket
Jayawickrama to Samson, 1 run, flat, on the legs, tucked away behind square
Jayawickrama to Samson, no run, fired in full on middle, squeezed back
Jayawickrama to Samson, no run, defends forward, skewing off the outside half towards short third man softly
Jayawickrama to Samson, wide, down leg, past the glance, and the keeper quickly gets across, pouches, and appeals for a strangle down. Nope, the umpire isn't getting fooled
Jayawickrama to Samson, FOUR, wow. A dance, a room-making, and then an inside-out loft over extra cover. Not Suryakumar good, but still, really, really good.
Jayawickrama to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, fuller, but still pretty wide. Shaw slaps, not with the fullest of timing, through the covers
Jayawickrama to Prithvi Shaw, no run, slingy, flat, outside off, Shaw makes room and flays it to backward point
Dananjaya to Samson, no run, across, forward, knocking back down the pitch
Dananjaya to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, leg-spin, on middle, and it doesn't look like Shaw's picked it early, but does well to outside-half it off his front-footed defence, behind point
Dananjaya to Samson, 1 run, full, loopy, base of off, squeezed down to long-on off a high backlift
Dananjaya to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, a quick back-foot shuffle, tucking softly round the corner
Dananjaya to Samson, 1 run, spinning into the pads, helped along behind square
Dananjaya to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, big forward lean, opening his bat face and poking it to point

Karunaratne to Samson, FOUR, back of a length, sitting up, and Samson stands up tall to pull along the ground. In fact the ball's hit one of the birds on the outfield and slowed down a touch. But never mind, no damage, no worries
Karunaratne to Samson, no run, goes short, well outside off though, and Samson doesn't go chasing
Karunaratne to Samson, no run, 130.5kph, full, slanting in on off, wristed, short mid-wicket
Karunaratne to Samson, no run, 133.5kph, full, just outside off, driven out to cover
Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, a bit of width, and slashed down to third man
Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, no run, 137.1kph, overcooked, and hard solid slap down the pitch, but not quite off the middle, and Karunaratne's in the way
Dananjaya to Samson, no run, tossed up just outside off, gets forward and taps it to cover
Dananjaya to Samson, no run, wristed away wide of mid-wicket, and both of them want the single, but for some reason get confused and go back to their respective ends
Dananjaya to Samson, SIX, a flat googly -- and Samson's on the dance down the track, freeing up his arms up get the swing, and smokes it straight back into the sightscreen
Dananjaya to Samson, no run, leg-spin, looped up outside off, teasing Samson as he gets forward to leave
Dananjaya to Samson, no run, off-break, spinning in from off, and taking the inside of Samson's flick to end up at short fine leg
Dananjaya to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, drifting into the legs, forward flicky-punch to long-on
Karunaratne to Samson, no run, cutter, good length, fifth-stump, slight in-nip. Left alone

Karunaratne to Samson, FOUR, loose cut, top-edged, and some lazy fielding at third man. Samson sees the width and throws his bat out, and Akila after running across, doesn't cover the line and just sticks his hand out in hope. Nah, can't touch it
Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, 132kph, full, pad-lined, flicked away to deep mid-wicket
Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, no run, length, cutting in and sticking a touch in the pitch as Shaw ends up mistiming his punch off the inside-half
Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, no run, 125.1kph, and Shaw - the compulsive puller - continues pulling them compulsively. It's short, high, and going over his head, over his bat
Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, no run, opens his bat face and punches it to cover
Dananjaya to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, across, punching it away into mid-wicket
Dananjaya to Prithvi Shaw, no run, the top-spinner, and Shaw gets across and nudges it straight to square leg
Dananjaya to Prithvi Shaw, no run, leg-break, full, floated up, drawing him forward to push through the line, defensively
Dananjaya to Prithvi Shaw, no run, the googly, kept out off a shuffling back-footed defence
Dananjaya to Prithvi Shaw, no run, leans forward, pressy, and punching it to cover
Dananjaya to Samson, 1 run, looped up full on off. Samson tries cover-driving, and ends up squirting it off the toe-end down to long-on
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, no run, 138kph, another quick short one. Ducked
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, no run, bounces him, Shaw takes it on with a hook, but gets beaten for pace and doesn't connect
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, 144.1kph, short, sitting up with width, and slapped on the up, bounce-riding, through sweeper.
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, no run, 137kph, bouncer, in-angling, ducking
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, no run, a forward press, with Chameera shortening his length a touch, to get tapped to point
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, pure Shaw things -- high backlift, high elbow, and punching it off the front foot straight down the ground. It really wasn't all that bad a delivery, it really wasn't
Karunaratne to Samson, no run, fuller, swinging away, outside off. Samson reaches out trying to squeeze, but pulls out
Karunaratne to Samson, no run, 131.9kph, gentle outswing, but again in that channel outside off, and Samson keeps leaving
Karunaratne to Samson, no run, 133.5kph, sixth-stump, good length. holding its line. Samson doesn't bother
Karunaratne to Samson, 2 runs, 134.4kph, nipping in on middle, Samson sticks his pad across the line and nurdles it round the corner

Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, draws a drive away from his body, draws a thick edge, but well past slip. Karunaratne plays around with Shaw's ego, floating it full and wide. And Shaw being Shaw, goes chasing
Karunaratne to Samson, 1 run, 134kph, pretty full, angling in on off, flicked through mid-wicket
Chameera to Samson, 1 run, 145kph, short, angling down leg, hurrying Samson on his pull to end up off the glove tamely behind square
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, 147.6kph, length, sixth-stump, guided down to third man
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, no run, 143kph, sharp bouncer. something Shaw spots early to duck
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, no run, 141.6kph, back of a length tummy-line. Shuffling block
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, 2 runs, strays into the pads once again, clipped very fine too, but fine leg does pretty well to get across and put in the dive
Chameera to Samson, 1 run, thick leading-edge, as he tries nudging it to leg, and ends up getting it down to third man
Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, no run, another crisp full-faced punch, straight to mid-off
Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, neat. Proper beautiful hands flowing through the line with his square punch, and a slightly late dive from cover-point to be cutting this off
Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, no run, 127.4kph, on the back foot, nipping in, on-punch, mid-on
Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, wide, full, pretty wide to start with, and then nipping away further too. Left, claiming the extra
Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, no run, beaten. A pretty typical punch on the up, but Karunaratne manages to extract some extra zip off the deck, whizzing past the upper half
Karunaratne to Prithvi Shaw, no run, 132.5kph, tight top-of-off, shuffling defence back down the pitch
Karunaratne to Samson, 1 run, a steer, angle-batted, down to third man
Chameera to Samson, 1 run, straightening into the leg-stump, and tucked to a misfielding short mid-wicket to give him his first ODI runs ..
Chameera to Samson, no run, shuffles across a touch, punching it crisply to cover
Chameera to Samson, no run, back of a length, tummy-lined. A lined-up back-footed block

Chameera to Dhawan, out Caught by M Bhanuka!! Loose flashy drive. It's the perfect tempter right in that full, sixth-stump zone, and Dhawan falls for it, wafting hard with his front leg going nowhere. And thus the faint nick off the outside-edge. First blood, big blood. Dhawan c M Bhanuka b Chameera 13(11) [4s-3]
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, angling across, length, fifth-stump, guided down to third man
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, leg-lined, and clipped deliciously. There's never a shortage of timing when Shaw's playing them, and even his pad-glances are just as loud and crisp. Into fine leg

Dananjaya to Dhawan, no run, and another LBW appeal, only much, much closer. Alas, the wasted review still lingers strongly in Dasun's head to be going up for this. Never mind, it's off Dhawan's bat now, as he sticks his pad to it in forward defending

Dananjaya to Dhawan, no run, well, well, with one second left on the DRS clock, Sri Lanka have taken this LBW appeal upstairs. And it's a shocking one. Dhawan's stuck his front leg out and kicked it away, but Dananjaya's adamant this is the arm ball, and finds it spinning away well outside off
Dananjaya to Dhawan, no run, better. He finally gets it on the stumps, off a length, something Dhawan blocks softly
Dananjaya to Dhawan, FOUR, this one's a conventional drive. Another wide half volley, and a lean, and bisecting point and cover
Dananjaya to Dhawan, FOUR, and again, more loose. Dananjaya overpitches this with a lot of width, and Dhawan drills it all along the ground for a change, through the covers
Dananjaya to Dhawan, FOUR, loose stuff .. full, flat, way outside off. Dhawan lays in, flaying over extra cover

Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, FOUR, defended, and a boundary. Yep, exactly that. It's nipping in on off, and all Shaw wants to do with it is dab, but it hits the cut-strip behind the pitch and spits up to fly over slip
Chameera to Dhawan, 1 run, 142.7kph, open-batted steer, lining it up on the back foot and running it down to third man
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, 143.4kph, off-lined, half a forward lean, quietly blocking it towards cover
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, 141.7kph, length, tightening up on the top of off, Dhawan hangs back, sticks his bat out and dabs it around to slip
Chameera to Dhawan, no run, 138.7kph, pitched up, outside off, angling away. A pressy leave
Chameera to Dhawan, 5 wides, 136.8kph, inswing, pace, but wasted well down leg. Past the glance, past the diving keeper
Chameera to Prithvi Shaw, 1 run, 122.9kph, a decent start all through -- a neat length delivery just outside off, and a nice solid confident-looking forward punch, wide of mid-off

van Beek to Joshua Little, byes, 1 run, Netherlands steal a one-run thriller! What an absolute heist they've pulled off! Horror option from Little to be honest with fine leg back at the fence. Goes across early for the paddle scoop, gets duped by the slower ball and can't get bat on it. The Dutch players mobbing van Beek!
van Beek to Young, 1 run, slower ball outside off, steered away towards deep point. Just a single
van Beek to Joshua Little, 1 run, very full and outside off, almost a yorker, dug out towards backward point

van Beek to Joshua Little, FOUR, how has he gotten this away for a boundary! Wow! Slower ball way outside off, Little shuffles across the stumps and somehow brooms this away, beating a diving short fine leg fielder to his right. These twists are absolutely ruining my nerves I tell you. Ireland breath again with this blow
van Beek to Young, 1 run, very full and on leg stump, squeezed out off the inside half towards short fine leg. Just a single

van Beek to Simi Singh, out Simi Singh Run Out!! 1 run completed. This should be the game for Netherlands! Singh was always going to come back for the second run, the throw is good though and his dive isn't the perfect one. The bat bounces as the bails come off and that's the end of him, and probably, Ireland as well. Was a slower ball on leg stump, helped away behind square leg but Singh can't get the two he wanted. Simi Singh run out (Bas de Leede/Scott Edwards) 45(69) [4s-4]
van Beek to Simi Singh, wide, harsh call from the ump! Singh shuffled across early for the paddle scoop but missed it due to the slowness of the delivery. Went just over the leg pole but still wided

Fred Klaassen to Joshua Little, 2 runs, dropped! Deep mid-wicket was probably late to spot the ball and the dive in the end doesn't work. Ireland get a bonus brace as well. Little went for another slog, couldn't quite connect properly
Fred Klaassen to Joshua Little, no run, another swing and a miss! The wheels have truly come off now you'd think! Slow off-cutter, sticks off the deck and Little misses the slog once again

Fred Klaassen to Joshua Little, no run, pressure continues to mount on Ireland! Another off-pace ball, Little can only get a leading edge back towards Klaassen. What an over this is from the left-armer! Top class!
Fred Klaassen to Joshua Little, no run, huge heave attempt, misses! Another slower ball, grips off the deck and Little's slog can't connect. Ireland struggling big time now
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, 1 run, shorter and outside off, Singh makes room to punch it away but straight towards sweeper cover. Can only get a single and Netherlands will only be glad
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, no run, swing and a miss! Gives the charge early and makes room for the inside out loft but is deceived by the slower ball from Klaassen
van Beek to Joshua Little, no run, shorter and outside off, Little jabs this towards cover and wants the single but Simi Singh rightly sends him back
van Beek to Joshua Little, no run, fuller and attacking the stumps, driven firmly towards mid-on
van Beek to Simi Singh, 1 run, angling into the pads, nudged softly towards backward square leg and they pinch a single
van Beek to Joshua Little, 1 run, pitched up outside off, driven firmly off the front foot towards deep point. Gets Simi Singh back on strike
van Beek to Joshua Little, no run, back of a length outside off, extra bounce and Little is beaten on the cut
van Beek to Joshua Little, no run, fuller and attacking the stumps, bunted towards mid-on
Seelaar to Joshua Little, 1 run, flatter one outside off, Little lunges back and punches it just past the bowler, down to long-off. Was a bit uppish but well wide of Seelaar

Seelaar to McCarthy, out Caught by van Beek!! This game takes another crazy turn! Seelaar has another in the same over and this game is truly alive now. It's a duck for McCarthy. He was lunging at this one, trying to push at it and that's never a good idea on this tacky surface. Spoons a dolly to short cover where it's swallowed. All of a sudden, Ireland have gone from being favourites to being the underdogs. Cricket, you beauty! McCarthy c van Beek b Seelaar 0(3)
Seelaar to McCarthy, no run, flatter and on off stump, McCarthy lunges in defence once more
Seelaar to McCarthy, no run, fuller and outside off, blocked off the front foot

Seelaar to Andy McBrine, out Lbw!! Talk about instinctive captaincy paying off! Netherlands needed a wicket to stir the nest in the Irish camp and it's the hosts' skipper who has delivered. Brought himself on as a bait of sorts and gets rid of McBrine. This was a fastish slider, forcing the left-hander to play across the line but he ended up getting rapped on the pad. Seemed to be sliding down leg initially but the ump gave it OUT after a long pause. In the end, it's that on-field call that's undone McBrine as it's clipping leg stump on ball tracking. Surely there isn't another twist in this game!! Andy McBrine lbw b Seelaar 17(32) [4s-3]
Seelaar to Simi Singh, 1 run, fuller and outside off, driven firmly down the ground to long-off

van der Gugten to Andy McBrine, 2 runs, full toss but McBrine can't quite take full toll of it. Tried to heave it with too much power and ended up skewing it aerially over mid-wicket. Easily over the infield though and they'll get a brace
van der Gugten to Andy McBrine, no run, short of a length closer to off stump, defended well from the crease to cover
van der Gugten to Simi Singh, 1 run, angling in on a good length, steered away down to third man
van der Gugten to Andy McBrine, 1 run, banged in short around middle and leg, doesn't rise that much as McBrine swivel-pulls this down to fine leg
van der Gugten to Andy McBrine, no run, full and closer to the off pole, defended off the front foot to point
van der Gugten to Andy McBrine, no run, slanting in on off stump, on a good length, blocked off the back foot towards mid-wicket
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, no run, fuller and on off stump, Singh shuffles across a bit and blocks
Fred Klaassen to Andy McBrine, 1 run, shorter and angling in on leg stump, helped away down towards fine leg
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, 1 run, slanting in from around off, Singh steps out and makes room to drive this through point. Straight to the sweeper fielder
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, no run, use of the feet from Singh this time, looking for his loft but has to adjust with a push back to the bowler
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, no run, fuller again, angling in, Singh is once again solid in defence
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, no run, pitched up around off, slanting in, Singh defends
van der Gugten to Andy McBrine, no run, attacks the stumps with a fuller length, defended
van der Gugten to Andy McBrine, no run, shorter and around off, blocked from the crease

van der Gugten to Andy McBrine, no run, extra bounce from a shorter length, McBrine looks for the cut but is undone by the lift off the deck. Appeal for caught behind from van der Gugten but he was the only one appealing
van der Gugten to Andy McBrine, no run, back of a length outside off, McBrine dabs this towards backward point. Slight hesitation between the batsmen but eventually no harm done
van der Gugten to Simi Singh, 1 run, short of a length outside off, steered away down to third man

van der Gugten to Simi Singh, 2 runs, big miscue but clears mid-off easily! Slower ball from van Beek, saw Singh charging down the track and opted for the change-up. As a result, the loft isn't quite off the middle but Singh had enough power to clear the infield

Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, FOUR, the rub of the green clearly going Ireland's way! More luck for McBrine who wanted to steer this down to third man but there was simply no room for the shot. The two-paced nature of the deck doesn't help either and the big inside edge narrowly misses leg stump, beating Scott Edwards to his right and down to the fine leg fence
Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, wide, Glover's wide syndrome continues. Opts for the short of a length zone but sprays this way down the leg-side
Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, no run, sharp bumper around off, McBrine swivels on the pull but fails to connect. Good effort ball from Glover
Brandon Glover to Simi Singh, leg byes, 1 run, angling in on leg stump, Singh misses the flick and deflects this off the pads, down to fine leg
Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, 1 run, shorter and wider outside off, sliced away down towards third man
Brandon Glover to Simi Singh, 1 run, shorter and outside off, fended off the back foot towards cover-point. They pinch a single

Brandon Glover to Simi Singh, FOUR, absolutely bludgeoned! As he's gotten settled at the crease, Singh has started to open up a lot more now. Charged down early, made room and hammered this through the covers. Went like a bullet through the infield and to the fence in no time
van Beek to Andy McBrine, no run, fuller and closer to the off pole, defended from the crease
van Beek to Andy McBrine, no run, full and angling across McBrine who push-drives off the front foot towards cover
van Beek to Andy McBrine, no run, short of a length outside off, defended off the back foot towards point
van Beek to Andy McBrine, no run, sharp bumper around middle and off, McBrine is rushed on the pull and he misses

van Beek to Andy McBrine, FOUR, finds the edge but it splits the keeper and first slip! Huge groan from the Dutch fielders and van Beek. Rolled his fingers across on this one and tempted McBrine into a loose waft outside his off stump. Scott Edwards did try with a full-stretched dive across to his left but it evaded him and also sneaked past slip. What's worse for the hosts is that this has gone to the third man fence as well. Huge fortune for Ireland
van Beek to Simi Singh, 1 run, fuller and straighter in line, wristed away down the ground to long-on
Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, no run, shortish and closer to off stump, McBrine looks to cut but it keeps coming in with the angle, beating him on the inside edge. Wasn't far away from the off pole
Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, no run, skids off the deck from a shorter length, leg-lined and McBrine misses the flick
Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, no run, very full and around off, almost a yorker length and McBrine jams it out towards cover
Brandon Glover to Simi Singh, 1 run, very full and around off, Singh drives firmly to mid-off and had started running with the shot. Got brisk response from Andy McBrine too
Brandon Glover to Simi Singh, no run, short of a length outside off, width on offer and Singh cuts well but straight to backward point
Brandon Glover to Simi Singh, wide, there he goes again with another extra. Glover sprays this one well down leg and Seelar has an irritated expression on his face. Can't fault him to be honest

Brandon Glover to Simi Singh, wide, Netherlands have been guilty of bowling too many wides! Glover especially has been a big offender today. Starts with a shorter length ball but it's well wide outside off
Brandon Glover to Simi Singh, no run, attacks the stumps with a fuller length ball, blocked
van Beek to Andy McBrine, no run, shorter and outside off, fended off the back foot towards point
van Beek to Andy McBrine, no run, pitched up on off stump, McBrine defends solidly from the crease towards cover
van Beek to Andy McBrine, no run, fuller and on leg stump, nudged gently towards mid-wicket
van Beek to Andy McBrine, no run, beaten! Angling across from a good length, McBrine's feet go nowhere as he tries to poke at this one
van Beek to Simi Singh, 1 run, back of a length outside off, dabbed gently off the back foot towards point

van Beek to Simi Singh, FOUR, aggression from Simi! Doesn't want to let van Beek settle in a new spell. Charged down early and lofted this easily over the mid-on fielder. With the field up, that was always a percentage stroke

Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, FOUR, edged but well wide of the keeper! McBrine was trying to steer this towards third man but certainly not this fine. This in-angler straightened a tad off the deck as McBrine tried to push with soft hands. The edge flew well wide of Scott Edwards and raced away fine to the third man fence

Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, no run, loud LBW shout but it's going down leg with the angle! Was very full and angling into McBrine from wide of the crease, he failed to connect the flick and Glover went up in appeal quite strongly. Optimistic shout at best and rightly not reviewed by Seelar
Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, no run, shorter and wider outside off, crunchy back foot punch from McBrine but straight to backward point
Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, no run, back of a length on middle and off, McBrine gets behind the line nicely and defends
Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, no run, shorter and on a fourth stump line, no shot offered
Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, no run, fuller and closer to the off stump, McBrine defends on the front foot

Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, wide, make that three in a row! Glover and Netherlands surely can't afford these extras in such a low-scoring game. Glover goes short and ends up sliding this well down the leg-side. Frustration clearly visible on his face
Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, wide, overcompensates in line this time and goes shorter well wide outside off
Brandon Glover to Andy McBrine, wide, banged in short but sliding well down the leg-side, McBrine looked to help it on its way but missed
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, no run, pitched up on middle and leg, Simi is solid in his front foot defence once more
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, no run, fuller again, Singh once again drives sweetly but straight to mid-off
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, no run, pitched up on off stump, Singh presses forward and defends firmly
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, wide, strays in line and feeds this well down the leg-side
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, no run, slanting in from a good length, defended off the front foot
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, no run, short and rising off the deck, Singh got into a tangle fending this towards square leg
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, no run, full and angling in on middle and leg, blocked out down the track

van der Gugten to Stirling, out Caught by Seelaar!! Smashed hard but straight to cover! There is the breakthrough Netherlands were desperate for and what a massive strike it is. Not a wicket-taking delivery from van der Gugten to be honest, was full and in the slot, tempting Stirling to go for the booming drive. He does so and connects well too, but can't keep it down and picks out the Dutch captain to perfection. A very sharp catch and the game is back on level terms now. Stirling falls after an impressive knock but he'll know that he should have seen this through. Stirling c Seelaar b van der Gugten 69(112) [4s-8]
van der Gugten to Simi Singh, 1 run, back of a length angling into the hips, tucked round the corner

van der Gugten to Simi Singh, FOUR, Simi's turn to get lucky! Backed away early to go inside out over cover but got cramped for space. Ended up squeezing a big inside edge that raced away very fine down the leg-side. Fine leg couldn't get across despite putting a dive

van der Gugten to Stirling, 1 run, streaky for Stirling as he once again tries to force the cut stroke but this time had no room for the shot, gets a thick inside edge that whistles past the leg stump, down to fine leg
van der Gugten to Stirling, no run, short and wide, Stirling went hard on the cut stroke but couldn't get it past backward point. If he had done so, there was a boundary for the taking

van der Gugten to Stirling, 2 runs, not quite off the middle as Stirling tries to heave across the line but gets enough to drag this wide of the mid-on fielder. Was a tad too full from van der Gugten and Stirling chanced his arm on seeing the field up
Fred Klaassen to Stirling, 1 run, leg-lined in-angler and Stirling shuffles across early to tickle this away down to fine leg
Fred Klaassen to Stirling, no run, probably the off-cutter from Klaassen, Stirling saw the length short and tried to cut but got cramped for room in the end. Beaten on the inside edge
Fred Klaassen to Stirling, no run, angling in from a shorter length, Stirling stands tall and punches firmly to cover
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, 1 run, very full and outside off, Simi reaches out and jabs it towards the fielder at cover-point
Fred Klaassen to Simi Singh, no run, back of a length on off stump, Simi hangs back and defends onto the track
Fred Klaassen to Stirling, 1 run, short of a length with width on offer, cut away to the right of the third man fielder

van der Gugten to Simi Singh, no run, back of a length outside off, Simi reaches out and dabs it towards backward point. Maiden from van der Gugten to start his new spell. Much-needed over for the Dutch as these two have been cruising in recent overs
van der Gugten to Simi Singh, no run, short and wide, there to be hit and Simi cracks the cut but once again can't thread the gap at backward point. He'll feel that he has missed out here
van der Gugten to Simi Singh, no run, short of a length around off stump, Simi defends off the bat splice towards point
van der Gugten to Simi Singh, no run, almost a replica of the previous ball as Simi tries to guide it down towards third man but can't get it past the backward point fielder
van der Gugten to Simi Singh, no run, shorter length this time, wider lines and Simi stabs this towards backward point. Can't beat the fielder and so rightly declines the single from Stirling
van der Gugten to Simi Singh, no run, fuller and around off, driven firmly with a straight bat past van der Gugten. Mid-on gets across
Seelaar to Simi Singh, 1 run, takes a cue from his partner and works it away to long-on
Seelaar to Simi Singh, no run, flings in with the arm, Singh blocks it
Seelaar to Stirling, 1 run, flattish, Stirling uses his wrists to pick it away to long-on
Seelaar to Simi Singh, 1 run, lunges forward and extends his defence to long-on
