Santner to Mahmudullah, no run, Santner drops one short and wide of off, cut straight to the fielder at backward point
Santner to Mahmudullah, wide, Santner drags one short and down leg, Mahmudullah was swivelling across on the pull and missed, called as a wide
Santner to Mahmudullah, no run, slower and just outside off - Mahmudullah waits on it and pushes it to the off-side
Santner to Mahmudullah, no run, hint of turn from off, Mahmudullah was looiking to work it to the on-side, the ball straightened around off, caught the leading edge and rolked towards the off-side
Santner to Mithun, 1 run, Santner drifts one onto Mithun's pads, nudged behind square on the on-side for a single
Neesham to Mahmudullah, no run, short of a good length and just outside off, Mahmudullah presses across and defends it towards gully - a wicket maiden from Neesham
Neesham to Mahmudullah, no run, another bouncer from Neesham, Mahmudullah ducks under it and lets it go
Neesham to Mahmudullah, no run, Neesham shortens his length outside off, Mahmudullah leans across and turns it to the on-side
Neesham to Mahmudullah, no run, short of a length and holding its line wide of off, left alone
Neesham to Mahmudullah, no run, banged in short and holding its line outside off, Mahmudullah drops his wrists and sways away from the line

Neesham to Rahim, out Caught by Guptill!! Chopped straight to gully - Rahim is gutted, did all the hard work and has simply thrown it away. Extra bounce causes his undoing, was cramped up for room on the cut as the ball kept coming back with the angle - looked awkward on the chop and ended up dabbing a simple catch to Guptil at wide gully. Second wicket for Neesham and New Zealand's day continues to get better. Rahim c Guptill b Neesham 23(49) [4s-2]
Santner to Mithun, no run, the arm-ball from Santner, slid back into the right-hander, Mithun makes room and pushes it to the off-side
Santner to Mithun, no run, tossed up on the leg-stump line, defended to the on-side
Santner to Rahim, 1 run, pushed through flatter and on the leg-stump line, nudged to the left of square leg for a single
Santner to Mithun, 1 run, Santner drifts one on the leg-stump line, worked towards square leg for a single
Santner to Rahim, 1 run, loopy delivery on off, punched down to long-off for a single
Santner to Rahim, no run, tossed up on off, Rahim leans forward and finds cover with the push-drive
Neesham to Mithun, no run, much better from Neesham, short of a good length and in that corridor outside off - left alone
Neesham to Mithun, wide, banged in short by Neesham, but it sails over Mithun's head and is called as a wide
Neesham to Mithun, no run, Neesham shortens his length around off, defended with an angled bat to the off-side
Neesham to Mithun, 2 runs, short of a length and at the stumps, Mithun swivels across and muscles the pull wide of mid-wicket, back for the second run
Neesham to Rahim, 1 run, banged in short and just outside off - Rahim gets on top of the bounce as he swivelled and pulled it past mid-wicket for a single
Neesham to Rahim, no run, on a good length and just outside off, Rahim leans across and defends it to the off-side

Neesham to Rahim, FOUR, short, wide and four, width on offer and Rahim doesn't miss out - stands tall, rides the bounce and lashes the square cut over backward point, couple of bounces and over the ropes
Jamieson to Mithun, no run, banged in short and holding its line outside off, left alone and it's the first maiden over of the day
Jamieson to Mithun, no run, nicely bowled, short of a length and a hint of straightening past the off-stump - makes Mithun push forward and beats Mithun on the outside edge
Jamieson to Mithun, no run, fraction fuller and just outside off, Mithun plays with an angled bat and defends it to the off-side
Jamieson to Mithun, no run, short of a good length and around the off-stump line, defended back at the bowler
Jamieson to Mithun, no run, back of a length and climbing onto the right-hander, Mithun rides the bounce and drops it down at his feet
Jamieson to Mithun, no run, Jamieson shortens his length around middle, Mithun prods across and turns it to the on-side
Neesham to Rahim, no run, short of a good length and just outside off, Rahim rides the bounce and keeps it down
Neesham to Rahim, no run, Neesham shortens his length and gets it to hold its line outside off, left alone
Neesham to Rahim, no run, short of a good length and just outside off, steered with an angled bat towards backward point
Neesham to Rahim, FOUR, cracking shot, that should release some pressure off Rahim - a wide half-volley and he reaches out on the drive to cream it through cover-point, no need to run for those

Neesham to Rahim, no ball, Neesham slides one short and down the leg-side - Latham has to move acros on the slide to prevent extra runs, called as a wide. But Neesham has overstepped first and it's a no-ball
Neesham to Rahim, no run, back of a length and well wide of off, Rahim steers it straight to Guptill at gully
Neesham to Rahim, no run, fuller length delivery on off, Rahim shuffles across and finds mid-on with the drive
Jamieson to Mithun, no run, on a good length and in that channel around off, Mithun plays with an open stance as he defended
Jamieson to Mithun, no run, short of a good length and holding its line outside off, left alone
Jamieson to Rahim, 1 run, Jamieson shortens his length outside off, catches the shoulder of Rahim's bat as he pressed forward, played with soft hands and the edge runs down to third man

Jamieson to Mithun, 1 run, streaky, Jamieson keeps it full and just outside off - Mithun wasn't fully forward as he pushed at the ball, squirts an inside edge behind square on the on-side for a single
Jamieson to Rahim, 1 run, fraction fuller and in that channel outside off, Rahim plays with an open face and runs it down towards third man
Jamieson to Rahim, no run, Jamieson shortens his length around off, hit Rahim high on the bat as he defended
Neesham to Mithun, no run, on a good length and angling into the pads, Mithun shuffles across and turns it to the on-side
Neesham to Mithun, no run, Neesham shortens his length and gets some extra bounce from outside off - dabbed with an angled bat towards gully
Neesham to Mithun, FOUR, nicely played, a nice friendly half-volley wide of off, Mithun leans into the drive and hit it hard into the ground, bounced over cover and rolled away to the ropes
Neesham to Mithun, no run, tad fuller and at the stumps, Mithun prods across and defends it to the on-side
Neesham to Mithun, no run, fuller length delivery at the stumps, Mithun shuffles across and finds mid-on with the clip
Neesham to Mithun, no run, short of a length and some extra bounce from outside off - Mithun drops his hands and defends it to the off-side
Jamieson to Rahim, no run, slanted in from wide of the crease, Rahim closes the bat face and the soft leading edge rolls back
Jamieson to Rahim, no run, 134.9ks back of a length around off, Rahim camps back and drops it into the off-side
Jamieson to Rahim, no run, 137.1ks fullish delivery around off, Rahim defends it solidly towards point
Jamieson to Rahim, 2 runs, tad too full and Rahim is able to ease the drive past a squarish mid-off, two more

Jamieson to Rahim, no run, Jamieson has his hands on his head. He thought he had Rahim's number. Goes wide of the crease and slants it in, the ball keeps shaping in, Rahim still goes for the drive away from the body and is beaten on the outside edge. Not sure what Rahim was thinking there..
Jamieson to Rahim, 2 runs, angled into the pads, Rahim clips it through the vacant mid-wicket pocket and scampers back for the second
Neesham to Mithun, no run, 129.6ks back of a length around off, Mithun pats it softly in front of backward point
Neesham to Mithun, no run, fuller than a good length and Mithun shoulders arms outside off
Neesham to Mithun, no run, on a length and outside off, Mithun lifts his bat and lets it go

Neesham to Mithun, no run, another leading edge but this one drops safely into the silly point region. Mithun almost makes the same mistake as Das, closes the bat face to a back of a length delivery and the ball does not go far

Neesham to Liton Das, out Caught by Boult!! Neesham strikes with his second delivery. Das' vigil comes to an end. He did all the hard work of surviving New Zealand's front line pacers but falls in a tame manner to the part-time of Neesham. Cross-seam back of a length delivery that holds up on the surface, Das closes the bat face early and the leading edge pops to mid-on where Boult makes no mistake. Liton Das c Boult b Neesham 19(36) [4s-1]
Neesham to Rahim, 1 run, short and outside off, Rahim cuts uppishly but right between gully and backward point, just a single
Jamieson to Liton Das, no run, once more pounded in at 135ks, Das fends it with soft hands down the wicket
Jamieson to Liton Das, no run, 136.5ks short of length ball on off, Das stands tall and defends to the right of Jamieson
Jamieson to Liton Das, no run, 137.3ks back of a length delivery outside off, Das drops his wrists and lets it pass
Jamieson to Liton Das, no run, angled in at the stumps, Das sits back and turns it to square leg
Jamieson to Liton Das, no run, 138.8ks delivery that keeps climbing, Das does well to pull his bat inside the line and not leave it hanging away from the body. Good channels from Jamieson..
Jamieson to Rahim, 1 run, back of a length angled in, Rahim drops it with soft hands into the on-side and races across, quick single stolen
Matt Henry to Liton Das, no run, fuller and around off, Das drives and picks out the mid-on fielder
Matt Henry to Liton Das, no run, once again goes past the batsman without any luck. This was much closer to off-stump and Das had to play, the ball straightened to defeat the outside edge
Matt Henry to Liton Das, no run, 136.6ks back of a length outside off, Das shoulders arms
Matt Henry to Liton Das, no run, 136.1ks full and at the stumps, Das drives crisply but straight to mid-on
Matt Henry to Liton Das, no run, jagging away outside off, Das lifts his bat and lets it go

Matt Henry to Liton Das, 2 runs, banged into the surface but at 132.8ks Henry is not troubling Das, pulled over mid-wicket and since it was not off the middle, the pair have to be content with a brace
Jamieson to Rahim, no run, 136ks back of a length delivery angled in, Rahim defends near his feet and the ball almost rolls back onto the stumps

Jamieson to Rahim, no run, this was a peach. Much closer to off-stump and Rahim had to play for the angle suggested it was coming into him, the ball straightens to beaten him neck and crop on the outside edge

Jamieson to Rahim, no run, that's better from Jamieson. Hits his favourite back of a length and gets the ball to shape away, Rahim could have let it pass as it was well outside off but he goes feeling for the bal and is beaten on the outside edge
Jamieson to Liton Das, 1 run, full and attacking the stumps, Das works it wide of mid-on and settles with a single, good diving stop
Jamieson to Liton Das, no run, very full delivery in the blockhole, Das tries to jam it out but in vain

Jamieson to Liton Das, FOUR, Jamieson welcomed to the attack with a boundary. Das was not in complete control but he will take the runs. Full and shaping away outside off, Das slices the drive uppishly but luckily wide of backward point and the ball races a way to the fence
Matt Henry to Rahim, no run, 132.6ks back of a length on off, Rahim is right behind the line to drop it into the off-side
Matt Henry to Rahim, no run, short of length delivery outside off, Rahim drops his gloves and stays away from the line
Matt Henry to Rahim, no run, pitches it up and draws Rahim into the drive, struck straight to mid-off
Matt Henry to Liton Das, 1 run, nip-backer from short of length, Das tucks it behind square on the leg-side, for a single
Matt Henry to Rahim, 1 run, once more probes away in the channel around off, Rahim pushes at it and the outside edge runs away past the slip cordon, single to third man

Matt Henry to Rahim, no run, edge and safe. Henry is still searching for his wicket. He has been a tad unlucky. This was in the corridor close to off, Rahim has to play and he fends with soft hands, the outside edge lands just in front of second slip
Boult to Rahim, 1 run, 136.5ks short of length delivery, Rahim hops and squirts it off the shoulder of the bat down to third man. A testing over from Boult and Rahim did well to survive
Boult to Rahim, no run, too far outside off and this is a much easier leave for Rahim
Boult to Rahim, no run, on a length and slanted outside off, Rahim confidently shoulders arms

Boult to Rahim, no run, this time he drops his gloves. Very similar delivery to the previous one, the ball kicks up from a length close to off, Rahim drops his hands and allows it to fly through to Latham

Boult to Rahim, no run, uhhh! That's a corker from Boult. Rahim does well not to go searching for it. The ball kicks up from back of a length and is in the channel around off, Rahim looks to fend but the ball goes whizzing past him
Boult to Rahim, no run, back of a length angled outside off, Rahim lifts his bat and lets it go

Matt Henry to Liton Das, 2 runs, on the shorter side and Das plays it really well, he gets on top of the bounce and short-arm jabs it through mid-wicket, he couldn't time it well enough and hence settles with a couple
Matt Henry to Rahim, 1 run, shade fuller and around off, Rahim squirts an inside edge backward of square leg

Matt Henry to Rahim, no run, stifled appeal for LBW now. Once more Rahim is caught in the crease beaten by a delivery that jags back into him, the ball strikes him on the thigh and rolls towards point. Too high..

Matt Henry to Rahim, no run, appeal for a caught behind. Umpire Chris Brown is not convinced. Latham does not take the review. The nip-backer and Rahim is cut into half, the ball beats the inside edge and brushes the back pocket on the way to the keeper, Latham went up but he knew that it was not off the bat
Matt Henry to Rahim, no run, shaping away outside off, Rahim waves his bat and lets it through to Latham
Matt Henry to Rahim, no run, very full delivery and Rahim jams it back to Henry
Boult to Liton Das, no run, short of length around off, Das rides the bounce and pats it with soft hands to backward point
Boult to Liton Das, no run, 136.6ks fullish delivery on off, Das blocks it with a straight bat back to Boult
Boult to Liton Das, no run, once more attacks middle and leg-stump, Das gently turns it to mid-wicket
Boult to Liton Das, no run, 134.6ks back of a length on the hips, Das hops and tucks it in front of mid-wicket
Boult to Liton Das, no run, shortens the length and keeps it around off, Das is right behind the line to defend
Boult to Liton Das, 2 runs, angled across the right hander, Das uses that to his advantage and eases it square on the off-side, just a gentle push and he scampers back comfortably for the second
Matt Henry to Rahim, no run, back of a length around off, Rahim sits back and blocks it solidly into the off-side

Matt Henry to Liton Das, 3 runs, fuller and searching for that outside edge, no movement and Das drives it past a diving cover fielder, he could not time the ball and that allows Neesham to hunt it down before it could reach the fence
Matt Henry to Liton Das, no run, on a length and close to off, Das defends with the bat and pad close together

Matt Henry to Rahim, 1 run, short and at the body, Rahim is wrapped on the gloves as he tries to fend it away, bit of extra bounce on that occasion and that surprised the right hander, safely negotiated backward of square leg
Matt Henry to Rahim, no run, back of a length around off, Rahim dabs it in front of backward point

Matt Henry to Liton Das, 1 run, dropped! It will go down as Mitchell's drop catch but he was put off by his skipper. Another unplayable delivery. Back of a length and in the corridor, Das dangles his bat and the outside edge is flying straight down first slip's lap, but Latham decides to dive across and blind Mitchell, he has no clue as the ball hits his fingers and rolls away

Boult to Rahim, no run, he is into his elements. Lands it on a length and keeps it in channel around off, Rahim plays expecting the ball to come back in, but the ball goes on with the angle to beat the outside edge
Boult to Rahim, wide, swinging down leg, Rahim does not connect with the glance and Latham flies to his left to make a one-handed stop, saved four runs there
Boult to Rahim, no run, 134.9ks short ball at the body, Rahim goes on his toes and fends it safely into the leg-side

Boult to Soumya Sarkar, out Caught by Conway!! Two in the over for Boult. Sarkar goes for a duck. Bangladesh in early trouble. This was a short ball and Sarkar wanted to upper cut it like his skipper had done in the first over, but he does not get on top of the bounce even though he jumps up, the ball hits the splice of the bat and balloons towards cover, Conway backtracks and reverse cups it over his head. The debutant made that look really easy. Soumya Sarkar c Conway b Boult 0(3)
Boult to Soumya Sarkar, no run, bit of away movement around off, Sarkar waits and blocks it late right under his eyes
Boult to Soumya Sarkar, no run, back of a length at the stumps, Sarkar defends carefully into the on-side

Boult to Tamim, out Lbw!! That's plumb. Boult knew it, Tamim knew it and more importantly umpire Chris Gaffaney knew it. It was only a matter of time before Boult broke through with the conditions offering enough assistance. It was a straight ball, angled into the left hander, Tamim plants his front foot across early and then tries to play around it, misses and is struck dead in front of the stumps. He does not even bother to discuss about the review with Das. Tamim lbw b Boult 13(15) [4s-1 6s-1]
Matt Henry to Tamim, 1 run, fuller than a good length, Tamim presses forward to block and the ball takes the outer edge, rolls away to third man
Matt Henry to Tamim, no run, on a length and angling across, Tamim prods forward and defends to cover
Matt Henry to Tamim, no run, aims for the ribs, Tamim hops and drops it with soft hands in front of mid-wicket
Matt Henry to Liton Das, 1 run, 135.7ks short ball at the body, Das has ample time to play the pull along the ground and pick up a single down to fine leg
Matt Henry to Liton Das, no run, 134.2ks delivery that is fraction short and outside off, Das cracks the cut straight to backward point
Matt Henry to Tamim, leg byes, 1 run, too straight and Tamim misses out, he fails to meet with the flick and the ball deflects off the thigh pad backward of square leg
Boult to Liton Das, no run, short of length on off, Das stands tall and blocks it down the wicket

Boult to Liton Das, no run, ufff! Scrambled seam delivery from Boult and Das does well not to nick it. Back of a length and around off, Das held his bat and allowed the ball to go past him, once more nice carry through to Latham

Boult to Liton Das, wide, tests the bounce on the surface and concedes the extra. Bumper that is dug in very short, Das ducks under it comfortably and Latham had to leap up to glove it, called for height
Boult to Liton Das, no run, really full delivery close to off, Das jams it out towards cover

Boult to Liton Das, 2 runs, neatly done! Das allows the good length delivery to arrive, he opens the bat face and eases it square on the off-side, just knocked it past the infield and collected a brace
Boult to Tamim, 1 run, shortens the length around off, Tamim gets on top of the bounce and steers it behind point, just a single

Boult to Tamim, no run, oh my! Another unplayable delivery from Boult. Tamim is opened like a can of beans. The ball shaped in and then curled away late, Tamim was moving forward to defend and is squared up completely as the ball brushes the back thigh on the way to Latham
Matt Henry to Liton Das, no run, uhh! That was a good leave. The ball held its line in the corridor around off but Das had it covered, he trusted the bounce on the surface and let it pass
Matt Henry to Liton Das, no run, nice shape and carry. The outswinger from back of a length, Das shoulders arms and Latham gathers that over his shoulder

Matt Henry to Tamim, 1 run, tight single but no harm done. Fraction short and around the hips, Tamim tucks it towards square leg and sets off, Das responds and gets in before Nicholls' throw goes past the stumps
Matt Henry to Tamim, no run, back of a length on off-stump, Tamim is right behind the line to defend

Matt Henry to Tamim, FOUR, Tamim is looking in ominous touch. Anything slightly off and he is pouncing on them. Henry strays onto the pads, Tamim flicks it square and the timing ensures that the ball races to the fence
Matt Henry to Tamim, no run, 133.6ks delivery around the off-stump channel, Tamim blocks it with a straight bat to mid-wicket
Boult to Liton Das, no run, good length ball close to off, Das leans forward and defends right under his eyes
Boult to Liton Das, no run, slanting across and shaping away outside off, Das lifts his bat and lets it go
Boult to Tamim, legbyes, 1 run, angled in and Tamim falls over as he attempts the flick, the ball deflects off the thigh pad into the on-side

Boult to Tamim, SIX, whoa! Tamim is up for the battle. Boult is off-radar and the Bangladesh skipper is not letting him go unpunished. Short and outside off, Tamim jumps up to ride the bounce and slashes the upper cut all the way over point
Boult to Tamim, no run, on a length and around off, Tamim prods forward and defends solidly back to Boult

Boult to Tamim, no run, oh ho ho! That's a beauty to start the series. Boult thought he had his man as his hands went on his head. Really full delivery that curls in because of the air and then shapes away late, Tamim tries to jam it out but is beaten comprehensively on the outside edge
Saifuddin to Latham, FOUR, full and picked off the pads to the fine leg fence. Sealed. New Zealand win the series with a game to go.

Saifuddin to Latham, no run, drama! Latham was beaten on the inside edge and the ball deflected off the pad to short cover. Daryl Mitchell sensed a quick single and tripped over in the middle of the pitch, the throw from the fielder was slightly wide and Mitchell gets home with a dive
Soumya Sarkar to Daryl Mitchell, 2 runs, pulls once again and this one drops short of the fielder at deep mid-wicket, Mitchell wanted the third but Latham wasn't keen on it. Sent back
Soumya Sarkar to Daryl Mitchell, FOUR, short once again and Mitchell jumps on it with a well-timed pull, the placement is good and now they're just one hit away from the target
Soumya Sarkar to Latham, 1 run, touch short outside off, pulled away wide of long-on
Mustafizur to Daryl Mitchell, 1 run, opens the bat face and steers the 120ks length delivery to backward point's left
Mustafizur to Daryl Mitchell, no run, good length just outside off, blocked into the covers

Mustafizur to Daryl Mitchell, FOUR, too full outside off. Change of pace, but it doesn't matter for Daryl Mitchell who's got long levers to clear the field with ease. Gets under the delivery and pumps it over mid-off
Taskin Ahmed to Latham, no run, was there an edge? Might be. Latham looks to pull the short ball and gets a fine edge off the back of the shoulder of the bat, drops well short of the keeper though
Taskin Ahmed to Latham, FOUR, gets a thick toe-edge on the pull and it flies away over the keeper for a one bounce boundary. New Zealand are just three hits away from sealing this game...
Taskin Ahmed to Daryl Mitchell, 1 run, good length just outside off, pushed away wide of mid-on and Mitchell's off the mark with a quick single
Taskin Ahmed to Latham, 1 run, chips the drive off the toe-end to mid-on and a clean pick up would have enabled a run-out opportunity at the bowling end, wasn't to be. Tamim was the fielder there
Taskin Ahmed to Latham, no run, clipped away to short mid-wicket

Taskin Ahmed to Latham, FOUR, HUNDRED NUMBER FIVE for skipper Tom Latham! It's his home ground and he gets to the milestone in style. Swivels and takes on the short ball from outside off to hammer the pull into the backward square leg fence
Mustafizur to Latham, 1 run, full on the pads, flicked away to the left of short mid-wicket
Mustafizur to Latham, FOUR, short and wide once again and Latham's carved that over backward point with disdain, just a couple of bounces and into the fence it goes...
Mustafizur to Latham, 2 runs, 131ks back of a length wide of off, cut away to the right of deep backward point

Mustafizur to Neesham, out Caught by Soumya Sarkar!! Neesham's gone but is it too late for Bangladesh? Mustafizur bowls a 120ks full delivery outside off and the batsman clearly didn't pick the change of pace, got lured by the length and heaved it straight down the throat of long-on. Neesham c Soumya Sarkar b Mustafizur 30(34) [4s-2]
Mustafizur to Neesham, FOUR, unveils the short ball and Neesham smashes the pull in the gap between deep mid-wicket and long-on. A desperate dive from the former but, no dice
Mustafizur to Neesham, wide, too full and wide of off, past the tramline as Neesham lets it pas
Mustafizur to Latham, 1 run, very full outside off at 135ks, Latham drives straight to mid-off and hustles across for a quick single
Mahedi Hasan to Latham, 1 run, driven down to long-on for an easy single
Mahedi Hasan to Neesham, 1 run, looks to heave/pull a quicker delivery and gets a thick inside edge to short fine
Mahedi Hasan to Neesham, 2 runs, comes down the track and drags the full delivery from outside off, drops well short of the fielder at long-on
Mahedi Hasan to Neesham, no run, punched off the back foot to short cover

Mahedi Hasan to Latham, 1 run, advances and mistimes the drive off the inside half towards long-on
Mustafizur to Latham, 1 run, swivels and nails the pull off the middle of the bat, picks out the fielder at deep square to his left
Mustafizur to Neesham, 1 run, full on off-stump, Neesham drops it into the off-side and calls his partner through for a quick single
Mustafizur to Latham, 1 run, fetches the short ball from wide of off and drags it off the toe-end to the left of deep mid-wicket
Mustafizur to Neesham, 1 run, 137ks full and wide of off, Neesham opens the bat face and drives to deep cover
Mustafizur to Neesham, no run, hint of reverse outside off, Neesham looks to drive sans any feet and gets beaten on the outside edge
Mustafizur to Latham, 1 run, flat-bat pull to the left of long-on

Mehidy Hasan to Latham, 1 run, shouts of 'catch it' but the keeper can't get there. Latham went for the scoop and sliced it off the toe-end to the right of the keeper. Mushfiqur was a tad late to react and hence got nowhere close
Mehidy Hasan to Neesham, 1 run, stays on the back foot and chops the quicker delivery square on the off-side
Mehidy Hasan to Neesham, no run, cuts and picks out the fielder at cover
Mehidy Hasan to Neesham, no run, looks to cut and gets beaten on the outside edge, too close to cut perhaps?
Mehidy Hasan to Neesham, no run, stays back and dabs the flatter delivery into the off-side
Mehidy Hasan to Neesham, no run, fuller on the stumps, Neesham prods forward and defends
Saifuddin to Latham, no run, advances and flicks the full delivery to the left of mid-wicket
Saifuddin to Neesham, 1 run, too full on off-stump, squeezed away wide of cover
Saifuddin to Neesham, no run, drops the ball in front of backward point and looks to nab a quick single. A direct hit from Mehidy but Neesham's well in with a dive
Saifuddin to Neesham, 2 runs, 126ks short and angled in, Neesham swivels and pulls it to the right of fine leg
Saifuddin to Latham, 1 run, full and veering into the pads, flicked away to the left of deep mid-wicket
Saifuddin to Latham, no run, 126ks good length just outside off, Latham walks forward and tucks to mid-wicket
Mehidy Hasan to Latham, 1 run, drops it short again and Latham uses the width on offer to cut it square on the off-side
Mehidy Hasan to Latham, no run, full and just outside off, worked to mid-wicket
Mehidy Hasan to Neesham, 3 runs, fractin short outside off, Neesham pulls it over mid-on and the fielder does well to put in dive at the last moment to prevent the boundary
Mehidy Hasan to Latham, 1 run, slapped off the back foot to sweeper cover
Mehidy Hasan to Latham, no run, opens the bat face and pushes the full delivery to backward point
Mehidy Hasan to Latham, no run, flat and fast outside off, Latham cuts and can't beat cover

Jamieson to Tamim, no run, Jamieson has pulled off a stunner here? A pitched up delivery and that's been driven back towards the bowler and guess what! Jamieson, 6 feet 8 inches tall, gets down really low to snaffle that. But, the umpires want to check if it's a fair catch. The soft signal is OUT. He's caught it cleanly, but did the ball touch the ground as he went down? The zoomer is in and this is what the TV umpire says - "I have got the ball on the ground and the player is not fully in control." And, the soft signal has been overturned. NOT OUT flashed on the giant screen and Jamieson has his arms up in the air. He is certainly not happy with the call...
